verses.meaning: Actions do not chain the self-possessed. The one who renounced action through discipline. Whose doubts wisdom destroyed.
verses.takeaway: Cut the chains before they tighten.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मादज्ञानसम्भूतं हृत्स्थं ज्ञानासिनात्मनः ।
छित्त्वैनं संशयं योगमातिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ भारत
verses.iast:
tasmādajñānasambhūtaṃ hṛtsthaṃ jñānāsinātmanaḥ |
chittvainaṃ saṃśayaṃ yogamātiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhārata
verses.meaning: So cut this doubt born of ignorance with the sword of wisdom. Stand in discipline and rise up to fight.
verses.takeaway: The chapter ends the way it began — with a sword and a sunrise.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
संन्यासं कर्मणां कृष्ण पुनर्योगं च शंससि ।
यच्छ्रेय एतयोरेकं तन्मे ब्रूहि सुनिश्चितम्
verses.iast:
saṃnyāsaṃ karmaṇāṃ kṛṣṇa punaryogaṃ ca śaṃsasi |
yacchreya etayorekaṃ tanme brūhi suniścitam
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: you praise giving up actions, and also doing them. Tell me plainly which of the two is better.
verses.takeaway: When two goods compete, ask which is greater.

verses.devanagari:
संन्यासः कर्मयोगश्च निःश्रेयसकरावुभौ ।
तयोस्तु कर्मसंन्यासात्कर्मयोगो विशिष्यते
verses.iast:
saṃnyāsaḥ karmayogaśca niḥśreyasakarāvubhau |
tayostu karmasaṃnyāsātkarmayogo viśiṣyate
verses.meaning: Krishna said: both giving up and doing lead to freedom. But of the two, disciplined doing is the better path.
verses.takeaway: Act, don't abstain.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञेयः स नित्यसंन्यासी यो न द्वेष्टि न काङ्क्षति ।
निर्द्वन्द्वो हि महाबाहो सुखं बन्धात्प्रमुच्यते
verses.iast:
jñeyaḥ sa nityasaṃnyāsī yo na dveṣṭi na kāṅkṣati |
nirdvandvo hi mahābāho sukhaṃ bandhātpramucyate
verses.meaning: Know that the true renouncer is one with no dislikes and no cravings. Free of opposites, such a one is easily freed from chains.
verses.takeaway: Renunciation is a state of mind, not an empty calendar.

verses.devanagari:
सांख्ययोगौ पृथग्बालाः प्रवदन्ति न पण्डिताः ।
एकमप्यास्थितः सम्यगुभयोर्विन्दते फलम्
verses.iast:
sāṃkhyayogau pṛthagbālāḥ pravadanti na paṇḍitāḥ |
ekamapyāsthitaḥ samyagubhayorvindate phalam
verses.meaning: Only children, not wise people, say understanding and disciplined action are different things. Master either one fully and you reap both rewards.
verses.takeaway: Different doors, same room.

verses.devanagari:
यत्सांख्यैः प्राप्यते स्थानं तद्योगैरपि गम्यते ।
एकं सांख्यं च योगं च यः पश्यति स: पश्यति
verses.iast:
yatsāṃkhyaiḥ prāpyate sthānaṃ tadyogairapi gamyate |
ekaṃ sāṃkhyaṃ ca yogaṃ ca yaḥ paśyati sa: paśyati
verses.meaning: The peace that thinkers reach, doers reach too. Whoever sees understanding and action as one — sees truly.
verses.takeaway: Stop choosing between them.

verses.devanagari:
संन्यासस्तु महाबाहो दुःखमाप्तुमयोगतः ।
योगयुक्तो मुनिर्ब्रह्म नचिरेणाधिगच्छति
verses.iast:
saṃnyāsastu mahābāho duḥkhamāptumayogataḥ |
yogayukto munirbrahma nacireṇādhigacchati
verses.meaning: Giving up without discipline is hard and painful. But the sage grounded in discipline soon reaches ultimate reality.
verses.takeaway: You cannot skip to the end.

verses.devanagari:
योगयुक्तो विशुद्धात्मा विजितात्मा जितेन्द्रियः ।
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा कुर्वन्नपि न लिप्यते
verses.iast:
yogayukto viśuddhātmā vijitātmā jitendriyaḥ |
sarvabhūtātmabhūtātmā kurvannapi na lipyate
verses.meaning: One whose self is pure. Self controlled. Senses ruled. Who sees the same self in every being. Acts without getting stained.
verses.takeaway: Clean hands, full schedule.

verses.devanagari:
नैव किंचित्करोमीति युक्तो मन्येत तत्त्ववित् ।
पश्यञ्श्रृण्वन्स्पृशञ्जिघ्रन्नश्नन्‌गच्छन्स्वपञ्श्वसन्
verses.iast:
naiva kiṃcitkaromīti yukto manyeta tattvavit |
paśyañśrṛṇvanspṛśañjighrannaśnan‌gacchansvapañśvasan
verses.meaning: The disciplined knower thinks 'I do nothing at all.' This while seeing, hearing, touching, smelling, eating, moving. Sleeping, breathing, speaking, excreting, grasping. Opening and closing the eyes.
verses.takeaway: Watch yourself live for one hour as a spectator.

verses.devanagari:
प्रलपन्विसृजन्गृह्णन्नुन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि ।
इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेषु वर्तन्त इति धारयन्
verses.iast:
pralapanvisṛjangṛhṇannunmiṣannimiṣannapi |
indriyāṇīndriyārtheṣu vartanta iti dhārayan
verses.meaning: Casting off clinging, one who acts as an offering to ultimate reality stays unstained. Like a lotus leaf untouched by water.
verses.takeaway: The book's most beautiful image of freedom.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मण्याधाय कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा करोति यः ।
लिप्यते न स पापेन पद्मपत्रमिवाम्भसा
verses.iast:
brahmaṇyādhāya karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā karoti yaḥ |
lipyate na sa pāpena padmapatramivāmbhasā
verses.meaning: Devotees act for self-purification alone. With body, mind, understanding — even senses. Dropping all clinging.
verses.takeaway: Use everything you have. Cling to nothing.

verses.devanagari:
कायेन मनसा बुद्ध्या केवलैरिन्द्रियैरपि ।
योगिनः कर्म कुर्वन्ति सङ्गं त्यक्त्वात्मशुद्धये
verses.iast:
kāyena manasā buddhyā kevalairindriyairapi |
yoginaḥ karma kurvanti saṅgaṃ tyaktvātmaśuddhaye
verses.meaning: Dropping results, one gains the highest peace. But the undisciplined, hungry for results, stay chained by desire.
verses.takeaway: Two workers, same work, opposite fates.

verses.devanagari:
युक्तः कर्मफलं त्यक्त्वा शान्तिमाप्नोति नैष्ठिकीम् ।
अयुक्तः कामकारेण फले सक्तो निबध्यते
verses.iast:
yuktaḥ karmaphalaṃ tyaktvā śāntimāpnoti naiṣṭhikīm |
ayuktaḥ kāmakāreṇa phale sakto nibadhyate
verses.meaning: The self-ruled self sits at ease in the nine-gated city of the body. Neither acting. Nor causing action.
verses.takeaway: You are the resident, not the building.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वकर्माणि मनसा संन्यस्यास्ते सुखं वशी ।
नवद्वारे पुरे देही नैव कुर्वन्न कारयन्
verses.iast:
sarvakarmāṇi manasā saṃnyasyāste sukhaṃ vaśī |
navadvāre pure dehī naiva kurvanna kārayan
verses.meaning: The Lord starts no one's actions, nor anyone's capacity to act, nor links deeds to results. Nature alone does all that.
verses.takeaway: God doesn't micromanage. Nature runs the office.

verses.devanagari:
न कर्तृत्वं न कर्माणि लोकस्य सृजति प्रभुः ।
न कर्मफलसंयोगं स्वभावस्तु प्रवर्तते
verses.iast:
na kartṛtvaṃ na karmāṇi lokasya sṛjati prabhuḥ |
na karmaphalasaṃyogaṃ svabhāvastu pravartate
verses.meaning: The Lord takes on no one's sin or merit. Wisdom lies covered by ignorance — and so all beings wander confused.
verses.takeaway: The sun is shining. The curtains are yours.

verses.devanagari:
नादत्ते कस्यचित्पापं न चैव सुकृतं विभुः ।
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः
verses.iast:
nādatte kasyacitpāpaṃ na caiva sukṛtaṃ vibhuḥ |
ajñānenāvṛtaṃ jñānaṃ tena muhyanti jantavaḥ
verses.meaning: But those whose ignorance wisdom destroys — for them, wisdom shines like the sun on the highest truth.
verses.takeaway: Light doesn't argue with darkness. It just arrives.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञानेन तु तदज्ञानं येषां नाशितमात्मनः ।
तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत्परम्
verses.iast:
jñānena tu tadajñānaṃ yeṣāṃ nāśitamātmanaḥ |
teṣāmādityavajjñānaṃ prakāśayati tatparam
verses.meaning: Minds fixed on That. Selves merged in That. Devoted to That. That as their final goal. They never return, their wrongs washed away by wisdom.
verses.takeaway: Point everything at one thing.

verses.devanagari:
तद्‌बुद्धयस्तदात्मानस्तन्निष्ठास्तत्परायणाः ।
गच्छन्त्यपुनरावृत्तिं ज्ञाननिर्धूतकल्मषाः
verses.iast:
tad‌buddhayastadātmānastanniṣṭhāstatparāyaṇāḥ |
gacchantyapunarāvṛttiṃ jñānanirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ
verses.meaning: The wise see the same in a learned humble priest, a cow, an elephant, a dog — even a dog-eating outcast.
verses.takeaway: The book's most radical sentence. Sit with it.

verses.devanagari:
विद्याविनयसंपन्ने ब्राह्मणे गवि हस्तिनि ।
शुनि चैव श्वपाके च पण्डिताः समदर्शिनः
verses.iast:
vidyāvinayasaṃpanne brāhmaṇe gavi hastini |
śuni caiva śvapāke ca paṇḍitāḥ samadarśinaḥ
verses.meaning: Even here on earth, the steady-minded conquer rebirth. For ultimate reality is flawless and steady. And in it they rest.
verses.takeaway: Win the war before the battlefield.

verses.devanagari:
इहैव तैर्जितः सर्गो येषां साम्ये स्थितं मनः ।
निर्दोषं हि समं ब्रह्म तस्माद्ब्रह्मणि ते स्थिताः
verses.iast:
ihaiva tairjitaḥ sargo yeṣāṃ sāmye sthitaṃ manaḥ |
nirdoṣaṃ hi samaṃ brahma tasmādbrahmaṇi te sthitāḥ
verses.meaning: One who knows ultimate reality, mind steady, undeluded, resting in it. Such a one neither cheers at pleasant things nor mourns unpleasant ones.
verses.takeaway: Good news and bad news get the same face.

verses.devanagari:
न प्रहृष्येत्प्रियं प्राप्य नोद्विजेत्प्राप्य चाप्रियम् ।
स्थिरबुद्धिरसंमूढो ब्रह्मविद्ब्रह्मणि स्थितः
verses.iast:
na prahṛṣyetpriyaṃ prāpya nodvijetprāpya cāpriyam |
sthirabuddhirasaṃmūḍho brahmavidbrahmaṇi sthitaḥ
verses.meaning: Detached from outer contacts, one finds the happiness inside the self. Joined to ultimate reality through focus. Unbreakable happiness.
verses.takeaway: The happiness that needs nothing external.

verses.devanagari:
बाह्यस्पर्शेष्वसक्तात्मा विन्दत्यात्मनि यत् सुखम् ।
स ब्रह्मयोगयुक्तात्मा सुखमक्षयमश्नुते
verses.iast:
bāhyasparśeṣvasaktātmā vindatyātmani yat sukham |
sa brahmayogayuktātmā sukhamakṣayamaśnute
verses.meaning: Pleasures born of contact are wombs of suffering — they begin and they end. The wise take no delight in them.
verses.takeaway: Everything with a start date has an expiry date.

verses.devanagari:
ये हि संस्पर्शजा भोगा दुःखयोनय एव ते ।
आद्यन्तवन्तः कौन्तेय न तेषु रमते बुधः
verses.iast:
ye hi saṃsparśajā bhogā duḥkhayonaya eva te |
ādyantavantaḥ kaunteya na teṣu ramate budhaḥ
verses.meaning: Whoever can bear, even in this life before death, the surges of desire and anger — that person is disciplined. That person is happy.
verses.takeaway: Bear it now, not later.

verses.devanagari:
शक्नोतीहैव यः सोढुं प्राक्शरीरविमोक्षणात् ।
कामक्रोधोद्भवं वेगं स युक्तः स सुखी नरः
verses.iast:
śaknotīhaiva yaḥ soḍhuṃ prākśarīravimokṣaṇāt |
kāmakrodhodbhavaṃ vegaṃ sa yuktaḥ sa sukhī naraḥ
verses.meaning: Happy within. Sporting within. Lit from within. Such a devotee, one with ultimate reality, reaches ultimate peace.
verses.takeaway: Three 'withins' in one verse. The direction is clear.

verses.devanagari:
योऽन्तःसुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथान्तर्ज्योतिरेव यः ।
स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति
verses.iast:
yo'ntaḥsukho'ntarārāmastathāntarjyotireva yaḥ |
sa yogī brahmanirvāṇaṃ brahmabhūto'dhigacchati
verses.meaning: Sages whose wrongs have ended. Doubts cut away. Selves ruled. Devoted to every being's welfare. They reach ultimate peace.
verses.takeaway: Freedom that includes everyone, or it isn't freedom.

verses.devanagari:
लभन्ते ब्रह्मनिर्वाणमृषयः क्षीणकल्मषाः ।
छिन्नद्वैधा यतात्मानः सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.iast:
labhante brahmanirvāṇamṛṣayaḥ kṣīṇakalmaṣāḥ |
chinnadvaidhā yatātmānaḥ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.meaning: Ascetics free of desire and anger. Minds ruled. Knowers of the self. Ultimate peace surrounds them — in life and after.
verses.takeaway: Peace on both sides of death.

verses.devanagari:
कामक्रोधवियुक्तानां यतीनां यतचेतसाम् ।
अभितो ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं वर्तते विदितात्मनाम्
verses.iast:
kāmakrodhaviyuktānāṃ yatīnāṃ yatacetasām |
abhito brahmanirvāṇaṃ vartate viditātmanām
verses.meaning: The sage shuts out outer contacts. Gaze fixed between the brows. Breath in and out made even, held within the nose.
verses.takeaway: The book gives actual instructions here. Follow them literally once.

verses.devanagari:
स्पर्शान्कृत्वा बहिर्बाह्यांश्चक्षुश्चैवान्तरे भ्रुवोः ।
प्राणापानौ समौ कृत्वा नासाभ्यन्तरचारिणौ
verses.iast:
sparśānkṛtvā bahirbāhyāṃścakṣuścaivāntare bhruvoḥ |
prāṇāpānau samau kṛtvā nāsābhyantaracāriṇau
verses.meaning: Senses, mind, understanding restrained. Aimed at liberation. Rid of desire, fear, anger. Such a one is forever free.
verses.takeaway: The full setup, stated as one sentence.

verses.devanagari:
यतेन्द्रियमनोबुद्धिर्मुनिर्मोक्षपरायणः ।
विगतेच्छाभयक्रोधो यः सदा मुक्त एव सः
verses.iast:
yatendriyamanobuddhirmunirmokṣaparāyaṇaḥ |
vigatecchābhayakrodho yaḥ sadā mukta eva saḥ
verses.meaning: Knowing Me as enjoyer of all sacrifices and penances, great lord of all worlds, friend of all beings — one finds peace.
verses.takeaway: The friend line changes everything. Read it twice.

verses.devanagari:
भोक्तारं यज्ञतपसां सर्वलोकमहेश्वरम् ।
सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां ज्ञात्वा मां शान्तिमृच्छति
verses.iast:
bhoktāraṃ yajñatapasāṃ sarvalokamaheśvaram |
suhṛdaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ jñātvā māṃ śāntimṛcchati
verses.meaning: Knowing Me as enjoyer of all sacrifices and penances, great lord of all worlds, friend of all beings — one finds peace.
verses.takeaway: The friend line changes everything. Read it twice.

verses.devanagari: स संन्यासी च योगी च न निरग्निर्न चाक्रियः
verses.iast: sa saṃnyāsī ca yogī ca na niragnirna cākriyaḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: whoever does the work that must be done, wanting no reward — that person is both renouncer and disciplined. Not one who just skips rituals or sits idle.
verses.takeaway: Do the work. Skip the theater.

verses.devanagari:
यं संन्यासमिति प्राहुर्योगं तं विद्धि पाण्डव ।
न ह्यसंन्यस्तसंकल्पो योगी भवति कश्चन
verses.iast:
yaṃ saṃnyāsamiti prāhuryogaṃ taṃ viddhi pāṇḍava |
na hyasaṃnyastasaṃkalpo yogī bhavati kaścana
verses.meaning: Know this. What they call renunciation is discipline itself. No one becomes disciplined without giving up selfish plans.
verses.takeaway: Different doors, same house — again, because we forget.

verses.devanagari:
आरुरुक्षोर्मुनेर्योगं कर्म कारणमुच्यते ।
योगारूढस्य तस्यैव शमः कारणमुच्यते
verses.iast:
ārurukṣormuneryogaṃ karma kāraṇamucyate |
yogārūḍhasya tasyaiva śamaḥ kāraṇamucyate
verses.meaning: For a beginner on the path, action is the vehicle. For one who has arrived, stillness becomes the vehicle.
verses.takeaway: Climb with effort. Rest in arrival.

verses.devanagari:
यदा हि नेन्द्रियार्थेषु न कर्मस्वनुषज्जते ।
सर्वसंकल्पसंन्यासी योगारूढस्तदोच्यते
verses.iast:
yadā hi nendriyārtheṣu na karmasvanuṣajjate |
sarvasaṃkalpasaṃnyāsī yogārūḍhastadocyate
verses.meaning: When one chases neither sense-objects nor actions. Having dropped every selfish plan. Then one has truly risen.
verses.takeaway: Freedom is what you stop grabbing.

verses.devanagari:
उद्धरेदात्मनात्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत् ।
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः
verses.iast:
uddharedātmanātmānaṃ nātmānamavasādayet |
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhurātmaiva ripurātmanaḥ
verses.meaning: Lift yourself by yourself. Never put yourself down. For your self can be your best friend — and your worst enemy.
verses.takeaway: You are both the patient and the doctor.

verses.devanagari:
बन्धुरात्मात्मनस्तस्य येनात्मैवात्मना जितः ।
अनात्मनस्तु शत्रुत्वे वर्तेतात्मैव शत्रुवत्
verses.iast:
bandhurātmātmanastasya yenātmaivātmanā jitaḥ |
anātmanastu śatrutve vartetātmaiva śatruvat
verses.meaning: For one who has conquered the self, the self is a friend. For one who hasn't, the self behaves like an enemy.
verses.takeaway: Befriend yourself before demanding anything of yourself.

verses.devanagari:
जितात्मनः प्रशान्तस्य परमात्मा समाहितः ।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु तथा मानापमानयोः
verses.iast:
jitātmanaḥ praśāntasya paramātmā samāhitaḥ |
śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu tathā mānāpamānayoḥ
verses.meaning: The self-controlled self stays steady amid cold and heat, pleasure and pain, honor and disgrace.
verses.takeaway: Thermometer people react. Thermostat people remain.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञानविज्ञानतृप्तात्मा कूटस्थो विजितेन्द्रियः ।
युक्त इत्युच्यते योगी समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः
verses.iast:
jñānavijñānatṛptātmā kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ |
yukta ityucyate yogī samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ
verses.meaning: Content with wisdom and experience, unshaken, senses ruled — to such a one, a lump of earth, a stone, and gold weigh the same. That is discipline.
verses.takeaway: Same weight, mud or gold.

verses.devanagari:
सुहृन्मित्रार्युदासीनमध्यस्थद्वेष्यबन्धुषु ।
साधुष्वपि च पापेषु समबुद्धिर्विशिष्यते
verses.iast:
suhṛnmitrāryudāsīnamadhyasthadveṣyabandhuṣu |
sādhuṣvapi ca pāpeṣu samabuddhirviśiṣyate
verses.meaning: Whoever sees alike. Well-wisher, friend, foe, stranger. Mediator, the hateful, kin. Good and wicked alike. Such a one stands tallest of all.
verses.takeaway: The seating chart of an equal mind.

verses.devanagari:
योगी युञ्जीत सततमात्मानं रहसि स्थितः ।
एकाकी यतचित्तात्मा निराशीरपरिग्रहः
verses.iast:
yogī yuñjīta satatamātmānaṃ rahasi sthitaḥ |
ekākī yatacittātmā nirāśīraparigrahaḥ
verses.meaning: Practice alone, in a clean, quiet place. Body and mind controlled. Wanting nothing. Owning nothing.
verses.takeaway: Solitude is equipment, not escape.

verses.devanagari:
शुचौ देशे प्रतिष्ठाप्य स्थिरमासनमात्मनः ।
नात्युच्छ्रितं नातिनीचं चैलाजिनकुशोत्तरम्
verses.iast:
śucau deśe pratiṣṭhāpya sthiramāsanamātmanaḥ |
nātyucchritaṃ nātinīcaṃ cailājinakuśottaram
verses.meaning: Seat firm, neither too high nor too low, layered with cloth, deerskin and sacred grass —
verses.takeaway: Set the stage before the practice.

verses.devanagari:
तत्रैकाग्रं मनः कृत्वा यतचित्तेन्द्रियक्रियः ।
उपविश्यासने युञ्ज्याद्योगमात्मविशुद्धये
verses.iast:
tatraikāgraṃ manaḥ kṛtvā yatacittendriyakriyaḥ |
upaviśyāsane yuñjyādyogamātmaviśuddhaye
verses.meaning: Sitting there. Mind pointed at one thing. Senses and workings stilled. Practice discipline, to purify yourself.
verses.takeaway: One point. Everything else can wait.

verses.devanagari:
समं कायशिरोग्रीवं धारयन्नचलं स्थिरः ।
सम्प्रेक्ष्य नासिकाग्रं स्वं दिशश्चानवलोकयन्
verses.iast:
samaṃ kāyaśirogrīvaṃ dhārayannacalaṃ sthiraḥ |
samprekṣya nāsikāgraṃ svaṃ diśaścānavalokayan
verses.meaning: Body, head and neck held straight and still. Gaze resting softly between the brows, looking nowhere else.
verses.takeaway: Posture is the first instruction for a reason.

verses.devanagari:
प्रशान्तात्मा विगतभीर्ब्रह्मचारिव्रते स्थितः ।
मनः संयम्य मच्चित्तो युक्त आसीत मत्परः
verses.iast:
praśāntātmā vigatabhīrbrahmacārivrate sthitaḥ |
manaḥ saṃyamya maccitto yukta āsīta matparaḥ
verses.meaning: Calm in self. Fearless. Firm in celibacy. Mind restrained and fixed on Me. Sit devoted, with Me as the final goal.
verses.takeaway: The full sitting instruction in one verse.

verses.devanagari:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी नियतमानसः ।
शान्तिं निर्वाणपरमां मत्संस्थामधिगच्छति
verses.iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī niyatamānasaḥ |
śāntiṃ nirvāṇaparamāṃ matsaṃsthāmadhigacchati
verses.meaning: Practicing like this constantly, the disciplined mind finds peace — the highest peace, union with Me.
verses.takeaway: Repetition is the whole secret.

verses.devanagari:
नात्यश्नतस्तु योगोऽस्ति न चैकान्तमनश्नतः ।
न चाति स्वप्नशीलस्य जाग्रतो नैव चार्जुन
verses.iast:
nātyaśnatastu yogo'sti na caikāntamanaśnataḥ |
na cāti svapnaśīlasya jāgrato naiva cārjuna
verses.meaning: This path is not for one who eats too much or fasts too much — not for the oversleeper, not for the insomniac.
verses.takeaway: Extremes break the instrument.

verses.devanagari:
युक्ताहारविहारस्य  युक्तचेष्टस्य कर्मसु ।
युक्तस्वप्नावबोधस्य योगो भवति दुःखहा
verses.iast:
yuktāhāravihārasya  yuktaceṣṭasya karmasu |
yuktasvapnāvabodhasya yogo bhavati duḥkhahā
verses.meaning: Be moderate in food and play. Measured in work. Balanced in sleep and waking. Then discipline dissolves all suffering.
verses.takeaway: Moderation in all things, including moderation applied wisely.

verses.devanagari:
यदा विनियतं चित्तमात्मन्येवावतिष्ठते ।
निःस्पृहः सर्वकामेभ्यो युक्त इत्युच्यते तदा
verses.iast:
yadā viniyataṃ cittamātmanyevāvatiṣṭhate |
niḥspṛhaḥ sarvakāmebhyo yukta ityucyate tadā
verses.meaning: When the restrained mind settles steady on the self alone. Free of hunger for anything. Then one stands disciplined.
verses.takeaway: Want nothing, hold everything.

verses.devanagari:
यथा दीपो निवातस्थो नेङ्गते सोपमा स्मृता ।
योगिनो यतचित्तस्य युञ्जतो योगमात्मनः
verses.iast:
yathā dīpo nivātastho neṅgate sopamā smṛtā |
yogino yatacittasya yuñjato yogamātmanaḥ
verses.meaning: A lamp sheltered from wind never flickers. So is the disciplined mind of one absorbed in the self.
verses.takeaway: Find your windless room.

verses.devanagari:
यत्रोपरमते चित्तं निरुद्धं योगसेवया ।
यत्र चैवात्मनात्मानं पश्यन्नात्मनि तुष्यति
verses.iast:
yatroparamate cittaṃ niruddhaṃ yogasevayā |
yatra caivātmanātmānaṃ paśyannātmani tuṣyati
verses.meaning: Where the mind, checked by practice, grows still — where seeing the self by the self, one rejoices in the self —
verses.takeaway: Happiness that needs no object.

verses.devanagari:
सुखमात्यन्तिकं यत्तद् बुद्धिग्राह्यमतीन्द्रियम् ।
वेत्ति यत्र न चैवायं स्थितश्चलति तत्त्वतः
verses.iast:
sukhamātyantikaṃ yattad buddhigrāhyamatīndriyam |
vetti yatra na caivāyaṃ sthitaścalati tattvataḥ
verses.meaning: That endless joy lies beyond the senses. Grasped only by understanding. Holding it, one never wavers from truth.
verses.takeaway: The joy that doesn't depend on anything happening.

verses.devanagari:
यं लब्ध्वा चापरं लाभं मन्यते नाधिकं ततः ।
यस्मिन्स्थितो न दुःखेन गुरुणापि विचाल्यते
verses.iast:
yaṃ labdhvā cāparaṃ lābhaṃ manyate nādhikaṃ tataḥ |
yasminsthito na duḥkhena guruṇāpi vicālyate
verses.meaning: Gaining which, no greater gain seems possible. Rooted in which, even the heaviest grief cannot shake one.
verses.takeaway: Find the thing that relativizes everything else.

verses.devanagari:
तं विद्याद्‌दुःखसंयोगवियोगं योगसंज्ञितम् ।
स निश्चयेन योक्तव्यो योगोऽनिर्विण्णचेतसा
verses.iast:
taṃ vidyād‌duḥkhasaṃyogaviyogaṃ yogasaṃjñitam |
sa niścayena yoktavyo yogo'nirviṇṇacetasā
verses.meaning: Know that severance from pain-union as discipline. Practice it with resolve and an undaunted heart.
verses.takeaway: Discipline has a definition. Memorize it.

verses.devanagari:
संकल्पप्रभवान्कामांस्त्यक्त्वा सर्वानशेषतः ।
मनसैवेन्द्रियग्रामं विनियम्य समन्ततः
verses.iast:
saṃkalpaprabhavānkāmāṃstyaktvā sarvānaśeṣataḥ |
manasaivendriyagrāmaṃ viniyamya samantataḥ
verses.meaning: Drop every desire born of imagination, every one. Rein in the sense-herd with the mind on all sides.
verses.takeaway: Round up every stray want.

verses.devanagari:
शनैः शनैरुपरमेद्‌बुद्ध्या धृतिगृहीतया ।
आत्मसंस्थं मनः कृत्वा न किंचिदपि चिन्तयेत्
verses.iast:
śanaiḥ śanairuparamed‌buddhyā dhṛtigṛhītayā |
ātmasaṃsthaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā na kiṃcidapi cintayet
verses.meaning: Step by step, grow quiet — resolve firm, courage up. Fix the mind on the self and think of nothing else.
verses.takeaway: Slow is smooth, smooth is still.

verses.devanagari:
यतो यतो निश्चरति मनश्चञ्चलमस्थिरम् ।
ततस्ततो नियम्यैतदात्मन्येव वशं नयेत्
verses.iast:
yato yato niścarati manaścañcalamasthiram |
tatastato niyamyaitadātmanyeva vaśaṃ nayet
verses.meaning: Wherever the fickle, restless mind wanders off — pull it back, every time, and settle it on the self alone.
verses.takeaway: The rep is the return, not the stillness.

verses.devanagari:
प्रशान्तमनसं ह्येनं योगिनं सुखमुत्तमम् ।
उपैति शान्तरजसं ब्रह्मभूतमकल्मषम्
verses.iast:
praśāntamanasaṃ hyenaṃ yoginaṃ sukhamuttamam |
upaiti śāntarajasaṃ brahmabhūtamakalmaṣam
verses.meaning: Supreme joy comes to the practitioner. Mind fully calm. Passions cooled. Sins gone. One with ultimate reality.
verses.takeaway: Cool, clean, calm, one.

verses.devanagari:
युञ्जन्नेवं सदात्मानं योगी विगतकल्मषः ।
सुखेन ब्रह्मसंस्पर्शमत्यन्तं सुखमश्नुते
verses.iast:
yuñjannevaṃ sadātmānaṃ yogī vigatakalmaṣaḥ |
sukhena brahmasaṃsparśamatyantaṃ sukhamaśnute
verses.meaning: Thus always yoked, one shakes off wrongdoing. Supreme joy is touched with ease. Contact with the ultimate.
verses.takeaway: Effort becomes effortless. That is the whole arc.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वभूतस्थमात्मानं सर्वभूतानि चात्मनि ।
ईक्षते योगयुक्तात्मा सर्वत्र समदर्शनः
verses.iast:
sarvabhūtasthamātmānaṃ sarvabhūtāni cātmani |
īkṣate yogayuktātmā sarvatra samadarśanaḥ
verses.meaning: Seeing the self in all beings. And all beings in the self. Such a seer, steady in discipline, sees everywhere the same.
verses.takeaway: One sight, everywhere.

verses.devanagari:
यो मां पश्यति सर्वत्र सर्वं च मयि पश्यति ।
तस्याहं न प्रणश्यामि स च मे न प्रणश्यति
verses.iast:
yo māṃ paśyati sarvatra sarvaṃ ca mayi paśyati |
tasyāhaṃ na praṇaśyāmi sa ca me na praṇaśyati
verses.meaning: Whoever sees Me in everything. And everything in Me. I am never lost to such a one. Nor is such a one ever lost to Me.
verses.takeaway: Mutual never-lost-ness. Read that twice.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वभूतस्थितं यो मां भजत्येकत्वमास्थितः ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि स योगी मयि वर्तते
verses.iast:
sarvabhūtasthitaṃ yo māṃ bhajatyekatvamāsthitaḥ |
sarvathā vartamāno'pi sa yogī mayi vartate
verses.meaning: Whoever worships Me, dwelling in all beings. Knowing all is one. However such a one lives, one lives in Me.
verses.takeaway: Address is irrelevant. Residence is everything.

verses.devanagari:
आत्मौपम्येन सर्वत्र समं पश्यति योऽर्जुन ।
सुखं वा यदि वा दुःखं स योगी परमो मतः
verses.iast:
ātmaupamyena sarvatra samaṃ paśyati yo'rjuna |
sukhaṃ vā yadi vā duḥkhaṃ sa yogī paramo mataḥ
verses.meaning: Judge pleasure and pain in all beings by your own measure. That practitioner counts as highest.
verses.takeaway: Empathy as a spiritual rank.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
योऽयं योगस्त्वया प्रोक्तः साम्येन मधुसूदन ।
एतस्याहं न पश्यामि चञ्चलत्वात्स्थितिं स्थिराम्
verses.iast:
yo'yaṃ yogastvayā proktaḥ sāmyena madhusūdana |
etasyāhaṃ na paśyāmi cañcalatvātsthitiṃ sthirām
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: this discipline of evenness you teach. I see no stable ground in it. Because the mind is so restless, Krishna.
verses.takeaway: The student pushes back. Good. So should you.

verses.devanagari:
चञ्चलं हि मनः कृष्ण प्रमाथि बलवद्‌दृढम् ।
तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये वायोरिव सुदुष्करम्
verses.iast:
cañcalaṃ hi manaḥ kṛṣṇa pramāthi balavad‌dṛḍham |
tasyāhaṃ nigrahaṃ manye vāyoriva suduṣkaram
verses.meaning: The mind is fickle, turbulent, powerful, stubborn. Holding it, I think, is as hard as holding the wind.
verses.takeaway: Everyone's objection, stated perfectly.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
असंशयं महाबाहो मनो दुर्निग्रहं चलम् ।
अभ्यासेन तु कौन्तेय वैराग्येण च गृह्यते
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
asaṃśayaṃ mahābāho mano durnigrahaṃ calam |
abhyāsena tu kaunteya vairāgyeṇa ca gṛhyate
verses.meaning: Krishna said: no doubt, strong-armed one, the mind is hard to hold and fickle. But it can be held — by practice and detachment.
verses.takeaway: No denial. Just method.

verses.devanagari:
असंयतात्मना योगो दुष्प्राप इति मे मतिः ।
वश्यात्मना तु यतता शक्योऽवाप्तुमुपायतः
verses.iast:
asaṃyatātmanā yogo duṣprāpa iti me matiḥ |
vaśyātmanā tu yatatā śakyo'vāptumupāyataḥ
verses.meaning: Discipline is hard for the uncontrolled. But the self-controlled can reach it by the right means, striving properly.
verses.takeaway: Hard is not impossible. Method matters.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
अयतिः श्रद्धयोपेतो योगाच्चलितमानसः ।
अप्राप्य योगसंसिद्धिं कां गतिं कृष्ण गच्छति
verses.iast:
ayatiḥ śraddhayopeto yogāccalitamānasaḥ |
aprāpya yogasaṃsiddhiṃ kāṃ gatiṃ kṛṣṇa gacchati
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: one full of faith but uncontrolled. Mind wandering from discipline. Missing perfection. What path does such a one walk, Krishna?
verses.takeaway: What happens to the sincere failure? Asked with love.

verses.devanagari:
कच्चिन्नोभयविभ्रष्टश्छिन्नाभ्रमिव नश्यति ।
अप्रतिष्ठो महाबाहो विमूढो ब्रह्मणः पथि
verses.iast:
kaccinnobhayavibhraṣṭaśchinnābhramiva naśyati |
apratiṣṭho mahābāho vimūḍho brahmaṇaḥ pathi
verses.meaning: Fallen from both paths. Shattered like a broken cloud. Does such a one vanish, mighty-armed? Confused on the road to ultimate reality?
verses.takeaway: The anxious question behind every beginner.

verses.devanagari:
एतन्मे संशयं कृष्ण छेत्तुमर्हस्यशेषतः ।
त्वदन्यः संशयस्यास्य छेत्ता न ह्युपपद्यते
verses.iast:
etanme saṃśayaṃ kṛṣṇa chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ |
tvadanyaḥ saṃśayasyāsya chettā na hyupapadyate
verses.meaning: Please cut this doubt of mine completely, Krishna. No one but You can cut it.
verses.takeaway: Bring your hardest question to the highest source.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
पार्थ नैवेह नामुत्र विनाशस्तस्य विद्यते ।
न हि कल्याणकृत्कश्चिद्‌दुर्गतिं तात गच्छति
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
pārtha naiveha nāmutra vināśastasya vidyate |
na hi kalyāṇakṛtkaścid‌durgatiṃ tāta gacchati
verses.meaning: Krishna said: neither here nor hereafter does such a one perish. No one who does good ever meets a bad end, dear friend.
verses.takeaway: Goodness is never wasted. Even interrupted goodness.

verses.devanagari:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः ।
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते
verses.iast:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ |
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo'bhijāyate
verses.meaning: Fallen from discipline, one reaches the worlds of the good. Dwells there long years. Then is born into a pure, prosperous family.
verses.takeaway: Failure gets a good address and a second chance.

verses.devanagari:
अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम् ।
एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्
verses.iast:
athavā yogināmeva kule bhavati dhīmatām |
etaddhi durlabhataraṃ loke janma yadīdṛśam
verses.meaning: Or one is born into a family of wise practitioners. A birth like that is the hardest thing in this world to get.
verses.takeaway: Some second chances are rarer than first ones.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र तं बुद्धिसंयोगं लभते पौर्वदेहिकम् ।
यतते च ततो भूयः संसिद्धौ कुरुनन्दन
verses.iast:
tatra taṃ buddhisaṃyogaṃ labhate paurvadehikam |
yatate ca tato bhūyaḥ saṃsiddhau kurunandana
verses.meaning: There one regains the understanding of a former life. And strives again toward perfection.
verses.takeaway: Nothing learned is ever truly lost.

verses.devanagari:
पूर्वाभ्यासेन तेनैव ह्रियते ह्यवशोऽपि सः ।
जिज्ञासुरपि योगस्य शब्दब्रह्मातिवर्तते
verses.iast:
pūrvābhyāsena tenaiva hriyate hyavaśo'pi saḥ |
jijñāsurapi yogasya śabdabrahmātivartate
verses.meaning: Drawn on by former practice. Even unwilling, one rises above scriptural rules.
verses.takeaway: Momentum outlives memory.

verses.devanagari:
प्रयत्नाद्यतमानस्तु योगी संशुद्धकिल्बिषः ।
अनेकजन्मसंसिद्धस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.iast:
prayatnādyatamānastu yogī saṃśuddhakilbiṣaḥ |
anekajanmasaṃsiddhastato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: But the practitioner who strives hard. Cleansed of wrong. Perfected over many births. Reaches the highest goal.
verses.takeaway: Many births. Keep going.

verses.devanagari:
तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः ।
कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद्योगी भवार्जुन
verses.iast:
tapasvibhyo'dhiko yogī jñānibhyo'pi mato'dhikaḥ |
karmibhyaścādhiko yogī tasmādyogī bhavārjuna
verses.meaning: Higher than penance-doers, higher than scholars, higher even than ritualists is the practitioner. So become one, Arjuna.
verses.takeaway: The final ranking, stated without apology.

verses.devanagari:
योगिनामपि सर्वेषां मद्गतेनान्तरात्मना ।
श्रद्धावान् भजते यो मां स मे युक्ततमो मतः
verses.iast:
yogināmapi sarveṣāṃ madgatenāntarātmanā |
śraddhāvān bhajate yo māṃ sa me yuktatamo mataḥ
verses.meaning: And among all practitioners: the one who worships Me with faith. Inmost self merged in Me. That one I hold most devoted.
verses.takeaway: The chapter's last word: love wins.

verses.devanagari: असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु
verses.iast: asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
verses.meaning: Krishna said: hear how you can know Me fully, beyond all doubt. Fix your mind on Me. Rest in Me. Practice discipline.
verses.takeaway: The chapter's promise, stated up front.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञानं तेऽहं सविज्ञानमिदं वक्ष्याम्यशेषतः ।
यज्ज्ञात्वा नेह भूयोऽन्यज्ज्ञातव्यमवशिष्यते
verses.iast:
jñānaṃ te'haṃ savijñānamidaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ |
yajjñātvā neha bhūyo'nyajjñātavyamavaśiṣyate
verses.meaning: I will tell you the whole story. Both knowledge and lived experience. Once known, nothing more remains to be known.
verses.takeaway: Theory plus practice equals done.

verses.devanagari:
मनुष्याणां सहस्रेषु कश्चिद्यतति सिद्धये ।
यततामपि सिद्धानां कश्चिन्मां वेत्ति तत्त्वतः
verses.iast:
manuṣyāṇāṃ sahasreṣu kaścidyatati siddhaye |
yatatāmapi siddhānāṃ kaścinmāṃ vetti tattvataḥ
verses.meaning: Among thousands, hardly one strives for perfection. And among those who strive, hardly one knows Me as I truly am.
verses.takeaway: Rarity is not discouragement. It is direction.

verses.devanagari:
भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च ।
अहंकार इतीयं मे भिन्ना प्रकृतिरष्टधा
verses.iast:
bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca |
ahaṃkāra itīyaṃ me bhinnā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā
verses.meaning: Earth, water, fire, air, space. Mind, understanding, ego. These eight make up My lower nature.
verses.takeaway: The inventory of everything you can touch or think.

verses.devanagari:
अपरेयमितस्त्वन्यां प्रकृतिं विद्धि मे पराम् ।
जीवभूतां महाबाहो ययेदं धार्यते जगत्
verses.iast:
apareyamitastvanyāṃ prakṛtiṃ viddhi me parām |
jīvabhūtāṃ mahābāho yayedaṃ dhāryate jagat
verses.meaning: But beyond this lower nature sits My higher nature. It is alive, mighty-armed one. And it holds up the whole universe.
verses.takeaway: Matter is the instrument. Life is the player.

verses.devanagari:
एतद्योनीनि भूतानि सर्वाणीत्युपधारय ।
अहं कृत्स्नस्य जगतः प्रभवः प्रलयस्तथा
verses.iast:
etadyonīni bhūtāni sarvāṇītyupadhāraya |
ahaṃ kṛtsnasya jagataḥ prabhavaḥ pralayastathā
verses.meaning: Know that all beings spring from these two natures. I am the birth and the ending of the entire universe.
verses.takeaway: Every arrival and every departure passes through one door.

verses.devanagari:
मत्तः परतरं नान्यत्किंचिदस्ति धनंजय ।
मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव
verses.iast:
mattaḥ parataraṃ nānyatkiṃcidasti dhanaṃjaya |
mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
verses.meaning: Nothing stands higher than Me, Arjuna. All this hangs upon Me, like pearls strung on a thread.
verses.takeaway: One string. Many pearls.

verses.devanagari:
रसोऽहमप्सु कौन्तेय प्रभास्मि शशिसूर्ययोः ।
प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु
verses.iast:
raso'hamapsu kaunteya prabhāsmi śaśisūryayoḥ |
praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
verses.meaning: I am the taste in water. The light in sun and moon. The sacred syllable in the scriptures. Sound in space. Courage in human beings.
verses.takeaway: Find the divine in the nearest things first.

verses.devanagari:
पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ ।
जीवनं सर्वभूतेषु तपश्चास्मि तपस्विषु
verses.iast:
puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau |
jīvanaṃ sarvabhūteṣu tapaścāsmi tapasviṣu
verses.meaning: I am the sweet smell in earth. The glow in fire. The life in all beings. And the discipline in the disciplined.
verses.takeaway: The signature inside every sense.

verses.devanagari:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम् ।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्
verses.iast:
bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam |
buddhirbuddhimatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham
verses.meaning: Know Me as the timeless seed of all beings. I am the wisdom of the wise and the splendor of the splendid.
verses.takeaway: Every excellence has one address.

verses.devanagari:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम् ।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ
verses.iast:
balaṃ balavatāṃ cāhaṃ kāmarāgavivarjitam |
dharmāviruddho bhūteṣu kāmo'smi bharatarṣabha
verses.meaning: I am the strength of the strong, free of craving and passion. And I am right desire, where it honors duty.
verses.takeaway: Strength without hunger. Wanting without grasping.

verses.devanagari:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये ।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु ते मयि
verses.iast:
ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye |
matta eveti tānviddhi na tvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
verses.meaning: Calm, restless, or dark — every mood comes from Me. But I am not in them. They are in Me.
verses.takeaway: The ocean is not in the waves.

verses.devanagari:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत् ।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
tribhirguṇamayairbhāvairebhiḥ sarvamidaṃ jagat |
mohitaṃ nābhijānāti māmebhyaḥ paramavyayam
verses.meaning: Fooled by these three moods, the whole world fails to see Me. I stand beyond them, beyond decay.
verses.takeaway: The show hides the stage.

verses.devanagari:
दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया ।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते
verses.iast:
daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā |
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
verses.meaning: Hard to cross is this divine confusion of Mine. But whoever takes refuge in Me alone crosses beyond it.
verses.takeaway: The maze has one exit, clearly marked.

verses.devanagari:
न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः ।
माययापहृतज्ञाना आसुरं भावमाश्रिताः
verses.iast:
na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ |
māyayāpahṛtajñānā āsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ
verses.meaning: Wrongdoers never reach Me. Neither the confused, nor the cruel, nor minds stolen by illusion, nor those who choose the demonic path.
verses.takeaway: Four locks on one door. All self-fitted.

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्विधा भजन्ते मां जनाः सुकृतिनोऽर्जुन ।
आर्तो जिज्ञासुरर्थार्थी ज्ञानी च भरतर्षभ
verses.iast:
caturvidhā bhajante māṃ janāḥ sukṛtino'rjuna |
ārto jijñāsurarthārthī jñānī ca bharatarṣabha
verses.meaning: Four kinds of good people turn to Me. The suffering. The curious. The ambitious. And the wise.
verses.takeaway: Every motive is a valid entrance.

verses.devanagari:
तेषां ज्ञानी नित्ययुक्त एकभक्तिर्विशिष्यते ।
प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः
verses.iast:
teṣāṃ jñānī nityayukta ekabhaktirviśiṣyate |
priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
verses.meaning: Highest among them stands the wise one. Always steady. Devoted to the One alone. I am dear beyond measure to such a one. And such a one is dear to Me.
verses.takeaway: Mutual dear-ness. The whole path in one exchange.

verses.devanagari:
उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम् ।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम्
verses.iast:
udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam |
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: All four are noble. But the wise one, I count as My very self. Such a one rests in Me, the goal beyond which nothing stands.
verses.takeaway: Good, better, and identical.

verses.devanagari:
बहूनां जन्मनामन्ते ज्ञानवान्मां प्रपद्यते ।
वासुदेवः सर्वमिति स महात्मा सुदुर्लभः
verses.iast:
bahūnāṃ janmanāmante jñānavānmāṃ prapadyate |
vāsudevaḥ sarvamiti sa mahātmā sudurlabhaḥ
verses.meaning: After many births, the wise one reaches Me, seeing the divine in everything. Such a great soul is the hardest thing to find.
verses.takeaway: The rarest sight in the world, described plainly.

verses.devanagari:
कामैस्तैस्तैर्हृतज्ञानाः प्रपद्यन्तेऽन्यदेवताः ।
तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया
verses.iast:
kāmaistaistairhṛtajñānāḥ prapadyante'nyadevatāḥ |
taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
verses.meaning: But those robbed of judgment by cravings chase lesser gods. Following rites that suit their nature.
verses.takeaway: Want small, worship small.

verses.devanagari:
यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति ।
तस्य तस्याचलां श्रद्धां तामेव विदधाम्यहम्
verses.iast:
yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati |
tasya tasyācalāṃ śraddhāṃ tāmeva vidadhāmyaham
verses.meaning: Whatever form any worshipper loves with faith — I make that very faith steady.
verses.takeaway: Sincerity is honored, whatever its address.

verses.devanagari:
स तया श्रद्धया युक्तस्तस्याराधनमीहते ।
लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान्हि तान्
verses.iast:
sa tayā śraddhayā yuktastasyārādhanamīhate |
labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitānhi tān
verses.meaning: Armed with that faith, one prays and wins one's wishes. Though every gift truly comes from Me.
verses.takeaway: All prayers are answered from one counter.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तवत्तु फलं तेषां तद्भवत्यल्पमेधसाम् ।
देवान्देवयजो यान्ति मद्भक्ता यान्ति मामपि
verses.iast:
antavattu phalaṃ teṣāṃ tadbhavatyalpamedhasām |
devāndevayajo yānti madbhaktā yānti māmapi
verses.meaning: But small minds win small, passing fruits. Worshippers of lesser gods join their gods. My worshippers reach Me.
verses.takeaway: Choose the destination by choosing the devotion.

verses.devanagari:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः ।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
avyaktaṃ vyaktimāpannaṃ manyante māmabuddhayaḥ |
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mamāvyayamanuttamam
verses.meaning: The unwise think Me, the unseen, to have become merely seen. They miss My highest nature — changeless, beyond compare.
verses.takeaway: Do not shrink the infinite to fit the frame.

verses.devanagari:
नाहं प्रकाशः सर्वस्य योगमायासमावृतः ।
मूढोऽयं नाभिजानाति लोको मामजमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
nāhaṃ prakāśaḥ sarvasya yogamāyāsamāvṛtaḥ |
mūḍho'yaṃ nābhijānāti loko māmajamavyayam
verses.meaning: Veiled by My mystic power, I am not open to all. This confused world does not know Me — unborn, beyond decay.
verses.takeaway: Hidden in plain sight, by design.

verses.devanagari:
वेदाहं समतीतानि वर्तमानानि चार्जुन ।
भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन
verses.iast:
vedāhaṃ samatītāni vartamānāni cārjuna |
bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
verses.meaning: I know all beings — past, present, and to come. But no one knows Me.
verses.takeaway: Total knowledge flows one way.

verses.devanagari:
इच्छाद्वेषसमुत्थेन द्वन्द्वमोहेन भारत ।
सर्वभूतानि संमोहं सर्गे यान्ति परन्तप
verses.iast:
icchādveṣasamutthena dvandvamohena bhārata |
sarvabhūtāni saṃmohaṃ sarge yānti parantapa
verses.meaning: Every creature enters this world confused. Blinded by likes and dislikes, by the war of opposites, Arjuna.
verses.takeaway: Birth comes with built-in fog.

verses.devanagari:
येषां त्वन्तगतं पापं जनानां पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।
ते द्वन्द्वमोहनिर्मुक्ता भजन्ते मां दृढव्रताः
verses.iast:
yeṣāṃ tvantagataṃ pāpaṃ janānāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām |
te dvandvamohanirmuktā bhajante māṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ
verses.meaning: But people of good deeds, whose wrongs have ended, worship Me with firm resolve. Free of the fog of opposites.
verses.takeaway: Character clears the lens.

verses.devanagari:
जरामरणमोक्षाय मामाश्रित्य यतन्ति ये ।
ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम्
verses.iast:
jarāmaraṇamokṣāya māmāśritya yatanti ye |
te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
verses.meaning: Those who strive in Me for freedom from old age and death come to know the ultimate. The inner self. And all action.
verses.takeaway: Three knowledges in one striving.

verses.devanagari:
साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः ।
प्रयाणकालेऽपि च मां ते विदुर्युक्तचेतसः
verses.iast:
sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ |
prayāṇakāle'pi ca māṃ te viduryuktacetasaḥ
verses.meaning: Those who know Me as Lord of beings, of gods, and of sacrifice. Steady in mind. They know Me even at the hour of death.
verses.takeaway: The final exam is passed long before it arrives.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
किं तद्ब्रह्म किमध्यात्मं किं कर्म पुरुषोत्तम ।
अधिभूतं च किं प्रोक्तमधिदैवं किमुच्यते
verses.iast:
kiṃ tadbrahma kimadhyātmaṃ kiṃ karma puruṣottama |
adhibhūtaṃ ca kiṃ proktamadhidaivaṃ kimucyate
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: what is the ultimate? What is the inner self? What is action? Tell me plainly, best of beings.
verses.takeaway: Eight questions. The chapter answers every one.

verses.devanagari:
अधियज्ञः कथं कोऽत्र देहेऽस्मिन्मधुसूदन ।
प्रयाणकाले च कथं ज्ञेयोऽसि नियतात्मभिः
verses.iast:
adhiyajñaḥ kathaṃ ko'tra dehe'sminmadhusūdana |
prayāṇakāle ca kathaṃ jñeyo'si niyatātmabhiḥ
verses.meaning: And what is the Lord of beings? The Lord of gods? How are You sacrifice itself, here in a body? And how do the self-controlled know You at the hour of death?
verses.takeaway: The questions continue. Definitions first, practice after.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
अक्षरं ब्रह्म परमं स्वभावोऽध्यात्ममुच्यते ।
भूतभावोद्भवकरो विसर्गः कर्मसंज्ञितः
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
akṣaraṃ brahma paramaṃ svabhāvo'dhyātmamucyate |
bhūtabhāvodbhavakaro visargaḥ karmasaṃjñitaḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: the ultimate is supreme and indestructible. Its dwelling in each person is the inner self. And action means the offering that creates and feeds all things.
verses.takeaway: Three definitions, no mystique.

verses.devanagari:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर
verses.iast:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam |
adhiyajño'hamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara
verses.meaning: The Lord of beings is all that perishes. The Lord of gods is the primal person. And the Lord of sacrifice is Myself, here in this body.
verses.takeaway: The remaining answers, equally direct.

verses.devanagari:
अन्तकाले च मामेव स्मरन्मुक्त्वा कलेवरम् ।
यः प्रयाति स मद्भावं याति नास्त्यत्र संशयः
verses.iast:
antakāle ca māmeva smaranmuktvā kalevaram |
yaḥ prayāti sa madbhāvaṃ yāti nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ
verses.meaning: Whoever leaves the body remembering Me at the last moment enters My being. Of this there is no doubt.
verses.takeaway: The final thought is the final address.

verses.devanagari:
यं यं वापि स्मरन्भावं त्यजत्यन्ते कलेवरम् ।
तं तमेवैति कौन्तेय सदा तद्भावभावितः
verses.iast:
yaṃ yaṃ vāpi smaranbhāvaṃ tyajatyante kalevaram |
taṃ tamevaiti kaunteya sadā tadbhāvabhāvitaḥ
verses.meaning: Whatever form one remembers at the end, to that one goes — shaped by a lifetime of dwelling on it.
verses.takeaway: You become what you rehearse.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु मामनुस्मर युध्य च ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्मामेवैष्यस्यसंशयम्
verses.iast:
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu māmanusmara yudhya ca |
mayyarpitamanobuddhirmāmevaiṣyasyasaṃśayam
verses.meaning: So remember Me always — and fight. Mind and understanding fixed on Me, you will surely reach Me.
verses.takeaway: Remembrance and duty, at the same time.

verses.devanagari:
अभ्यासयोगयुक्तेन चेतसा नान्यगामिना ।
परमं पुरुषं दिव्यं याति पार्थानुचिन्तयन्
verses.iast:
abhyāsayogayuktena cetasā nānyagāminā |
paramaṃ puruṣaṃ divyaṃ yāti pārthānucintayan
verses.meaning: Mind unwavering. Trained by steady practice. One goes to the divine supreme Person.
verses.takeaway: Steadiness is a trained muscle.

verses.devanagari:
कविं पुराणमनुशासितारमणोरणीयांसमनुस्मरेद्यः ।
सर्वस्य धातारमचिन्त्यरूपमादित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात्
verses.iast:
kaviṃ purāṇamanuśāsitāramaṇoraṇīyāṃsamanusmaredyaḥ |
sarvasya dhātāramacintyarūpamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt
verses.meaning: Meditate on the ancient Seer. The ruler. Subtler than the atom. Sustainer of all. Form beyond thought. Bright as the sun. Beyond all darkness.
verses.takeaway: The portrait to hold in mind.

verses.devanagari:
प्रयाणकाले मनसाचलेन
भक्त्या युक्तो योगबलेन चैव ।
भ्रुवोर्मध्ये प्राणमावेश्य सम्यक्
स तं परं पुरुषमुपैति दिव्यम्
verses.iast:
prayāṇakāle manasācalena
bhaktyā yukto yogabalena caiva |
bhruvormadhye prāṇamāveśya samyak
sa taṃ paraṃ puruṣamupaiti divyam
verses.meaning: At the hour of departure, steady in devotion. Breath gathered between the brows. One attains that divine Being.
verses.takeaway: The practice for the last moment, rehearsed beforehand.

verses.devanagari:
यदक्षरं वेदविदो वदन्ति
विशन्ति यद्यतयो वीतरागाः ।
यदिच्छन्तो ब्रह्मचर्यं चरन्ति
तत्ते पदं संग्रहेण प्रवक्ष्ये
verses.iast:
yadakṣaraṃ vedavido vadanti
viśanti yadyatayo vītarāgāḥ |
yadicchanto brahmacaryaṃ caranti
tatte padaṃ saṃgraheṇa pravakṣye
verses.meaning: The wise call that goal indestructible. Free of desire, the ascetics enter it. Seekers of it live the celibate path.
verses.takeaway: Three traditions point at one door.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वद्वाराणि संयम्य मनो हृदि निरुध्य च ।
मूर्ध्न्याधायात्मनः प्राणमास्थितो योगधारणाम्
verses.iast:
sarvadvārāṇi saṃyamya mano hṛdi nirudhya ca |
mūrdhnyādhāyātmanaḥ prāṇamāsthito yogadhāraṇām
verses.meaning: Close every gate of sense. Lock the mind in the heart. Hold the breath steady. Rest in unbroken meditation.
verses.takeaway: The full closing sequence.

verses.devanagari:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन् ।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्
verses.iast:
omityekākṣaraṃ brahma vyāharanmāmanusmaran |
yaḥ prayāti tyajandehaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: Chant the single syllable Om — the eternal ultimate — meditating on Me. Such a one reaches the highest goal.
verses.takeaway: One syllable. One thought. One destination.

verses.devanagari:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः ।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः
verses.iast:
ananyacetāḥ satataṃ yo māṃ smarati nityaśaḥ |
tasyāhaṃ sulabhaḥ pārtha nityayuktasya yoginaḥ
verses.meaning: To one always yoked, meditating on Me. Mind undivided. I am easy to reach.
verses.takeaway: Constancy makes the infinite accessible.

verses.devanagari:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम् ।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं परमां गताः
verses.iast:
māmupetya punarjanma duḥkhālayamaśāśvatam |
nāpnuvanti mahātmānaḥ saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatāḥ
verses.meaning: Great souls who reach Me never return to this passing life — this house of sorrow.
verses.takeaway: Graduation means no repeat term.

verses.devanagari:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन ।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते
verses.iast:
ābrahmabhuvanāllokāḥ punarāvartino'rjuna |
māmupetya tu kaunteya punarjanma na vidyate
verses.meaning: All worlds cycle back — even the highest heaven. But reaching Me, there is no rebirth.
verses.takeaway: Every address except one is temporary.

verses.devanagari:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः ।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः
verses.iast:
sahasrayugaparyantamaharyadbrahmaṇo viduḥ |
rātriṃ yugasahasrāntāṃ te'horātravido janāḥ
verses.meaning: Those who know a day of Brahma lasts a thousand ages — and the night as long — truly know day and night.
verses.takeaway: Cosmic time, stated as fact.

verses.devanagari:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे ।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसंज्ञके
verses.iast:
avyaktādvyaktayaḥ sarvāḥ prabhavantyaharāgame |
rātryāgame pralīyante tatraivāvyaktasaṃjñake
verses.meaning: At daybreak, all visible things emerge from the unseen. At nightfall, they dissolve back into it.
verses.takeaway: The universe breathes in and out.

verses.devanagari:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते ।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे
verses.iast:
bhūtagrāmaḥ sa evāyaṃ bhūtvā bhūtvā pralīyate |
rātryāgame'vaśaḥ pārtha prabhavatyaharāgame
verses.meaning: Again and again this host of beings is born with the day. And helplessly dissolved with the night.
verses.takeaway: The subjunctive mood of existence.

verses.devanagari:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः ।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति
verses.iast:
parastasmāttu bhāvo'nyo'vyakto'vyaktātsanātanaḥ |
yaḥ sa sarveṣu bhūteṣu naśyatsu na vinaśyati
verses.meaning: But beyond that unseen stands another — eternal, unperceived. Never destroyed when all is destroyed.
verses.takeaway: Behind the cycle, something that never cycles.

verses.devanagari:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम् ।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
verses.iast:
avyakto'kṣara ityuktastamāhuḥ paramāṃ gatim |
yaṃ prāpya na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
verses.meaning: They call it the indestructible, the highest goal. Reaching it, none return. That is My supreme home.
verses.takeaway: The address that ends all addresses.

verses.devanagari:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्या लभ्यस्त्वनन्यया ।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्
verses.iast:
puruṣaḥ sa paraḥ pārtha bhaktyā labhyastvananyayā |
yasyāntaḥsthāni bhūtāni yena sarvamidaṃ tatam
verses.meaning: That supreme Person — in whom all beings dwell, who fills all this — is reached by love that wanders nowhere else.
verses.takeaway: Single-pointed love as a vehicle.

verses.devanagari:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः ।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्यामि भरतर्षभ
verses.iast:
yatra kāle tvanāvṛttimāvṛttiṃ caiva yoginaḥ |
prayātā yānti taṃ kālaṃ vakṣyāmi bharatarṣabha
verses.meaning: Now hear the parting times. By one road, the departed never return. By the other, they come back.
verses.takeaway: Two exits. Know them before you need them.

verses.devanagari:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम् ।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म ब्रह्मविदो जनाः
verses.iast:
agnirjyotirahaḥ śuklaḥ ṣaṇmāsā uttarāyaṇam |
tatra prayātā gacchanti brahma brahmavido janāḥ
verses.meaning: Fire, flame, daylight. The bright fortnight. The six months of the northern sun. Going forth in these, knowers of the ultimate reach the ultimate.
verses.takeaway: The road of light, itemized.

verses.devanagari:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम् ।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते
verses.iast:
dhūmo rātristathā kṛṣṇaḥ ṣaṇmāsā dakṣiṇāyanam |
tatra cāndramasaṃ jyotiryogī prāpya nivartate
verses.meaning: Smoke, night, the dark fortnight. The six months of the southern sun. The traveler goes to the moonlit world — and returns.
verses.takeaway: The road of smoke, itemized.

verses.devanagari:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते ।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः
verses.iast:
śuklakṛṣṇe gatī hyete jagataḥ śāśvate mate |
ekayā yātyanāvṛttimanyayāvartate punaḥ
verses.meaning: Bright and dark — these two roads run forever. By one, no return. By the other, return.
verses.takeaway: The whole map in two lines.

verses.devanagari:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन ।
तस्मात्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगयुक्तो भवार्जुन
verses.iast:
naite sṛtī pārtha jānanyogī muhyati kaścana |
tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu yogayukto bhavārjuna
verses.meaning: Knowing both roads, no practitioner is confused. So stand in discipline at all times, Arjuna.
verses.takeaway: A map studied is a traveler unlost.

verses.devanagari:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव
दानेषु यत् पुण्यफलं प्रदिष्टम् ।
अत्येति तत्सर्वमिदं विदित्वा
योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यम्
verses.iast:
vedeṣu yajñeṣu tapaḥsu caiva
dāneṣu yat puṇyaphalaṃ pradiṣṭam |
atyeti tatsarvamidaṃ viditvā
yogī paraṃ sthānamupaiti cādyam
verses.meaning: Knowing all this, one gathers every sacred reward. Scriptures and sacrifices. Disciplines and gifts. Then reaches the highest seat.
verses.takeaway: The chapter's closing audit: everything, plus the goal.

verses.devanagari: ज्ञानं विज्ञानसहितं यज्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्
verses.iast: jñānaṃ vijñānasahitaṃ yajjñātvā mokṣyase'śubhāt
verses.meaning: Krishna said: to you who never carp, I will speak the deepest secret. Knowledge married to experience. Knowing it, you escape all evil.
verses.takeaway: The king of secrets, for an open mind.

verses.devanagari:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम् ।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसुखं कर्तुमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
rājavidyā rājaguhyaṃ pavitramidamuttamam |
pratyakṣāvagamaṃ dharmyaṃ susukhaṃ kartumavyayam
verses.meaning: It is the king of sciences, the king of mysteries. It purifies. It lasts forever. It asks nothing against duty. It is seen directly and done with ease.
verses.takeaway: Six praises. Memorize the weight of what follows.

verses.devanagari:
अश्रद्दधानाः पुरुषा धर्मस्यास्य परन्तप ।
अप्राप्य मां निवर्तन्ते मृत्युसंसारवर्त्मनि
verses.iast:
aśraddadhānāḥ puruṣā dharmasyāsya parantapa |
aprāpya māṃ nivartante mṛtyusaṃsāravartmani
verses.meaning: Whoever lacks faith in this truth never reaches Me. Such people sink back into the mortal round.
verses.takeaway: Faith is the ticket. Doubt is the undertow.

verses.devanagari:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना ।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि न चाहं तेष्ववस्थितः
verses.iast:
mayā tatamidaṃ sarvaṃ jagadavyaktamūrtinā |
matsthāni sarvabhūtāni na cāhaṃ teṣvavasthitaḥ
verses.meaning: I fill this whole universe in unseen form. All beings live in Me. But I do not live in them.
verses.takeaway: Contained by none, containing all.

verses.devanagari:
न च मत्स्थानि भूतानि पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम् ।
भूतभृन्न च भूतस्थो ममात्मा भूतभावनः
verses.iast:
na ca matsthāni bhūtāni paśya me yogamaiśvaram |
bhūtabhṛnna ca bhūtastho mamātmā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
verses.meaning: And yet — beings do not live in Me either. See the mystery of My power. I uphold all beings and make all beings. Yet My self rests in none of them.
verses.takeaway: Both true at once. Sit with that.

verses.devanagari:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान् ।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय
verses.iast:
yathākāśasthito nityaṃ vāyuḥ sarvatrago mahān |
tathā sarvāṇi bhūtāni matsthānītyupadhāraya
verses.meaning: As the mighty wind roams everywhere within space — yet space holds it lightly — so all beings rest in Me.
verses.takeaway: The sky is never burdened by weather.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम् ।
कल्पक्षये पुनस्तानि कल्पादौ विसृजाम्यहम्
verses.iast:
sarvabhūtāni kaunteya prakṛtiṃ yānti māmikām |
kalpakṣaye punastāni kalpādau visṛjāmyaham
verses.meaning: When an age ends, all beings fold back into My nature. When the next begins, I pour them forth again.
verses.takeaway: The cosmos breathes. I am the lungs.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः ।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्
verses.iast:
prakṛtiṃ svāmavaṣṭabhya visṛjāmi punaḥ punaḥ |
bhūtagrāmamimaṃ kṛtsnamavaśaṃ prakṛtervaśāt
verses.meaning: Guiding My own nature, I create this whole gathering again and again. Helpless before nature's force, they come.
verses.takeaway: The potter's wheel never stops. Neither does the Potter.

verses.devanagari:
न च मां तानि कर्माणि निबध्नन्ति धनंजय ।
उदासीनवदासीनमसक्तं तेषु कर्मसु
verses.iast:
na ca māṃ tāni karmāṇi nibadhnanti dhanaṃjaya |
udāsīnavadāsīnamasaktaṃ teṣu karmasu
verses.meaning: But these acts never bind Me. I sit apart, unconcerned, unattached to the doing.
verses.takeaway: The busiest hands in the universe, the freest heart.

verses.devanagari:
मयाध्यक्षेण प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम् ।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगद्विपरिवर्तते
verses.iast:
mayādhyakṣeṇa prakṛtiḥ sūyate sacarācaram |
hetunānena kaunteya jagadviparivartate
verses.meaning: Through Me as witness, nature births everything that moves or stands still. And so the universe turns.
verses.takeaway: One witness. Endless motion.

verses.devanagari:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम् ।
परं भावमजानन्तो मम भूतमहेश्वरम्
verses.iast:
avajānanti māṃ mūḍhā mānuṣīṃ tanumāśritam |
paraṃ bhāvamajānanto mama bhūtamaheśvaram
verses.meaning: Fools scorn Me in human form. Blind to My highest nature as great Lord of all beings.
verses.takeaway: The costume hides the King — for those who only see costumes.

verses.devanagari:
मोघाशा मोघकर्माणो मोघज्ञाना विचेतसः ।
राक्षसीमासुरीं चैव प्रकृतिं मोहिनीं श्रिताः
verses.iast:
moghāśā moghakarmāṇo moghajñānā vicetasaḥ |
rākṣasīmāsurīṃ caiva prakṛtiṃ mohinīṃ śritāḥ
verses.meaning: Vain their hopes, vain their acts, vain their knowledge. Minds unhinged, they slide toward the demonic way.
verses.takeaway: Emptiness compounds. Choose the other direction.

verses.devanagari:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीं प्रकृतिमाश्रिताः ।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
mahātmānastu māṃ pārtha daivīṃ prakṛtimāśritāḥ |
bhajantyananyamanaso jñātvā bhūtādimavyayam
verses.meaning: But great souls take refuge in the divine nature. Knowing Me as the endless source of all beings, they worship with undivided minds.
verses.takeaway: Two natures on offer. Pick the divine one.

verses.devanagari:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः ।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते
verses.iast:
satataṃ kīrtayanto māṃ yatantaśca dṛḍhavratāḥ |
namasyantaśca māṃ bhaktyā nityayuktā upāsate
verses.meaning: They praise Me without ceasing. They strive, firm in vows. They bow in reverence. Always yoked, they worship.
verses.takeaway: Devotion as a daily practice, not a mood.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते ।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.iast:
jñānayajñena cāpyanye yajanto māmupāsate |
ekatvena pṛthaktvena bahudhā viśvatomukham
verses.meaning: Others worship through the sacrifice of knowledge. Seeing Me as one, as separate, as all-pervading in countless forms.
verses.takeaway: Philosophy itself can be an offering.

verses.devanagari:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम् ।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्
verses.iast:
ahaṃ kraturahaṃ yajñaḥ svadhāhamahamauṣadham |
mantro'hamahamevājyamahamagnirahaṃ hutam
verses.meaning: I am the ritual and the prayer. The offering to ancestors and the healing herb. The hymn, the butter, the fire, the gift.
verses.takeaway: Every item on the altar is the same Person.

verses.devanagari:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः ।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोंकार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च
verses.iast:
pitāhamasya jagato mātā dhātā pitāmahaḥ |
vedyaṃ pavitramoṃkāra ṛksāma yajureva ca
verses.meaning: I am father, mother, maker, grandsire of this universe. The thing to know. The purifier. The syllable Om. The three scriptures. The goal, keeper, Lord, witness.
verses.takeaway: The longest 'I am' list so far. Read it slowly.

verses.devanagari:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः साक्षी निवासः शरणं सुहृत् ।
प्रभवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
gatirbhartā prabhuḥ sākṣī nivāsaḥ śaraṇaṃ suhṛt |
prabhavaḥ pralayaḥ sthānaṃ nidhānaṃ bījamavyayam
verses.meaning: I send the heat and hold the rains. I am death and deathlessness both. Being and non-being alike, Arjuna.
verses.takeaway: Opposites are My two hands.

verses.devanagari:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च ।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन
verses.iast:
tapāmyahamahaṃ varṣaṃ nigṛhṇāmyutsṛjāmi ca |
amṛtaṃ caiva mṛtyuśca sadasaccāhamarjuna
verses.meaning: Scholars of the three scriptures drink the sacred draught, sins washed clean. They sacrifice, asking heaven — and win the shining world of the gods.
verses.takeaway: Virtue earns its wage. In full.

verses.devanagari:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पूतपापा
यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते ।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोक-
मश्नन्ति दिव्यान्दिवि देवभोगान्
verses.iast:
traividyā māṃ somapāḥ pūtapāpā
yajñairiṣṭvā svargatiṃ prārthayante |
te puṇyamāsādya surendraloka-
maśnanti divyāndivi devabhogān
verses.meaning: But when the joy runs out and merit is spent, they fall back into the mortal world.
verses.takeaway: Every wage gets spent. Heaven included.

verses.devanagari:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं
क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति ।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना
गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते
verses.iast:
te taṃ bhuktvā svargalokaṃ viśālaṃ
kṣīṇe puṇye martyalokaṃ viśanti |
evaṃ trayīdharmamanuprapannā
gatāgataṃ kāmakāmā labhante
verses.meaning: Chasers of desires, followers of rites — their fruit is going and coming, coming and going.
verses.takeaway: The commuter's reward: more commuting.

verses.devanagari:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते ।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्
verses.iast:
ananyāścintayanto māṃ ye janāḥ paryupāsate |
teṣāṃ nityābhiyuktānāṃ yogakṣemaṃ vahāmyaham
verses.meaning: But those who worship Me alone. Meditating on nothing else, always yoked. I secure what they have and grant what they lack.
verses.takeaway: The divine insurance policy, stated plainly.

verses.devanagari:
येऽप्यन्यदेवताभक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्
verses.iast:
ye'pyanyadevatābhaktā yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ |
te'pi māmeva kaunteya yajantyavidhipūrvakam
verses.meaning: Even devotees of other gods, worshipping with faith, truly worship Me. Only by the wrong road.
verses.takeaway: All prayers arrive. Some take detours.

verses.devanagari:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च ।
न तु मामभिजानन्ति तत्त्वेनातश्च्यवन्ति ते
verses.iast:
ahaṃ hi sarvayajñānāṃ bhoktā ca prabhureva ca |
na tu māmabhijānanti tattvenātaścyavanti te
verses.meaning: For I receive and rule every sacrifice. But they do not know Me truly — so they fall back.
verses.takeaway: The host of every feast, mistaken for a guest.

verses.devanagari:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितॄन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः ।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्
verses.iast:
yānti devavratā devānpitṝnyānti pitṛvratāḥ |
bhūtāni yānti bhūtejyā yānti madyājino'pi mām
verses.meaning: God-worshippers reach the gods. Ancestor-worshippers reach the ancestors. Ghost-worshippers reach the ghosts. My worshippers reach Me.
verses.takeaway: The destination matches the devotion. Exactly.

verses.devanagari:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति ।
तदहं भक्त्युपहृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः
verses.iast:
patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ yo me bhaktyā prayacchati |
tadahaṃ bhaktyupahṛtamaśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ
verses.meaning: Leaf, flower, fruit, water — whatever love offers, I accept from a pure heart.
verses.takeaway: The smallest gift counts, if love wraps it.

verses.devanagari:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत् ।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्
verses.iast:
yatkaroṣi yadaśnāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat |
yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam
verses.meaning: Whatever you do, eat, sacrifice, give, or suffer — lay it all before Me.
verses.takeaway: Total offering. No exceptions column.

verses.devanagari:
शुभाशुभफलैरेवं मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धनैः ।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि
verses.iast:
śubhāśubhaphalairevaṃ mokṣyase karmabandhanaiḥ |
saṃnyāsayogayuktātmā vimukto māmupaiṣyasi
verses.meaning: Then you slip free of the chains of action, fair or foul. Yoked in devotion and renunciation, you reach Me.
verses.takeaway: Freedom is an offering laid correctly.

verses.devanagari:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः ।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते तेषु चाप्यहम्
verses.iast:
samo'haṃ sarvabhūteṣu na me dveṣyo'sti na priyaḥ |
ye bhajanti tu māṃ bhaktyā mayi te teṣu cāpyaham
verses.meaning: I am the same to all beings. None hateful, none dear. But lovers who dwell in Me — I dwell in them too.
verses.takeaway: Impartial to all. Intimate with lovers.

verses.devanagari:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक् ।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः
verses.iast:
api cetsudurācāro bhajate māmananyabhāk |
sādhureva sa mantavyaḥ samyagvyavasito hi saḥ
verses.meaning: Even a lifelong wrongdoer who turns to Me alone counts as good. Such resolve sets one straight.
verses.takeaway: No past disqualifies a present turning.

verses.devanagari:
क्षिप्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति ।
कौन्तेय प्रति जानीहि न मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति
verses.iast:
kṣipraṃ bhavati dharmātmā śaśvacchāntiṃ nigacchati |
kaunteya prati jānīhi na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati
verses.meaning: Such a one soon grows righteous and finds lasting peace. Proclaim it: My devotee never perishes.
verses.takeaway: The guarantee, in writing.

verses.devanagari:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः ।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्
verses.iast:
māṃ hi pārtha vyapāśritya ye'pi syuḥ pāpayonayaḥ |
striyo vaiśyāstathā śūdrāste'pi yānti parāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: Even the lowborn, women, merchants, laborers — all who take refuge reach the highest goal.
verses.takeaway: The gate has no caste, no gender, no lock.

verses.devanagari:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा ।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्
verses.iast:
kiṃ punarbrāhmaṇāḥ puṇyā bhaktā rājarṣayastathā |
anityamasukhaṃ lokamimaṃ prāpya bhajasva mām
verses.meaning: How much more, then, holy priests and royal sages devoted to Me? Landed in this fleeting, painful world — worship Me.
verses.takeaway: If the lowest reach, what excuse has the highest?

verses.devanagari:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि युक्त्वैवमात्मानं मत्परायणः
verses.iast:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru |
māmevaiṣyasi yuktvaivamātmānaṃ matparāyaṇaḥ
verses.meaning: Fix your mind on Me. Love Me. Serve Me. Bow to Me. Make Me your highest goal, your deepest practice — and you will surely reach Me.
verses.takeaway: The whole Gita in four imperatives.

verses.devanagari: यत्तेऽहं प्रीयमाणाय वक्ष्यामि हितकाम्यया
verses.iast: yatte'haṃ prīyamāṇāya vakṣyāmi hitakāmyayā
verses.meaning: Krishna said: hear once more My finest words. I speak them for your good, because you delight in them.
verses.takeaway: Flattery-free preamble. The list is the point.

verses.devanagari:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः ।
अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः
verses.iast:
na me viduḥ suragaṇāḥ prabhavaṃ na maharṣayaḥ |
ahamādirhi devānāṃ maharṣīṇāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ
verses.meaning: Neither gods nor great sages know My origin. For I am in every way the source of gods and sages alike.
verses.takeaway: The maker precedes the made. Including the gods.

verses.devanagari:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम् ।
असंमूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते
verses.iast:
yo māmajamanādiṃ ca vetti lokamaheśvaram |
asaṃmūḍhaḥ sa martyeṣu sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate
verses.meaning: Whoever knows Me as unborn. Beginningless. Great Lord of the world. Undeluded, such a mortal is freed from all wrong.
verses.takeaway: Three recognitions. One liberation.

verses.devanagari:
बुद्धिर्ज्ञानमसंमोहः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः ।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च
verses.iast:
buddhirjñānamasaṃmohaḥ kṣamā satyaṃ damaḥ śamaḥ |
sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ bhavo'bhāvo bhayaṃ cābhayameva ca
verses.meaning: Reason, wisdom, clarity, patience, truth, restraint, calm. Joy, sorrow, birth, death, fear, courage.
verses.takeaway: The full human weather report, in one verse.

verses.devanagari:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः ।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः
verses.iast:
ahiṃsā samatā tuṣṭistapo dānaṃ yaśo'yaśaḥ |
bhavanti bhāvā bhūtānāṃ matta eva pṛthagvidhāḥ
verses.meaning: Non-harm, balance, contentment, discipline, generosity, fame, disgrace. All these varied moods of beings come from Me alone.
verses.takeaway: Even disgrace has a single source.

verses.devanagari:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा ।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः
verses.iast:
maharṣayaḥ sapta pūrve catvāro manavastathā |
madbhāvā mānasā jātā yeṣāṃ loka imāḥ prajāḥ
verses.meaning: The seven ancient sages and the four Manus. Fathers of all peoples. All were born from My mind, sharing My power.
verses.takeaway: The family tree has one root.

verses.devanagari:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः ।
सोऽविकम्पेन योगेन युज्यते नात्र संशयः
verses.iast:
etāṃ vibhūtiṃ yogaṃ ca mama yo vetti tattvataḥ |
so'vikampena yogena yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ
verses.meaning: Whoever truly knows these powers and glories of Mine stands in unshakable discipline. Of this there is no doubt.
verses.takeaway: Knowledge that steadies. That is the test.

verses.devanagari:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते ।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः
verses.iast:
ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo mattaḥ sarvaṃ pravartate |
iti matvā bhajante māṃ budhā bhāvasamanvitāḥ
verses.meaning: I am the source of all, and all moves through Me. Knowing this, the wise worship Me with love.
verses.takeaway: One premise. One response.

verses.devanagari:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम् ।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च
verses.iast:
maccittā madgataprāṇā bodhayantaḥ parasparam |
kathayantaśca māṃ nityaṃ tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca
verses.meaning: Minds on Me, lives offered to Me. Teaching each other, speaking of Me always. Content and joyful.
verses.takeaway: The portrait of a living community.

verses.devanagari:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम् ।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते
verses.iast:
teṣāṃ satatayuktānāṃ bhajatāṃ prītipūrvakam |
dadāmi buddhiyogaṃ taṃ yena māmupayānti te
verses.meaning: To these, always yoked, worshipping with love, I grant the wisdom by which they reach Me.
verses.takeaway: Devotion earns instruction. Instruction completes devotion.

verses.devanagari:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः ।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्वता
verses.iast:
teṣāmevānukampārthamahamajñānajaṃ tamaḥ |
nāśayāmyātmabhāvastho jñānadīpena bhāsvatā
verses.meaning: Dwelling in their hearts, out of compassion I destroy. Their darkness-born ignorance. With wisdom's shining lamp.
verses.takeaway: The indwelling teacher lights His own lamp.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान् ।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्
verses.iast:
paraṃ brahma paraṃ dhāma pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhavān |
puruṣaṃ śāśvataṃ divyamādidevamajaṃ vibhum
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: You are the supreme ultimate, the supreme home, the holiest of the holy.
verses.takeaway: The student answers with a hymn.

verses.devanagari:
आहुस्त्वामृषयः सर्वे देवर्षिर्नारदस्तथा ।
असितो देवलो व्यासः स्वयं चैव ब्रवीषि मे
verses.iast:
āhustvāmṛṣayaḥ sarve devarṣirnāradastathā |
asito devalo vyāsaḥ svayaṃ caiva bravīṣi me
verses.meaning: Saints call You the eternal, divine, first god — Narada, Asita, Devala, Vyasa. And You Yourself tell me so.
verses.takeaway: Scripture, sages, and the source agree.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वमेतदृतं मन्ये यन्मां वदसि केशव ।
न हि ते भगवन्व्यक्तिं विदुर्देवा न दानवाः
verses.iast:
sarvametadṛtaṃ manye yanmāṃ vadasi keśava |
na hi te bhagavanvyaktiṃ vidurdevā na dānavāḥ
verses.meaning: All You tell me I hold true, Krishna. Neither gods nor demons grasp Your manifestation.
verses.takeaway: Belief stated before the asking. Good order.

verses.devanagari:
स्वयमेवात्मनात्मानं वेत्थ त्वं पुरुषोत्तम ।
भूतभावन भूतेश देवदेव जगत्पते
verses.iast:
svayamevātmanātmānaṃ vettha tvaṃ puruṣottama |
bhūtabhāvana bhūteśa devadeva jagatpate
verses.meaning: You alone know Yourself by Yourself. Best of beings. Maker of all. Lord of all. God of gods. Ruler of the universe.
verses.takeaway: The address before the request.

verses.devanagari:
वक्तुमर्हस्यशेषेण दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
याभिर्विभूतिभिर्लोकानिमांस्त्वं व्याप्य तिष्ठसि
verses.iast:
vaktumarhasyaśeṣeṇa divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ |
yābhirvibhūtibhirlokānimāṃstvaṃ vyāpya tiṣṭhasi
verses.meaning: So declare fully Your divine glories — by which You stand pervading all these worlds.
verses.takeaway: The request: everything, in full.

verses.devanagari:
कथं विद्यामहं योगिंस्त्वां सदा परिचिन्तयन् ।
केषु केषु च भावेषु चिन्त्योऽसि भगवन्मया
verses.iast:
kathaṃ vidyāmahaṃ yogiṃstvāṃ sadā paricintayan |
keṣu keṣu ca bhāveṣu cintyo'si bhagavanmayā
verses.meaning: How shall I know You, ever meditating? In which things should I contemplate You, Lord?
verses.takeaway: Method and objects. The practical half of the request.

verses.devanagari:
विस्तरेणात्मनो योगं विभूतिं च जनार्दन ।
भूयः कथय तृप्तिर्हि शृण्वतो नास्ति मेऽमृतम्
verses.iast:
vistareṇātmano yogaṃ vibhūtiṃ ca janārdana |
bhūyaḥ kathaya tṛptirhi śṛṇvato nāsti me'mṛtam
verses.meaning: Tell again, in full, Your power and glory. I never tire of hearing this nectar.
verses.takeaway: Hunger for the infinite, stated sweetly.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि दिव्या ह्यात्मविभूतयः ।
प्राधान्यतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ नास्त्यन्तो विस्तरस्य मे
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
hanta te kathayiṣyāmi divyā hyātmavibhūtayaḥ |
prādhānyataḥ kuruśreṣṭha nāstyanto vistarasya me
verses.meaning: Krishna said: then I will tell You My chief glories. For the full extent has no end.
verses.takeaway: The catalogue begins — explicitly abridged.

verses.devanagari:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेश सर्वभूताशयस्थितः ।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च
verses.iast:
ahamātmā guḍākeśa sarvabhūtāśayasthitaḥ |
ahamādiśca madhyaṃ ca bhūtānāmanta eva ca
verses.meaning: I am the self seated in every heart. I am the beginning, middle, and end of all beings.
verses.takeaway: The master key to the whole list.

verses.devanagari:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान् ।
मरीचिर्मरुतामस्मि नक्षत्राणामहं शशी
verses.iast:
ādityānāmahaṃ viṣṇurjyotiṣāṃ raviraṃśumān |
marīcirmarutāmasmi nakṣatrāṇāmahaṃ śaśī
verses.meaning: Among sun-gods, Vishnu. Among lights, the radiant sun. Among storm-gods, Marichi. Among stars, the moon.
verses.takeaway: The best of each class, claimed in turn.

verses.devanagari:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः ।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना
verses.iast:
vedānāṃ sāmavedo'smi devānāmasmi vāsavaḥ |
indriyāṇāṃ manaścāsmi bhūtānāmasmi cetanā
verses.meaning: Among scriptures, the song-scripture. Among gods, Indra. Among senses, the mind. Among beings, awareness.
verses.takeaway: Best-in-class, continued.

verses.devanagari:
रुद्राणां शंकरश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम् ।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्
verses.iast:
rudrāṇāṃ śaṃkaraścāsmi vitteśo yakṣarakṣasām |
vasūnāṃ pāvakaścāsmi meruḥ śikhariṇāmaham
verses.meaning: Among storm-powers, Shiva. Among keepers of wealth, Kubera. Among elements, fire. Among peaks, Meru.
verses.takeaway: The catalogue does not discriminate by sect.

verses.devanagari:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम् ।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः
verses.iast:
purodhasāṃ ca mukhyaṃ māṃ viddhi pārtha bṛhaspatim |
senānīnāmahaṃ skandaḥ sarasāmasmi sāgaraḥ
verses.meaning: Among priests, Brihaspati. Among generals, Skanda. Among waters, the ocean.
verses.takeaway: Priests, armies, oceans — each has a crown.

verses.devanagari:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्म्येकमक्षरम् ।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः
verses.iast:
maharṣīṇāṃ bhṛgurahaṃ girāmasmyekamakṣaram |
yajñānāṃ japayajño'smi sthāvarāṇāṃ himālayaḥ
verses.meaning: Among sages, Bhrigu. Among words, the single syllable Om. Among rites, silent prayer. Among mountains, the Himalaya.
verses.takeaway: Silence outranks ceremony.

verses.devanagari:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः ।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः
verses.iast:
aśvatthaḥ sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ devarṣīṇāṃ ca nāradaḥ |
gandharvāṇāṃ citrarathaḥ siddhānāṃ kapilo muniḥ
verses.meaning: Among trees, the sacred fig. Among seers, Narada. Among musicians of heaven, Chitraratha. Among adepts, Kapila.
verses.takeaway: Botany, music, and philosophy have their kings too.

verses.devanagari:
उच्चैःश्रवसमश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम् ।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपम्
verses.iast:
uccaiḥśravasamaśvānāṃ viddhi māmamṛtodbhavam |
airāvataṃ gajendrāṇāṃ narāṇāṃ ca narādhipam
verses.meaning: Among horses, the nectar-born steed. Among elephants, Airavata. Among humans, the king.
verses.takeaway: Even kingship points upward.

verses.devanagari:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् ।
प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः
verses.iast:
āyudhānāmahaṃ vajraṃ dhenūnāmasmi kāmadhuk |
prajanaścāsmi kandarpaḥ sarpāṇāmasmi vāsukiḥ
verses.meaning: Among weapons, the thunderbolt. Among cattle, the wish-giver. Among creators, desire. Among serpents, Vasuki.
verses.takeaway: Desire itself, rightly placed, is divine.

verses.devanagari:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसामहम् ।
पितॄणामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमतामहम्
verses.iast:
anantaścāsmi nāgānāṃ varuṇo yādasāmaham |
pitṝṇāmaryamā cāsmi yamaḥ saṃyamatāmaham
verses.meaning: Among serpent-kings, Ananta. Among sea-dwellers, Varuna. Among ancestors, Aryaman. Among rulers, Yama.
verses.takeaway: Every hierarchy has a head. One head wears them all.

verses.devanagari:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतामहम् ।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्
verses.iast:
prahlādaścāsmi daityānāṃ kālaḥ kalayatāmaham |
mṛgāṇāṃ ca mṛgendro'haṃ vainateyaśca pakṣiṇām
verses.meaning: Among demons, Prahlada. Among reckoners, time. Among beasts, the lion. Among birds, the eagle.
verses.takeaway: Devotion in a demon. Time among counters.

verses.devanagari:
पवनः पवतामस्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम् ।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी
verses.iast:
pavanaḥ pavatāmasmi rāmaḥ śastrabhṛtāmaham |
jhaṣāṇāṃ makaraścāsmi srotasāmasmi jāhnavī
verses.meaning: Among purifiers, the wind. Among warriors, Rama. Among fishes, the sea-beast. Among rivers, the Ganges.
verses.takeaway: The familiar made glorious.

verses.devanagari:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन ।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्
verses.iast:
sargāṇāmādirantaśca madhyaṃ caivāhamarjuna |
adhyātmavidyā vidyānāṃ vādaḥ pravadatāmaham
verses.meaning: Of all that begins, I am beginning, middle, and end. Among learnings, self-knowledge. Among debaters, fair argument.
verses.takeaway: The frame repeated — lest the list distract.

verses.devanagari:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकस्य च ।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः
verses.iast:
akṣarāṇāmakāro'smi dvandvaḥ sāmāsikasya ca |
ahamevākṣayaḥ kālo dhātāhaṃ viśvatomukhaḥ
verses.meaning: Among letters, A. Among compounds, the pairing of equals. I am endless time, and the maker facing every way.
verses.takeaway: First letter. Fairest grammar. Endless time.

verses.devanagari:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च भविष्यताम् ।
कीर्तिः श्रीर्वाक्च नारीणां स्मृतिर्मेधा धृतिः क्षमा
verses.iast:
mṛtyuḥ sarvaharaścāhamudbhavaśca bhaviṣyatām |
kīrtiḥ śrīrvākca nārīṇāṃ smṛtirmedhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā
verses.meaning: I am all-seizing death, and the birth of things to come. Among women: fame, fortune, speech, memory, wisdom, courage, patience.
verses.takeaway: Seven goddesses close the feminine roll.

verses.devanagari:
बृहत्साम तथा साम्नां गायत्री छन्दसामहम् ।
