मासानां मार्गशीर्षोऽहमृतूनां कुसुमाकरः
verses.iast:
bṛhatsāma tathā sāmnāṃ gāyatrī chandasāmaham |
māsānāṃ mārgaśīrṣo'hamṛtūnāṃ kusumākaraḥ
verses.meaning: Among hymns, the great chant. Among metres, Gayatri. Among months, the harvest month. Among seasons, spring.
verses.takeaway: Poetry, calendar, and spring — claimed.

verses.devanagari:
द्यूतं छलयतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम् ।
जयोऽस्मि व्यवसायोऽस्मि सत्त्वं सत्त्ववतामहम्
verses.iast:
dyūtaṃ chalayatāmasmi tejastejasvināmaham |
jayo'smi vyavasāyo'smi sattvaṃ sattvavatāmaham
verses.meaning: Among cheats, the dice-game. Among the splendid, splendor. I am victory, resolve, and the goodness of the good.
verses.takeaway: Even the dice table has its Lord.

verses.devanagari:
वृष्णीनां वासुदेवोऽस्मि पाण्डवानां धनंजयः ।
मुनीनामप्यहं व्यासः कवीनामुशना कविः
verses.iast:
vṛṣṇīnāṃ vāsudevo'smi pāṇḍavānāṃ dhanaṃjayaḥ |
munīnāmapyahaṃ vyāsaḥ kavīnāmuśanā kaviḥ
verses.meaning: Among clansmen, Krishna. Among archers, Arjuna. Among sages, Vyasa. Among poets, Usanas.
verses.takeaway: The speaker names Himself — and His listener.

verses.devanagari:
दण्डो दमयतामस्मि नीतिरस्मि जिगीषताम् ।
मौनं चैवास्मि गुह्यानां ज्ञानं ज्ञानवतामहम्
verses.iast:
daṇḍo damayatāmasmi nītirasmi jigīṣatām |
maunaṃ caivāsmi guhyānāṃ jñānaṃ jñānavatāmaham
verses.meaning: Among punishers, the rod. Among strivers, fair policy. Among secrets, silence. Among knowers, wisdom.
verses.takeaway: Power, politics, secrecy, knowledge — each crowned.

verses.devanagari:
यच्चापि सर्वभूतानां बीजं तदहमर्जुन ।
न तदस्ति विना यत्स्यान्मया भूतं चराचरम्
verses.iast:
yaccāpi sarvabhūtānāṃ bījaṃ tadahamarjuna |
na tadasti vinā yatsyānmayā bhūtaṃ carācaram
verses.meaning: Whatever seeds all beings — that am I. Nothing moving or still can exist without Me.
verses.takeaway: The seed-clause. The metaphysics in one line.

verses.devanagari:
नान्तोऽस्ति मम दिव्यानां विभूतीनां परन्तप ।
एष तूद्देशतः प्रोक्तो विभूतेर्विस्तरो मया
verses.iast:
nānto'sti mama divyānāṃ vibhūtīnāṃ parantapa |
eṣa tūddeśataḥ prokto vibhūtervistaro mayā
verses.meaning: My glories have no end. What I have told is a fraction only.
verses.takeaway: The catalogue closes with humility — His own.

verses.devanagari:
यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा ।
तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसंभवम्
verses.iast:
yadyadvibhūtimatsattvaṃ śrīmadūrjitameva vā |
tattadevāvagaccha tvaṃ mama tejoṃ'śasaṃbhavam
verses.meaning: Wherever you see power, glory, or brilliance — know it as a spark of My splendor.
verses.takeaway: The reader's field guide in one rule.

verses.devanagari:
अथवा बहुनैतेन किं ज्ञातेन तवार्जुन ।
विष्टभ्याहमिदं कृत्स्नमेकांशेन स्थितो जगत्
verses.iast:
athavā bahunaitena kiṃ jñātena tavārjuna |
viṣṭabhyāhamidaṃ kṛtsnamekāṃśena sthito jagat
verses.meaning: Why know more? With a single fragment of Myself I uphold this entire universe.
verses.takeaway: One spark holds everything. End of list.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मसंज्ञितम् ।
यत्त्वयोक्तं वचस्तेन मोहोऽयं विगतो मम
verses.iast:
madanugrahāya paramaṃ guhyamadhyātmasaṃjñitam |
yattvayoktaṃ vacastena moho'yaṃ vigato mama
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: the supreme mystery You spoke for my welfare has cleared my confusion.
verses.takeaway: Gratitude first. The vision request comes next.

verses.devanagari:
भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्
verses.iast:
bhavāpyayau hi bhūtānāṃ śrutau vistaraśo mayā |
tvattaḥ kamalapatrākṣa māhātmyamapi cāvyayam
verses.meaning: I have heard at length of the birth and passing of beings. And of Your imperishable glory, lotus-eyed one.
verses.takeaway: He listened. Now he asks.

verses.devanagari:
एवमेतद्यथात्थ त्वमात्मानं परमेश्वर ।
द्रष्टुमिच्छामि ते रूपमैश्वरं पुरुषोत्तम
verses.iast:
evametadyathāttha tvamātmānaṃ parameśvara |
draṣṭumicchāmi te rūpamaiśvaraṃ puruṣottama
verses.meaning: What You say of Yourself is so. Now I long to see Your divine form, highest Lord.
verses.takeaway: Belief first, vision second. In that order.

verses.devanagari:
मन्यसे यदि तच्छक्यं मया द्रष्टुमिति प्रभो ।
योगेश्वर ततो मे त्वं दर्शयात्मानमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
manyase yadi tacchakyaṃ mayā draṣṭumiti prabho |
yogeśvara tato me tvaṃ darśayātmānamavyayam
verses.meaning: If I can bear the sight, Lord of discipline, show me Your imperishable Self.
verses.takeaway: The boldest request in the whole poem.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
पश्य मे पार्थ रूपाणि शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।
नानाविधानि दिव्यानि नानावर्णाकृतीनि च
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
paśya me pārtha rūpāṇi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ |
nānāvidhāni divyāni nānāvarṇākṛtīni ca
verses.meaning: Krishna said: see My forms by the hundred and thousand. Countless, divine, multicolored.
verses.takeaway: The curtain speech before the curtain parts.

verses.devanagari:
पश्यादित्यान्वसून्रुद्रानश्विनौ मरुतस्तथा ।
बहून्यदृष्टपूर्वाणि पश्याश्चर्याणि भारत
verses.iast:
paśyādityānvasūnrudrānaśvinau marutastathā |
bahūnyadṛṣṭapūrvāṇi paśyāścaryāṇi bhārata
verses.meaning: See sun-gods, wind-gods, storm-gods, the twin horsemen. Wonders never seen before.
verses.takeaway: The guest list of the vision.

verses.devanagari:
इहैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम् ।
मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि
verses.iast:
ihaikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ paśyādya sacarācaram |
mama dehe guḍākeśa yaccānyad draṣṭumicchasi
verses.meaning: See the whole universe, moving and still, gathered in one within My body. And anything else you wish.
verses.takeaway: Everything, in one place, at once.

verses.devanagari:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा ।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्
verses.iast:
na tu māṃ śakyase draṣṭumanenaiva svacakṣuṣā |
divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me yogamaiśvaram
verses.meaning: But human eyes cannot see Me. I grant you a divine eye. Behold My majestic power.
verses.takeaway: New sight required for a new sight.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो राजन्महायोगेश्वरो हरिः ।
दर्शयामास पार्थाय परमं रूपमैश्वरम्
verses.iast:
evamuktvā tato rājanmahāyogeśvaro hariḥ |
darśayāmāsa pārthāya paramaṃ rūpamaiśvaram
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said: so speaking, Hari showed the prince His supreme divine form.
verses.takeaway: The narrator takes over. Eyes open.

verses.devanagari:
अनेकवक्त्रनयनमनेकाद्भुतदर्शनम् ।
अनेकदिव्याभरणं दिव्यानेकोद्यतायुधम्
verses.iast:
anekavaktranayanamanekādbhutadarśanam |
anekadivyābharaṇaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham
verses.meaning: Countless mouths and eyes. Wondrous sights within. Celestial ornaments, weapons raised high.
verses.takeaway: The inventory of infinity, part one.

verses.devanagari:
दिव्यमाल्याम्बरधरं दिव्यगन्धानुलेपनम् ।
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवमनन्तं विश्वतोमुखम्
verses.iast:
divyamālyāmbaradharaṃ divyagandhānulepanam |
sarvāścaryamayaṃ devamanantaṃ viśvatomukham
verses.meaning: Garlands of stars, robes of light, perfumes of heaven. Every wonder, faces in every direction.
verses.takeaway: Dress for the cosmos itself.

verses.devanagari:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपदुत्थिता ।
यदि भाः सदृशी सा स्याद्भासस्तस्य महात्मनः
verses.iast:
divi sūryasahasrasya bhavedyugapadutthitā |
yadi bhāḥ sadṛśī sā syādbhāsastasya mahātmanaḥ
verses.meaning: If a thousand suns burst forth at once, that might match this splendor.
verses.takeaway: The famous simile. Understatement as praise.

verses.devanagari:
तत्रैकस्थं जगत्कृत्स्नं प्रविभक्तमनेकधा ।
अपश्यद्देवदेवस्य शरीरे पाण्डवस्तदा
verses.iast:
tatraikasthaṃ jagatkṛtsnaṃ pravibhaktamanekadhā |
apaśyaddevadevasya śarīre pāṇḍavastadā
verses.meaning: There Arjuna saw the whole universe in one — yet divided in countless parts — within the god of gods.
verses.takeaway: One and many, simultaneously.

verses.devanagari:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनंजयः ।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत
verses.iast:
tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo hṛṣṭaromā dhanaṃjayaḥ |
praṇamya śirasā devaṃ kṛtāñjalirabhāṣata
verses.meaning: Amazed, hair on end, he bowed his head and spoke with folded hands.
verses.takeaway: Terror and devotion in one posture.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे
सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसंघान् ।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थ-
मृषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्
verses.iast:
paśyāmi devāṃstava deva dehe
sarvāṃstathā bhūtaviśeṣasaṃghān |
brahmāṇamīśaṃ kamalāsanastha-
mṛṣīṃśca sarvānuragāṃśca divyān
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: I see all gods within Your body. All beings. The creator on His lotus. Sages and serpents.
verses.takeaway: The eyewitness account begins.

verses.devanagari:
अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं
पश्यामि त्वां सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम् ।
नान्तं न मध्यं न पुनस्तवादिं
पश्यामि विश्वेश्वर विश्वरूप
verses.iast:
anekabāhūdaravaktranetraṃ
paśyāmi tvāṃ sarvato'nantarūpam |
nāntaṃ na madhyaṃ na punastavādiṃ
paśyāmi viśveśvara viśvarūpa
verses.meaning: Countless arms, bellies, mouths, eyes everywhere. No end, no middle, no beginning in sight.
verses.takeaway: Infinity, reported plainly.

verses.devanagari:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च
तेजोराशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दुर्निरीक्ष्यं समन्ता-
द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्
verses.iast:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakriṇaṃ ca
tejorāśiṃ sarvato dīptimantam |
paśyāmi tvāṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ samantā-
ddīptānalārkadyutimaprameyam
verses.meaning: Crown, mace, discus. A mass of radiance, blinding on every side, blazing like fire and sun.
verses.takeaway: The familiar emblems, made unbearable.

verses.devanagari:
त्वमक्षरं परमं वेदितव्यं
त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
त्वमव्ययः शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता
सनातनस्त्वं पुरुषो मतो मे
verses.iast:
tvamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ veditavyaṃ
tvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam |
tvamavyayaḥ śāśvatadharmagoptā
sanātanastvaṃ puruṣo mato me
verses.meaning: You are the imperishable truth to be known. The highest refuge. Guardian of eternal duty. The timeless being.
verses.takeaway: Theology inside the terror.

verses.devanagari:
अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-
मनन्तबाहुं शशिसूर्यनेत्रम् ।
पश्यामि त्वां दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं
स्वतेजसा विश्वमिदं तपन्तम्
verses.iast:
anādimadhyāntamanantavīrya-
manantabāhuṃ śaśisūryanetram |
paśyāmi tvāṃ dīptahutāśavaktraṃ
svatejasā viśvamidaṃ tapantam
verses.meaning: No beginning, middle, or end. Boundless power. Sun and moon for eyes. A mouth of blazing fire, warming the universe.
verses.takeaway: The face that heats the worlds.

verses.devanagari:
द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं हि
व्याप्तं त्वयैकेन दिशश्च सर्वाः ।
दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं रूपमुग्रं तवेदं
लोकत्रयं प्रव्यथितं महात्मन्
verses.iast:
dyāvāpṛthivyoridamantaraṃ hi
vyāptaṃ tvayaikena diśaśca sarvāḥ |
dṛṣṭvādbhutaṃ rūpamugraṃ tavedaṃ
lokatrayaṃ pravyathitaṃ mahātman
verses.meaning: Earth and sky and every direction are filled by You alone. The three worlds tremble at this terrible wonder.
verses.takeaway: Aloneness at cosmic scale.

verses.devanagari:
अमी हि त्वां सुरसंघा विशन्ति
केचिद्भीताः प्राञ्जलयो गृणन्ति ।
स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा महर्षिसिद्धसंघाः
स्तुवन्ति त्वां स्तुतिभिः पुष्कलाभिः
verses.iast:
amī hi tvāṃ surasaṃghā viśanti
kecidbhītāḥ prāñjalayo gṛṇanti |
svastītyuktvā maharṣisiddhasaṃghāḥ
stuvanti tvāṃ stutibhiḥ puṣkalābhiḥ
verses.meaning: Hosts of gods stream into You. Some pray in fear with folded hands. Sages chant blessings and praise.
verses.takeaway: Surrender, fear, and song together.

verses.devanagari:
रुद्रादित्या वसवो ये च साध्या
विश्वेऽश्विनौ मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च ।
गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघा
वीक्षन्ते त्वां विस्मिताश्चैव सर्वे
verses.iast:
rudrādityā vasavo ye ca sādhyā
viśve'śvinau marutaścoṣmapāśca |
gandharvayakṣāsurasiddhasaṃghā
vīkṣante tvāṃ vismitāścaiva sarve
verses.meaning: Storm-gods, sun-gods, circlers, ancestors. Twins, winds, musicians, demons, adepts. All stare amazed.
verses.takeaway: The whole pantheon, reduced to spectators.

verses.devanagari:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं
महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम् ।
बहूदरं बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं
दृष्ट्वा लोकाः प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम्
verses.iast:
rūpaṃ mahatte bahuvaktranetraṃ
mahābāho bahubāhūrupādam |
bahūdaraṃ bahudaṃṣṭrākarālaṃ
dṛṣṭvā lokāḥ pravyathitāstathāham
verses.meaning: Many mouths, eyes, arms, thighs, feet, bellies, dreadful teeth. All peoples terrified — and I with them.
verses.takeaway: Fear honestly confessed.

verses.devanagari:
नभःस्पृशं दीप्तमनेकवर्णं
व्यात्ताननं दीप्तविशालनेत्रम् ।
दृष्ट्वा हि त्वां प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा
धृतिं न विन्दामि शमं च विष्णो
verses.iast:
nabhaḥspṛśaṃ dīptamanekavarṇaṃ
vyāttānanaṃ dīptaviśālanetram |
dṛṣṭvā hi tvāṃ pravyathitāntarātmā
dhṛtiṃ na vindāmi śamaṃ ca viṣṇo
verses.meaning: Touching the sky, radiant, many-colored. Jaws agape, eyes ablaze. I shake inside, courage and calm gone.
verses.takeaway: The bravest archer unmanned.

verses.devanagari:
दंष्ट्राकरालानि च ते मुखानि
दृष्ट्वैव कालानलसन्निभानि ।
दिशो न जाने न लभे च शर्म
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
verses.iast:
daṃṣṭrākarālāni ca te mukhāni
dṛṣṭvaiva kālānalasannibhāni |
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma
prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
verses.meaning: These tusk-ringed mouths glow like doomsday fire. I lose my bearings and my peace. Be gracious, all-pervading Lord.
verses.takeaway: Lost directions. One address for mercy.

verses.devanagari:
अमी च त्वां धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्राः
सर्वे सहैवावनिपालसंघैः ।
भीष्मो द्रोणः सूतपुत्रस्तथासौ
सहास्मदीयैरपि योधमुख्यैः
verses.iast:
amī ca tvāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrasya putrāḥ
sarve sahaivāvanipālasaṃghaiḥ |
bhīṣmo droṇaḥ sūtaputrastathāsau
sahāsmadīyairapi yodhamukhyaiḥ
verses.meaning: Dhritarashtra's sons with all their kings. Bhishma, Drona, Karna. Our own captains too.
verses.takeaway: The muster roll of the doomed.

verses.devanagari:
वक्त्राणि ते त्वरमाणा विशन्ति
दंष्ट्राकरालानि भयानकानि ।
केचिद्विलग्ना दशनान्तरेषु
संदृश्यन्ते चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः
verses.iast:
vaktrāṇi te tvaramāṇā viśanti
daṃṣṭrākarālāni bhayānakāni |
kecidvilagnā daśanāntareṣu
saṃdṛśyante cūrṇitairuttamāṅgaiḥ
verses.meaning: All rush into Your dreadful toothed mouths. Some stick, heads crushed, between the teeth.
verses.takeaway: The war's ending, previewed.

verses.devanagari:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः
समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति ।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा
विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति
verses.iast:
yathā nadīnāṃ bahavo'mbuvegāḥ
samudramevābhimukhā dravanti |
tathā tavāmī naralokavīrā
viśanti vaktrāṇyabhivijvalanti
verses.meaning: As rivers race to the sea, so these heroes pour into Your blazing mouths.
verses.takeaway: Courage flowing one way only.

verses.devanagari:
यथा प्रदीप्तं ज्वलनं पतङ्गा
विशन्ति नाशाय समृद्धवेगाः ।
तथैव नाशाय विशन्ति लोका-
स्तवापि वक्त्राणि समृद्धवेगाः
verses.iast:
yathā pradīptaṃ jvalanaṃ pataṅgā
viśanti nāśāya samṛddhavegāḥ |
tathaiva nāśāya viśanti lokā-
stavāpi vaktrāṇi samṛddhavegāḥ
verses.meaning: As moths dive into flame, so these multitudes hasten to their ruin.
verses.takeaway: The oldest simile for self-destruction.

verses.devanagari:
लेलिह्यसे ग्रसमानः समन्ता-
ल्लोकान्समग्रान्वदनैर्ज्वलद्भिः ।
तेजोभिरापूर्य जगत्समग्रं
भासस्तवोग्राः प्रतपन्ति विष्णो
verses.iast:
lelihyase grasamānaḥ samantā-
llokānsamagrānvadanairjvaladbhiḥ |
tejobhirāpūrya jagatsamagraṃ
bhāsastavogrāḥ pratapanti viṣṇo
verses.meaning: Swallowing all from every side, licking them with flaming tongues. Your splendor fills and scorches the universe.
verses.takeaway: Appetite as cosmology.

verses.devanagari:
आख्याहि मे को भवानुग्ररूपो
नमोऽस्तु ते देववर प्रसीद ।
विज्ञातुमिच्छामि भवन्तमाद्यं
न हि प्रजानामि तव प्रवृत्तिम्
verses.iast:
ākhyāhi me ko bhavānugrarūpo
namo'stu te devavara prasīda |
vijñātumicchāmi bhavantamādyaṃ
na hi prajānāmi tava pravṛttim
verses.meaning: Who are You in this fierce form? Salutations, chief of gods. Be gracious. I must know the primeval one — Your deeds pass understanding.
verses.takeaway: The question the whole chapter bends toward.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो
लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः ।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे
येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
kālo'smi lokakṣayakṛtpravṛddho
lokānsamāhartumiha pravṛttaḥ |
ṛte'pi tvāṃ na bhaviṣyanti sarve
ye'vasthitāḥ pratyanīkeṣu yodhāḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: I am Time, destroyer of worlds, now risen to devour. Even without you, these warriors will all cease to be.
verses.takeaway: The answer, without cushion.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व
जित्वा शत्रून् भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम् ।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव
निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्
verses.iast:
tasmāttvamuttiṣṭha yaśo labhasva
jitvā śatrūn bhuṅkṣva rājyaṃ samṛddham |
mayaivaite nihatāḥ pūrvameva
nimittamātraṃ bhava savyasācin
verses.meaning: So rise, win glory, conquer, enjoy the kingdom. They are already slain by Me. Be merely the instrument.
verses.takeaway: Instrument, not author. That is the whole ethic.

verses.devanagari:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च
कर्णं तथान्यानपि योधवीरान् ।
मया हतांस्त्वं जहि मा व्यथिष्ठा
युध्यस्व जेतासि रणे सपत्नान्
verses.iast:
droṇaṃ ca bhīṣmaṃ ca jayadrathaṃ ca
karṇaṃ tathānyānapi yodhavīrān |
mayā hatāṃstvaṃ jahi mā vyathiṣṭhā
yudhyasva jetāsi raṇe sapatnān
verses.meaning: Strike Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna — already slain by Me. Do not grieve. Fight. You will conquer.
verses.takeaway: The kill-list as reassurance.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.devanagari:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं केशवस्य
कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः किरीटी ।
नमस्कृत्वा भूय एवाह कृष्णं
सगद्गदं भीतभीतः प्रणम्य
verses.iast:
etacchrutvā vacanaṃ keśavasya
kṛtāñjalirvepamānaḥ kirīṭī |
namaskṛtvā bhūya evāha kṛṣṇaṃ
sagadgadaṃ bhītabhītaḥ praṇamya
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said: hearing this, the trembling crowned one bowed with folded hands. Throat choked, he spoke again.
verses.takeaway: The narrator frames the second hymn.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या
जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते च ।
रक्षांसि भीतानि दिशो द्रवन्ति
सर्वे नमस्यन्ति च सिद्धसंघाः
verses.iast:
sthāne hṛṣīkeśa tava prakīrtyā
jagatprahṛṣyatyanurajyate ca |
rakṣāṃsi bhītāni diśo dravanti
sarve namasyanti ca siddhasaṃghāḥ
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: rightly does the world rejoice in Your glory. Demons flee terrified. Adepts bow down.
verses.takeaway: Fear and joy, correctly assigned.

verses.devanagari:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन्
गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे ।
अनन्त देवेश जगन्निवास
त्वमक्षरं सदसत्तत्परं यत्
verses.iast:
kasmācca te na nameranmahātman
garīyase brahmaṇo'pyādikartre |
ananta deveśa jagannivāsa
tvamakṣaraṃ sadasattatparaṃ yat
verses.meaning: Why would they not bow to You — greater than the creator, first cause? Infinite Lord, refuge of worlds. Being, non-being, and beyond both.
verses.takeaway: The metaphysical crescendo.

verses.devanagari:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराण-
स्त्वमस्य विश्वस्य परं निधानम् ।
वेत्तासि वेद्यं च परं च धाम
त्वया ततं विश्वमनन्तरूप
verses.iast:
tvamādidevaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇa-
stvamasya viśvasya paraṃ nidhānam |
vettāsi vedyaṃ ca paraṃ ca dhāma
tvayā tataṃ viśvamanantarūpa
verses.meaning: Primal god, ancient person. Highest refuge of this universe. Knower and known and supreme goal. All-pervading, infinite-formed.
verses.takeaway: Titles stacked like temple stones.

verses.devanagari:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः
प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रपितामहश्च ।
नमो नमस्तेऽस्तु सहस्रकृत्वः
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते
verses.iast:
vāyuryamo'gnirvaruṇaḥ śaśāṅkaḥ
prajāpatistvaṃ prapitāmahaśca |
namo namaste'stu sahasrakṛtvaḥ
punaśca bhūyo'pi namo namaste
verses.meaning: Wind, death, fire, ocean, moon. Creator and great grandsire both.
verses.takeaway: Elements and ancestors in one breath.

verses.devanagari:
नमः पुरस्तादथ पृष्ठतस्ते
नमोऽस्तु ते सर्वत एव सर्व ।
अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं
सर्वं समाप्नोषि ततोऽसि सर्वः
verses.iast:
namaḥ purastādatha pṛṣṭhataste
namo'stu te sarvata eva sarva |
anantavīryāmitavikramastvaṃ
sarvaṃ samāpnoṣi tato'si sarvaḥ
verses.meaning: Salutations a thousand times, again and again. Before, behind, on every side — to You who are all.
verses.takeaway: Prostration in every direction.

verses.devanagari:
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं
हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति ।
अजानता महिमानं तवेदं
मया प्रमादात्प्रणयेन वापि
verses.iast:
sakheti matvā prasabhaṃ yaduktaṃ
he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti |
ajānatā mahimānaṃ tavedaṃ
mayā pramādātpraṇayena vāpi
verses.meaning: For calling You 'friend,' 'Krishna,' 'clansman' — light words from ignorance of this greatness —
verses.takeaway: The apology begins. Casualness confessed.

verses.devanagari:
यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि
विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु ।
एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत तत्समक्षं
तत्क्षामये त्वामहमप्रमेयम्
verses.iast:
yaccāvahāsārthamasatkṛto'si
vihāraśayyāsanabhojaneṣu |
eko'thavāpyacyuta tatsamakṣaṃ
tatkṣāmaye tvāmahamaprameyam
verses.meaning: For jests at play, rest, meals, and councils. Alone or before others. Forgive me, imperishable one.
verses.takeaway: Every intimacy re-examined.

verses.devanagari:
पितासि लोकस्य चराचरस्य
त्वमस्य पूज्यश्च गुरुर्गरीयान् ।
न त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यो
लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव
verses.iast:
pitāsi lokasya carācarasya
tvamasya pūjyaśca gururgarīyān |
na tvatsamo'styabhyadhikaḥ kuto'nyo
lokatraye'pyapratimaprabhāva
verses.meaning: Father of all that moves and stands. Greatest teacher. None equals You — how could any surpass?
verses.takeaway: No comparison available. That is the point.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय कायं
प्रसादये त्वामहमीशमीड्यम् ।
पितेव पुत्रस्य सखेव सख्युः
प्रियः प्रियायार्हसि देव सोढुम्
verses.iast:
tasmātpraṇamya praṇidhāya kāyaṃ
prasādaye tvāmahamīśamīḍyam |
piteva putrasya sakheva sakhyuḥ
priyaḥ priyāyārhasi deva soḍhum
verses.meaning: So I bow, prostrate, begging grace. Bear with me as a father his son, a friend his friend, a lover his beloved.
verses.takeaway: Three mercies invoked for one pardon.

verses.devanagari:
अदृष्टपूर्वं हृषितोऽस्मि दृष्ट्वा
भयेन च प्रव्यथितं मनो मे ।
तदेव मे दर्शय देव रूपं
प्रसीद देवेश जगन्निवास
verses.iast:
adṛṣṭapūrvaṃ hṛṣito'smi dṛṣṭvā
bhayena ca pravyathitaṃ mano me |
tadeva me darśaya deva rūpaṃ
prasīda deveśa jagannivāsa
verses.meaning: Thrilled to see the never-seen, yet trembling — show me again the familiar form, gracious Lord of gods.
verses.takeaway: Joy and fear ask together.

verses.devanagari:
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रहस्त-
मिच्छामि त्वां द्रष्टुमहं तथैव ।
तेनैव रूपेण चतुर्भुजेन
सहस्रबाहो भव विश्वमूर्ते
verses.iast:
kirīṭinaṃ gadinaṃ cakrahasta-
micchāmi tvāṃ draṣṭumahaṃ tathaiva |
tenaiva rūpeṇa caturbhujena
sahasrabāho bhava viśvamūrte
verses.meaning: Crown, mace, discus in hand, as before. Thousand-armed one — return to the four-armed form.
verses.takeaway: The specific request: shrink the infinite.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
मया प्रसन्नेन तवार्जुनेदं
रूपं परं दर्शितमात्मयोगात् ।
तेजोमयं विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं
यन्मे त्वदन्येन न दृष्टपूर्वम्
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
mayā prasannena tavārjunedaṃ
rūpaṃ paraṃ darśitamātmayogāt |
tejomayaṃ viśvamanantamādyaṃ
yanme tvadanyena na dṛṣṭapūrvam
verses.meaning: Krishna said: out of love I showed this supreme, infinite, primal form — seen by you alone, Arjuna.
verses.takeaway: Grace, not achievement, explains the vision.

verses.devanagari:
न वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न दानै-
र्न च क्रियाभिर्न तपोभिरुग्रैः ।
एवंरूपः शक्य अहं नृलोके
द्रष्टुं त्वदन्येन कुरुप्रवीर
verses.iast:
na vedayajñādhyayanairna dānai-
rna ca kriyābhirna tapobhirugraiḥ |
evaṃrūpaḥ śakya ahaṃ nṛloke
draṣṭuṃ tvadanyena kurupravīra
verses.meaning: No scripture, sacrifice, gift, rite, or fierce discipline can show this form. None but you has seen it.
verses.takeaway: The vision is unearnable. Twice stated.

verses.devanagari:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् ।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य
verses.iast:
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvo
dṛṣṭvā rūpaṃ ghoramīdṛṅmamedam |
vyapetabhīḥ prītamanāḥ punastvaṃ
tadeva me rūpamidaṃ prapaśya
verses.meaning: Do not fear this terrible form of Mine. Glad-hearted, fearless — see again My familiar shape.
verses.takeaway: Comfort before the withdrawal.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.devanagari:
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः ।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा
verses.iast:
ityarjunaṃ vāsudevastathoktvā
svakaṃ rūpaṃ darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ |
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītamenaṃ
bhūtvā punaḥ saumyavapurmahātmā
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said: so speaking, Krishna resumed His own gentle form and comforted the frightened prince.
verses.takeaway: The cosmos folds back into the charioteer.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन ।
इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः
verses.iast:
dṛṣṭvedaṃ mānuṣaṃ rūpaṃ tava saumyaṃ janārdana |
idānīmasmi saṃvṛttaḥ sacetāḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: seeing again this gentle human form, my mind steadies and returns to normal.
verses.takeaway: Recovery, reported simply.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम ।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
sudurdarśamidaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭavānasi yanmama |
devā apyasya rūpasya nityaṃ darśanakāṅkṣiṇaḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: even gods forever long to see this form you have seen. It is hard won.
verses.takeaway: The vision envied by heaven itself.

verses.devanagari:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया ।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा
verses.iast:
nāhaṃ vedairna tapasā na dānena na cejyayā |
śakya evaṃvidho draṣṭuṃ dṛṣṭavānasi māṃ yathā
verses.meaning: Not by scriptures, penance, gifts, or rites can I be seen as you have seen Me.
verses.takeaway: Unearnable — third stating, for emphasis kept.

verses.devanagari:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप
verses.iast:
bhaktyā tvananyayā śakya ahamevaṃvidho'rjuna |
jñātuṃ draṣṭuṃ ca tattvena praveṣṭuṃ ca paraṃtapa
verses.meaning: But by single-pointed devotion I can be known, seen, and entered truly.
verses.takeaway: The one key: undivided love.

verses.devanagari:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः ।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव
verses.iast:
matkarmakṛnmatparamo madbhaktaḥ saṅgavarjitaḥ |
nirvairaḥ sarvabhūteṣu yaḥ sa māmeti pāṇḍava
verses.meaning: Who works for Me, holds Me highest, loves Me, drops attachments, hates no being — such a one reaches Me.
verses.takeaway: The chapter's whole teaching in one verse.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते ।
ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः
verses.iast:
evaṃ satatayuktā ye bhaktāstvāṃ paryupāsate |
ye cāpyakṣaramavyaktaṃ teṣāṃ ke yogavittamāḥ
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: two kinds of worshippers. Those devoted to Your visible form. And those seeking the unseen imperishable. Who knows discipline best?
verses.takeaway: The chapter's single question. Everything answers it.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते ।
श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
mayyāveśya mano ye māṃ nityayuktā upāsate |
śraddhayā parayopetāste me yuktatamā matāḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: those constantly devoted. Full of highest faith. Minds fixed on Me. I count them most disciplined.
verses.takeaway: The verdict first. Reasons after.

verses.devanagari:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते ।
सर्वत्रगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्
verses.iast:
ye tvakṣaramanirdeśyamavyaktaṃ paryupāsate |
sarvatragamacintyaṃ ca kūṭasthamacalaṃ dhruvam
verses.meaning: But others restrain every sense. Minds steady at all times. Meditating on the indescribable, imperishable, unseen.
verses.takeaway: The harder road, described fairly.

verses.devanagari:
संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः ।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः
verses.iast:
saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ sarvatra samabuddhayaḥ |
te prāpnuvanti māmeva sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ
verses.meaning: The all-pervading, unthinkable, changeless, constant. Working for the good of all beings. They too reach Me.
verses.takeaway: Both roads arrive. Costs differ.

verses.devanagari:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम् ।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते
verses.iast:
kleśo'dhikatarasteṣāmavyaktāsaktacetasām |
avyaktā hi gatirduḥkhaṃ dehavadbhiravāpyate
verses.meaning: Still, the unseen path strains embodied beings sorely. The formless goal comes hard to those with bodies.
verses.takeaway: Honest advertising for the abstract.

verses.devanagari:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः ।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते
verses.iast:
ye tu sarvāṇi karmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparāḥ |
ananyenaiva yogena māṃ dhyāyanta upāsate
verses.meaning: But those who dedicate every act to Me. Holding Me highest. Worshipping with love for none besides.
verses.takeaway: The easier road, with one condition: exclusivity.

verses.devanagari:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात् ।
भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्
verses.iast:
teṣāmahaṃ samuddhartā mṛtyusaṃsārasāgarāt |
bhavāmi nacirātpārtha mayyāveśitacetasām
verses.meaning: minds fixed on Me — I swiftly lift them from the ocean of mortal death.
verses.takeaway: Swiftness promised. Ocean crossed.

verses.devanagari:
मय्येव मन आधत्स्व मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय ।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः
verses.iast:
mayyeva mana ādhatsva mayi buddhiṃ niveśaya |
nivasiṣyasi mayyeva ata ūrdhvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ
verses.meaning: Fix your mind on Me alone, your understanding too. In Me you will dwell hereafter. No doubt.
verses.takeaway: The instruction in two lines.

verses.devanagari:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थिरम् ।
अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनंजय
verses.iast:
atha cittaṃ samādhātuṃ na śaknoṣi mayi sthiram |
abhyāsayogena tato māmicchāptuṃ dhanaṃjaya
verses.meaning: If you cannot steady your mind on Me, then reach Me through constant practice of meditation.
verses.takeaway: Failure path one: practice.

verses.devanagari:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव ।
मदर्थमपि कर्माणि कुर्वन्सिद्धिमवाप्स्यसि
verses.iast:
abhyāse'pyasamartho'si matkarmaparamo bhava |
madarthamapi karmāṇi kurvansiddhimavāpsyasi
verses.meaning: If even practice defeats you, work for My sake above all. Acting for Me, you will reach perfection.
verses.takeaway: Failure path two: dedicated work.

verses.devanagari:
अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्
verses.iast:
athaitadapyaśakto'si kartuṃ madyogamāśritaḥ |
sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ tataḥ kuru yatātmavān
verses.meaning: If even that is beyond you, take refuge in devotion to Me. Restrain yourself. Give up every fruit of action.
verses.takeaway: Failure path three: surrender the results.

verses.devanagari:
श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते ।
ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्
verses.iast:
śreyo hi jñānamabhyāsājjñānāddhyānaṃ viśiṣyate |
dhyānātkarmaphalatyāgastyāgācchāntiranantaram
verses.meaning: For knowledge beats rote practice. Worship beats knowledge. Giving up results beats worship. And surrender brings peace swiftly.
verses.takeaway: The ladder, ranked rung by rung.

verses.devanagari:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च ।
निर्ममो निरहंकारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी
verses.iast:
adveṣṭā sarvabhūtānāṃ maitraḥ karuṇa eva ca |
nirmamo nirahaṃkāraḥ samaduḥkhasukhaḥ kṣamī
verses.meaning: Who hates no being. Friendly, compassionate. Free of ego and possessiveness.
verses.takeaway: The portrait of dear-ness begins.

verses.devanagari:
संतुष्टः सततं योगी यतात्मा दृढनिश्चयः ।
मय्यर्पितमनोबुद्धिर्यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.iast:
saṃtuṣṭaḥ satataṃ yogī yatātmā dṛḍhaniścayaḥ |
mayyarpitamanobuddhiryo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.meaning: Even through joy and sorrow. Forgiving, content, always yoked. Self-ruled, resolute. Mind and heart Mine. Such a one is dear to Me.
verses.takeaway: Dear-ness, itemized.

verses.devanagari:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः ।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः
verses.iast:
yasmānnodvijate loko lokānnodvijate ca yaḥ |
harṣāmarṣabhayodvegairmukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ
verses.meaning: Who disturbs no world, nor is disturbed by any. Free of excitement, anger, fear, and worry — such a one is dear to Me.
verses.takeaway: Untroubled and untroubling.

verses.devanagari:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मद्भक्तः स मे प्रियः
verses.iast:
anapekṣaḥ śucirdakṣa udāsīno gatavyathaḥ |
sarvārambhaparityāgī yo madbhaktaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.meaning: Unconcerned with outcomes. Pure, efficient, neutral, untroubled. Surrendering every selfish act. Such a one is dear to Me.
verses.takeaway: Efficiency without anxiety.

verses.devanagari:
यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः
verses.iast:
yo na hṛṣyati na dveṣṭi na śocati na kāṅkṣati |
śubhāśubhaparityāgī bhaktimānyaḥ sa me priyaḥ
verses.meaning: No craving, no aversion. No grief, no greed. Abandoning likes and dislikes alike — such a one is dear to Me.
verses.takeaway: The equanimity verse. The chapter's heart.

verses.devanagari:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः ।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः
verses.iast:
samaḥ śatrau ca mitre ca tathā mānāpamānayoḥ |
śītoṣṇasukhaduḥkheṣu samaḥ saṅgavivarjitaḥ
verses.meaning: Same toward friend and foe, honor and disgrace. Same in heat and cold, pleasure and pain. Free of clinging.
verses.takeaway: Sameness as a discipline.

verses.devanagari:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित् ।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः
verses.iast:
tulyanindāstutirmaunī santuṣṭo yena kenacit |
aniketaḥ sthiramatirbhaktimānme priyo naraḥ
verses.meaning: To whom praise and blame sound alike. Quiet, content with whatever comes, homeless, steady-minded, full of devotion — such a one is dear to Me.
verses.takeaway: Homeless, yet at home everywhere.

verses.devanagari:
ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते ।
श्रद्दधाना मत्परमा भक्तास्तेऽतीव मे प्रियाः
verses.iast:
ye tu dharmyāmṛtamidaṃ yathoktaṃ paryupāsate |
śraddadhānā matparamā bhaktāste'tīva me priyāḥ
verses.meaning: But devotees who hold Me highest. And drink this immortal teaching with faith. They are supremely dear to Me.
verses.takeaway: Faith plus the teaching: the dearest combination.

verses.devanagari: एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः
verses.iast: etadyo vetti taṃ prāhuḥ kṣetrajña iti tadvidaḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: this body is the field. Whoever knows it is the knower of the field.
verses.takeaway: Two words unlock the chapter: field and knower.

verses.devanagari:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम
verses.iast:
kṣetrajñaṃ cāpi māṃ viddhi sarvakṣetreṣu bhārata |
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorjñānaṃ yattajjñānaṃ mataṃ mama
verses.meaning: And know Me as the knower in every field. Knowing field and knower — that is true knowledge.
verses.takeaway: The owner of every field is one.

verses.devanagari:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यादृक्च यद्विकारि यतश्च यत् ।
स च यो यत्प्रभावश्च तत्समासेन मे शृणु
verses.iast:
tatkṣetraṃ yacca yādṛkca yadvikāri yataśca yat |
sa ca yo yatprabhāvaśca tatsamāsena me śṛṇu
verses.meaning: Hear briefly what the field is, what it is like, its changes, its source. Who the knower is, and his powers.
verses.takeaway: The syllabus, stated plainly.

verses.devanagari:
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतं छन्दोभिर्विविधैः पृथक् ।
ब्रह्मसूत्रपदैश्चैव हेतुमद्भिर्विनिश्चितैः
verses.iast:
ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītaṃ chandobhirvividhaiḥ pṛthak |
brahmasūtrapadaiścaiva hetumadbhirviniścitaiḥ
verses.meaning: Sages have sung this in many hymns, distinctly. In reasoned texts that reveal the ultimate.
verses.takeaway: Old songs, settled arguments, one subject.

verses.devanagari:
महाभूतान्यहंकारो बुद्धिरव्यक्तमेव च ।
इन्द्रियाणि दशैकं च पञ्च चेन्द्रियगोचराः
verses.iast:
mahābhūtānyahaṃkāro buddhiravyaktameva ca |
indriyāṇi daśaikaṃ ca pañca cendriyagocarāḥ
verses.meaning: The five elements, ego, intellect, the unseen. Ten senses plus mind. Five sense-objects.
verses.takeaway: The field's parts list, part one.

verses.devanagari:
इच्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः ।
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्
verses.iast:
icchā dveṣaḥ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ saṃghātaścetanā dhṛtiḥ |
etatkṣetraṃ samāsena savikāramudāhṛtam
verses.meaning: Desire, hatred, pleasure, pain. Body, awareness, resolve. This, in brief, is the field with all its changes.
verses.takeaway: The inner weather counts as field too.

verses.devanagari:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम् ।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः
verses.iast:
amānitvamadambhitvamahiṃsā kṣāntirārjavam |
ācāryopāsanaṃ śaucaṃ sthairyamātmavinigrahaḥ
verses.meaning: Humility, honesty, harmlessness. Patience, honor, reverence for teachers. Purity, steadiness, self-rule.
verses.takeaway: Wisdom listed as character, not cleverness.

verses.devanagari:
इन्द्रियार्थेषु वैराग्यमनहंकार एव च ।
जन्ममृत्युजराव्याधिदुःखदोषानुदर्शनम्
verses.iast:
indriyārtheṣu vairāgyamanahaṃkāra eva ca |
janmamṛtyujarāvyādhiduḥkhadoṣānudarśanam
verses.meaning: Freedom from sense slavery. Freedom from ego. Seeing the pain in birth, death, age, and disease.
verses.takeaway: Clear eyes about the human lot.

verses.devanagari:
असक्तिरनभिष्वङ्गः पुत्रदारगृहादिषु ।
नित्यं च समचित्तत्वमिष्टानिष्टोपपत्तिषु
verses.iast:
asaktiranabhiṣvaṅgaḥ putradāragṛhādiṣu |
nityaṃ ca samacittatvamiṣṭāniṣṭopapattiṣu
verses.meaning: No clinging to children, spouse, or home. Even-minded through welcome and unwelcome alike.
verses.takeaway: Love without clutching. Calm without numbness.

verses.devanagari:
मयि चानन्ययोगेन भक्तिरव्यभिचारिणी ।
विविक्तदेशसेवित्वमरतिर्जनसंसदि
verses.iast:
mayi cānanyayogena bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī |
viviktadeśasevitvamaratirjanasaṃsadi
verses.meaning: Unswerving devotion to Me alone. Love of solitude. Hunger for self-knowledge.
verses.takeaway: Three practices of the wise.

verses.devanagari:
अध्यात्मज्ञाननित्यत्वं तत्त्वज्ञानार्थदर्शनम् ।
एतज्ज्ञानमिति प्रोक्तमज्ञानं यदतोऽन्यथा
verses.iast:
adhyātmajñānanityatvaṃ tattvajñānārthadarśanam |
etajjñānamiti proktamajñānaṃ yadato'nyathā
verses.meaning: Constancy in truth-seeking. Seeing what wisdom aims at. This is knowledge. Its opposite is ignorance.
verses.takeaway: The definition closes the list.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञेयं यत्तत्प्रवक्ष्यामि यज्ज्ञात्वामृतमश्नुते ।
अनादि मत्परं ब्रह्म न सत्तन्नासदुच्यते
verses.iast:
jñeyaṃ yattatpravakṣyāmi yajjñātvāmṛtamaśnute |
anādi matparaṃ brahma na sattannāsaducyate
verses.meaning: Now hear the goal of knowing. The supreme ultimate. Beginningless. Neither being nor non-being.
verses.takeaway: The address of everything worth finding.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वतः पाणिपादं तत्सर्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् ।
सर्वतः श्रुतिमल्लोके सर्वमावृत्य तिष्ठति
verses.iast:
sarvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ tatsarvato'kṣiśiromukham |
sarvataḥ śrutimalloke sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati
verses.meaning: Hands and feet everywhere. Eyes, heads, faces everywhere. Ears everywhere. Enfolding all.
verses.takeaway: Omnipresence, anatomized.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वेन्द्रियगुणाभासं सर्वेन्द्रियविवर्जितम् ।
असक्तं सर्वभृच्चैव निर्गुणं गुणभोक्तृ च
verses.iast:
sarvendriyaguṇābhāsaṃ sarvendriyavivarjitam |
asaktaṃ sarvabhṛccaiva nirguṇaṃ guṇabhoktṛ ca
verses.meaning: Enjoying every sense, yet senseless. Detached, yet upholding all. Quality-free, yet tasting qualities.
verses.takeaway: Every paradox holds hands here.

verses.devanagari:
बहिरन्तश्च भूतानामचरं चरमेव च ।
सूक्ष्मत्वात्तदविज्ञेयं दूरस्थं चान्तिके च तत्
verses.iast:
bahirantaśca bhūtānāmacaraṃ carameva ca |
sūkṣmatvāttadavijñeyaṃ dūrasthaṃ cāntike ca tat
verses.meaning: Inside all, outside all. Moving and unmoving. Too subtle to grasp. Farther than far, nearer than near.
verses.takeaway: The geography of the infinite.

verses.devanagari:
अविभक्तं च भूतेषु विभक्तमिव च स्थितम् ।
भूतभर्तृ च तज्ज्ञेयं ग्रसिष्णु प्रभविष्णु च
verses.iast:
avibhaktaṃ ca bhūteṣu vibhaktamiva ca sthitam |
bhūtabhartṛ ca tajjñeyaṃ grasiṣṇu prabhaviṣṇu ca
verses.meaning: Undivided, yet seemingly divided among beings. To be known as sustainer, devourer, creator.
verses.takeaway: One actor, three roles, countless stages.

verses.devanagari:
ज्योतिषामपि तज्ज्योतिस्तमसः परमुच्यते ।
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं ज्ञानगम्यं हृदि सर्वस्य विष्ठितम्
verses.iast:
jyotiṣāmapi tajjyotistamasaḥ paramucyate |
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ jñānagamyaṃ hṛdi sarvasya viṣṭhitam
verses.meaning: Light of all lights, beyond darkness. Wisdom, its goal, its path — planted in every heart.
verses.takeaway: The lamp no darkness touches.

verses.devanagari:
इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः ।
मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते
verses.iast:
iti kṣetraṃ tathā jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ coktaṃ samāsataḥ |
madbhakta etadvijñāya madbhāvāyopapadyate
verses.meaning: Field, wisdom, and goal — thus declared in brief. My devotee who grasps this grows fit for oneness with Me.
verses.takeaway: Summary plus fitness certificate.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्ध्यनादी उभावपि ।
विकारांश्च गुणांश्चैव विद्धि प्रकृतिसंभवान्
verses.iast:
prakṛtiṃ puruṣaṃ caiva viddhyanādī ubhāvapi |
vikārāṃśca guṇāṃścaiva viddhi prakṛtisaṃbhavān
verses.meaning: Know this: both nature and spirit are beginningless. And every change and mood is born of nature.
verses.takeaway: Two eternals. One source of change.

verses.devanagari:
कार्यकरणकर्तृत्वे हेतुः प्रकृतिरुच्यते ।
पुरुषः सुखदुःखानां भोक्तृत्वे हेतुरुच्यते
verses.iast:
kāryakaraṇakartṛtve hetuḥ prakṛtirucyate |
puruṣaḥ sukhaduḥkhānāṃ bhoktṛtve heturucyate
verses.meaning: Nature drives the body and senses to act. Spirit experiences pleasure and pain.
verses.takeaway: Doer and feeler, distinguished.

verses.devanagari:
पुरुषः प्रकृतिस्थो हि भुङ्‌क्ते प्रकृतिजान्गुणान् ।
कारणं गुणसङ्गोऽस्य सदसद्योनिजन्मसु
verses.iast:
puruṣaḥ prakṛtistho hi bhuṅ‌kte prakṛtijānguṇān |
kāraṇaṃ guṇasaṅgo'sya sadasadyonijanmasu
verses.meaning: Spirit wedded to nature tastes nature's moods. Clinging to them decides the next womb, high or low.
verses.takeaway: Taste determines rebirth. Choose flavors wisely.

verses.devanagari:
उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः ।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः
verses.iast:
upadraṣṭānumantā ca bhartā bhoktā maheśvaraḥ |
paramātmeti cāpyukto dehe'sminpuruṣaḥ paraḥ
verses.meaning: Yet spirit in the body is also witness, approver, supporter, experiencer. Great Lord. Supreme Self.
verses.takeaway: The lodger is also the landlord.

verses.devanagari:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह ।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स भूयोऽभिजायते
verses.iast:
ya evaṃ vetti puruṣaṃ prakṛtiṃ ca guṇaiḥ saha |
sarvathā vartamāno'pi na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate
verses.meaning: Whoever truly knows spirit, nature, and nature's moods is never reborn. Whatever life one leads.
verses.takeaway: Knowledge voids the return ticket.

verses.devanagari:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना ।
अन्ये सांख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे
verses.iast:
dhyānenātmani paśyanti kecidātmānamātmanā |
anye sāṃkhyena yogena karmayogena cāpare
verses.meaning: Some see the Self by meditation. Some by philosophy. Some by selfless action.
verses.takeaway: Three doors, one room.

verses.devanagari:
अन्ये त्वेवमजानन्तः श्रुत्वान्येभ्य उपासते ।
तेऽपि चातितरन्त्येव मृत्युं श्रुतिपरायणाः
verses.iast:
anye tvevamajānantaḥ śrutvānyebhya upāsate |
te'pi cātitarantyeva mṛtyuṃ śrutiparāyaṇāḥ
verses.meaning: Others only hear the teaching and trust it, devoted. They too cross beyond death.
verses.takeaway: Hearing with faith also saves.

verses.devanagari:
यावत्संजायते किंचित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ
verses.iast:
yāvatsaṃjāyate kiṃcitsattvaṃ sthāvarajaṅgamam |
kṣetrakṣetrajñasaṃyogāttadviddhi bharatarṣabha
verses.meaning: Whatever lives and moves or stands still is born of the field meeting its knower.
verses.takeaway: Every birth has two parents.

verses.devanagari:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम् ।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति
verses.iast:
samaṃ sarveṣu bhūteṣu tiṣṭhantaṃ parameśvaram |
vinaśyatsvavinaśyantaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati
verses.meaning: Who sees the supreme Lord dwelling equally in all beings — undying amid the dying — truly sees.
verses.takeaway: Equal sight is true sight.

verses.devanagari:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम् ।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.iast:
samaṃ paśyanhi sarvatra samavasthitamīśvaram |
na hinastyātmanātmānaṃ tato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: Seeing the Lord the same everywhere harms not the self by the self. Then comes the highest goal.
verses.takeaway: The seer is safe from himself.

verses.devanagari:
प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि क्रियमाणानि सर्वशः ।
यः पश्यति तथात्मानमकर्तारं स पश्यति
verses.iast:
prakṛtyaiva ca karmāṇi kriyamāṇāni sarvaśaḥ |
yaḥ paśyati tathātmānamakartāraṃ sa paśyati
verses.meaning: Who sees all acts done by nature alone — and the self as no doer — truly sees.
verses.takeaway: The non-doer doctrine, stated cleanly.

verses.devanagari:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति ।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म संपद्यते तदा
verses.iast:
yadā bhūtapṛthagbhāvamekasthamanupaśyati |
tata eva ca vistāraṃ brahma saṃpadyate tadā
verses.meaning: Seeing all separate beings rooted in One. Spreading from One. One becomes the ultimate.
verses.takeaway: Many branches. One trunk. One arrival.

verses.devanagari:
अनादित्वान्निर्गुणत्वात्परमात्मायमव्ययः ।
शरीरस्थोऽपि कौन्तेय न करोति न लिप्यते
verses.iast:
anāditvānnirguṇatvātparamātmāyamavyayaḥ |
śarīrastho'pi kaunteya na karoti na lipyate
verses.meaning: The imperishable Self is beginningless. Beyond qualities. Lodged in the body. It neither acts nor stains.
verses.takeaway: Present everywhere. Guilty nowhere.

verses.devanagari:
यथा सर्वगतं सौक्ष्म्यादाकाशं नोपलिप्यते ।
सर्वत्रावस्थितो देहे तथात्मा नोपलिप्यते
verses.iast:
yathā sarvagataṃ saukṣmyādākāśaṃ nopalipyate |
sarvatrāvasthito dehe tathātmā nopalipyate
verses.meaning: All-pervading space stays unstained. So the Self in every body stays unstained.
verses.takeaway: Space never gets dirty. Neither do you.

verses.devanagari:
यथा प्रकाशयत्येकः कृत्स्नं लोकमिमं रविः ।
क्षेत्रं क्षेत्री तथा कृत्स्नं प्रकाशयति भारत
verses.iast:
yathā prakāśayatyekaḥ kṛtsnaṃ lokamimaṃ raviḥ |
kṣetraṃ kṣetrī tathā kṛtsnaṃ prakāśayati bhārata
verses.meaning: As one sun lights the whole world, the knower lights the entire field.
verses.takeaway: One lamp per universe. It suffices.

verses.devanagari:
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोरेवमन्तरं ज्ञानचक्षुषा ।
भूतप्रकृतिमोक्षं च ये विदुर्यान्ति ते परम्
verses.iast:
kṣetrakṣetrajñayorevamantaraṃ jñānacakṣuṣā |
bhūtaprakṛtimokṣaṃ ca ye viduryānti te param
verses.meaning: Seeing with wisdom's eye the field-knower divide — and beings freed from nature — one reaches the supreme.
verses.takeaway: The final distinction. Then no more distinctions.

verses.devanagari: यज्ज्ञात्वा मुनयः सर्वे परां सिद्धिमितो गताः
verses.iast: yajjñātvā munayaḥ sarve parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: again I declare the highest wisdom. Learning it, all sages reached perfection.
verses.takeaway: The encore of all encores.

verses.devanagari:
इदं ज्ञानमुपाश्रित्य मम साधर्म्यमागताः ।
सर्गेऽपि नोपजायन्ते प्रलये न व्यथन्ति च
verses.iast:
idaṃ jñānamupāśritya mama sādharmyamāgatāḥ |
sarge'pi nopajāyante pralaye na vyathanti ca
verses.meaning: Rooted in this wisdom, united with My essence. No birth at creation. No pain at dissolution.
verses.takeaway: Beyond the cosmic schedule entirely.

verses.devanagari:
मम योनिर्महद्ब्रह्म तस्मिन्गर्भं दधाम्यहम् ।
संभवः सर्वभूतानां ततो भवति भारत
verses.iast:
mama yonirmahadbrahma tasmingarbhaṃ dadhāmyaham |
saṃbhavaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tato bhavati bhārata
verses.meaning: The great expanse is My womb. I plant the seed. From this union, all beings are born.
verses.takeaway: Cosmology in three lines.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वयोनिषु कौन्तेय मूर्तयः संभवन्ति याः ।
तासां ब्रह्म महद्योनिरहं बीजप्रदः पिता
verses.iast:
sarvayoniṣu kaunteya mūrtayaḥ saṃbhavanti yāḥ |
tāsāṃ brahma mahadyonirahaṃ bījapradaḥ pitā
verses.meaning: Whatever forms emerge from any womb — the expanse is mother, and I am the seed-giving father.
verses.takeaway: One fatherhood, countless wombs.

verses.devanagari:
सत्त्वं रजस्तम इति गुणाः प्रकृतिसंभवाः ।
निबध्नन्ति महाबाहो देहे देहिनमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
sattvaṃ rajastama iti guṇāḥ prakṛtisaṃbhavāḥ |
nibadhnanti mahābāho dehe dehinamavyayam
verses.meaning: Clarity, passion, inertia. Nature's three moods. They bind the undying self inside the body.
verses.takeaway: Three ropes. One prisoner who is free.

verses.devanagari:
तत्र सत्त्वं निर्मलत्वात्प्रकाशकमनामयम् ।
सुखसङ्गेन बध्नाति ज्ञानसङ्गेन चानघ
verses.iast:
tatra sattvaṃ nirmalatvātprakāśakamanāmayam |
sukhasaṅgena badhnāti jñānasaṅgena cānagha
verses.meaning: Clarity, pure and luminous, free of stain, binds through joy and wisdom.
verses.takeaway: The golden chain is still a chain.

verses.devanagari:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम् ।
तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्
verses.iast:
rajo rāgātmakaṃ viddhi tṛṣṇāsaṅgasamudbhavam |
tannibadhnāti kaunteya karmasaṅgena dehinam
verses.meaning: Passion is thirst — born of craving and clinging. It binds the embodied through endless doing.
verses.takeaway: Thirst that drinks effort.

verses.devanagari:
तमस्त्वज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम् ।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत
verses.iast:
tamastvajñānajaṃ viddhi mohanaṃ sarvadehinām |
pramādālasyanidrābhistannibadhnāti bhārata
verses.meaning: Inertia is ignorance-born. It deludes every embodied being. It binds through neglect, laziness, and sleep.
verses.takeaway: The heaviest chain feels like a blanket.

verses.devanagari:
सत्त्वं सुखे संजयति रजः कर्मणि भारत ।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे संजयत्युत
verses.iast:
sattvaṃ sukhe saṃjayati rajaḥ karmaṇi bhārata |
jñānamāvṛtya tu tamaḥ pramāde saṃjayatyuta
verses.meaning: Clarity pulls toward joy. Passion toward action. Inertia veils wisdom and pulls toward neglect.
verses.takeaway: Three magnets. Know which pulls you.

verses.devanagari:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत ।
रजः सत्त्वं तमश्चैव तमः सत्त्वं रजस्तथा
verses.iast:
rajastamaścābhibhūya sattvaṃ bhavati bhārata |
rajaḥ sattvaṃ tamaścaiva tamaḥ sattvaṃ rajastathā
verses.meaning: Each mood rules when the other two recede. Clarity, then passion, then inertia — by turns.
verses.takeaway: The inner weather cycle.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते ।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धं सत्त्वमित्युत
verses.iast:
sarvadvāreṣu dehe'sminprakāśa upajāyate |
jñānaṃ yadā tadā vidyādvivṛddhaṃ sattvamityuta
verses.meaning: When every sense-door shines with understanding. Clarity is on the throne.
verses.takeaway: The diagnostic: light at all gates.

verses.devanagari:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामशमः स्पृहा ।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ
verses.iast:
lobhaḥ pravṛttirārambhaḥ karmaṇāmaśamaḥ spṛhā |
rajasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe bharatarṣabha
verses.meaning: Greed, drive, restless doing, discontent, craving — these mark the reign of passion.
verses.takeaway: The diagnostic: hunger in motion.

verses.devanagari:
अप्रकाशोऽप्रवृत्तिश्च प्रमादो मोह एव च ।
तमस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे कुरुनन्दन
verses.iast:
aprakāśo'pravṛttiśca pramādo moha eva ca |
tamasyetāni jāyante vivṛddhe kurunandana
verses.meaning: Dimness, inertia, neglect, confusion. These mark the reign of inertia.
verses.takeaway: The diagnostic: lights out.

verses.devanagari:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत् ।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकानमलान्प्रतिपद्यते
verses.iast:
yadā sattve pravṛddhe tu pralayaṃ yāti dehabhṛt |
tadottamavidāṃ lokānamalānpratipadyate
verses.meaning: Dying in clarity, one reaches the pure worlds of the wise.
verses.takeaway: The final mood decides the address.

verses.devanagari:
रजसि प्रलयं गत्वा कर्मसङ्गिषु जायते ।
तथा प्रलीनस्तमसि मूढयोनिषु जायते
verses.iast:
rajasi pralayaṃ gatvā karmasaṅgiṣu jāyate |
tathā pralīnastamasi mūḍhayoniṣu jāyate
verses.meaning: Dying in passion, one is reborn among the driven. Dying in inertia, among the ignorant.
verses.takeaway: Death is a sorting, not an ending.

verses.devanagari:
कर्मणः सुकृतस्याहुः सात्त्विकं निर्मलं फलम् ।
रजसस्तु फलं दुःखमज्ञानं तमसः फलम्
verses.iast:
karmaṇaḥ sukṛtasyāhuḥ sāttvikaṃ nirmalaṃ phalam |
rajasastu phalaṃ duḥkhamajñānaṃ tamasaḥ phalam
verses.meaning: Good acts ripen into purity. Passionate acts into pain. Inert acts into darkness.
verses.takeaway: Harvest law. No exceptions.

verses.devanagari:
सत्त्वात्संजायते ज्ञानं रजसो लोभ एव च ।
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च
verses.iast:
sattvātsaṃjāyate jñānaṃ rajaso lobha eva ca |
pramādamohau tamaso bhavato'jñānameva ca
verses.meaning: Clarity yields wisdom. Passion yields greed. Inertia yields neglect, confusion, darkness.
verses.takeaway: Each mood manufactures its own mind.

verses.devanagari:
ऊर्ध्वं गच्छन्ति सत्त्वस्था मध्ये तिष्ठन्ति राजसाः ।
जघन्यगुणवृत्तिस्था अधो गच्छन्ति तामसाः
verses.iast:
ūrdhvaṃ gacchanti sattvasthā madhye tiṣṭhanti rājasāḥ |
jaghanyaguṇavṛttisthā adho gacchanti tāmasāḥ
verses.meaning: The clear rise upward. The passionate stay midway. The inert sink down.
verses.takeaway: Three elevators. Check which you boarded.

verses.devanagari:
नान्यं गुणेभ्यः कर्तारं यदा द्रष्टानुपश्यति ।
गुणेभ्यश्च परं वेत्ति मद्भावं सोऽधिगच्छति
verses.iast:
nānyaṃ guṇebhyaḥ kartāraṃ yadā draṣṭānupaśyati |
guṇebhyaśca paraṃ vetti madbhāvaṃ so'dhigacchati
verses.meaning: Who sees moods alone as the doers — and knows what stands beyond moods — enters My essence.
verses.takeaway: Watch the play. Know the watcher. Merge.

verses.devanagari:
गुणानेतानतीत्य त्रीन्देही देहसमुद्भवान् ।
जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्विमुक्तोऽमृतमश्नुते
verses.iast:
guṇānetānatītya trīndehī dehasamudbhavān |
janmamṛtyujarāduḥkhairvimukto'mṛtamaśnute
verses.meaning: Rising past the three moods that build the body, one gains deathlessness — free of birth, age, and sorrow.
verses.takeaway: Transcendence has a precise address.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
कैर्लिङ्गैस्त्रीन्गुणानेतानतीतो भवति प्रभो ।
किमाचारः कथं चैतांस्त्रीन्गुणानतिवर्तते
verses.iast:
kairliṅgaistrīnguṇānetānatīto bhavati prabho |
kimācāraḥ kathaṃ caitāṃstrīnguṇānativartate
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: what marks one past the moods? How does such a one live? How transcend them?
verses.takeaway: Three questions. The chapter's second half answers.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
प्रकाशं च प्रवृत्तिं च मोहमेव च पाण्डव ।
न द्वेष्टि संप्रवृत्तानि न निवृत्तानि काङ्क्षति
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
prakāśaṃ ca pravṛttiṃ ca mohameva ca pāṇḍava |
na dveṣṭi saṃpravṛttāni na nivṛttāni kāṅkṣati
verses.meaning: Krishna said: meet clarity, drive, and delusion. Without hatred at their coming. Nor craving at their going.
verses.takeaway: Welcome neither. Chase neither.

verses.devanagari:
उदासीनवदासीनो गुणैर्यो न विचाल्यते ।
गुणा वर्तन्त इत्येव योऽवतिष्ठति नेङ्गते
verses.iast:
udāsīnavadāsīno guṇairyo na vicālyate |
guṇā vartanta ityeva yo'vatiṣṭhati neṅgate
verses.meaning: who sits aside, unshaken, steady, watching moods as mere moods —
verses.takeaway: The spectator simile, lived.

verses.devanagari:
समदुःखसुखः स्वस्थः समलोष्टाश्मकाञ्चनः ।
तुल्यप्रियाप्रियो धीरस्तुल्यनिन्दात्मसंस्तुतिः
verses.iast:
samaduḥkhasukhaḥ svasthaḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāñcanaḥ |
tulyapriyāpriyo dhīrastulyanindātmasaṃstutiḥ
verses.meaning: self-contained, same in joy and pain, same toward clod, stone, and gold, steady through praise and blame —
verses.takeaway: Equality training, item by item.

verses.devanagari:
मानापमानयोस्तुल्यस्तुल्यो मित्रारिपक्षयोः ।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी गुणातीतः स उच्यते
verses.iast:
mānāpamānayostulyastulyo mitrāripakṣayoḥ |
sarvārambhaparityāgī guṇātītaḥ sa ucyate
verses.meaning: Same in honor and disgrace. Same to friend and foe. Abandoning all selfish schemes. Such a one has transcended.
verses.takeaway: The full portrait. Nothing decorative.

verses.devanagari:
मां च योऽव्यभिचारेण भक्तियोगेन सेवते ।
स गुणान्समतीत्यैतान्ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.iast:
māṃ ca yo'vyabhicāreṇa bhaktiyogena sevate |
sa guṇānsamatītyaitānbrahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.meaning: And whoever serves Me with undivided love rises past all moods. Fit for oneness with ultimate reality.
verses.takeaway: Love outranks analysis. Stated, not argued.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मणो हि प्रतिष्ठाहममृतस्याव्ययस्य च ।
शाश्वतस्य च धर्मस्य सुखस्यैकान्तिकस्य च
verses.iast:
brahmaṇo hi pratiṣṭhāhamamṛtasyāvyayasya ca |
śāśvatasya ca dharmasya sukhasyaikāntikasya ca
verses.meaning: For I am the home of the ultimate. Of deathless freedom. Eternal duty. Unbroken joy.
verses.takeaway: The chapter closes on the address itself.

verses.devanagari: छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्
verses.iast: chandāṃsi yasya parṇāni yastaṃ veda sa vedavit
verses.meaning: Krishna said: roots above, branches below. The timeless fig tree. Its leaves are hymns. Who knows it knows all sacred lore.
verses.takeaway: The upside-down tree. Roots in heaven.

verses.devanagari:
अधश्चोर्ध्वं प्रसृतास्तस्य शाखा
गुणप्रवृद्धा विषयप्रवालाः ।
अधश्च मूलान्यनुसंततानि
कर्मानुबन्धीनि मनुष्यलोके
verses.iast:
adhaścordhvaṃ prasṛtāstasya śākhā
guṇapravṛddhā viṣayapravālāḥ |
adhaśca mūlānyanusaṃtatāni
karmānubandhīni manuṣyaloke
verses.meaning: Its branches spread high and low, fed by nature's moods. Sense-objects are its shoots. Down in the human world, action-growing roots spread wide.
verses.takeaway: Botany as biography.

verses.devanagari:
न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते
नान्तो न चादिर्न च संप्रतिष्ठा ।
अश्वत्थमेनं सुविरूढमूल-
मसङ्गशस्त्रेण दृढेन छित्त्वा
verses.iast:
na rūpamasyeha tathopalabhyate
nānto na cādirna ca saṃpratiṣṭhā |
aśvatthamenaṃ suvirūḍhamūla-
masaṅgaśastreṇa dṛḍhena chittvā
verses.meaning: Neither its form, nor end, nor beginning, nor ground is seen here. So cut this deep-rooted tree with the tough axe of detachment.
verses.takeaway: Wield the axe. The tree is your own life.

verses.devanagari:
ततः पदं तत्परिमार्गितव्यं
यस्मिन्गता न निवर्तन्ति भूयः ।
तमेव चाद्यं पुरुषं प्रपद्ये
यतः प्रवृत्तिः प्रसृता पुराणी
verses.iast:
tataḥ padaṃ tatparimārgitavyaṃ
yasmingatā na nivartanti bhūyaḥ |
tameva cādyaṃ puruṣaṃ prapadye
yataḥ pravṛttiḥ prasṛtā purāṇī
verses.meaning: Then seek the place of no return — resting on the primal being from whom this ancient world-tree grew.
verses.takeaway: Cut, then seek. In that order.

verses.devanagari:
निर्मानमोहा जितसङ्गदोषा
अध्यात्मनित्या विनिवृत्तकामाः ।
द्वन्द्वैर्विमुक्ताः सुखदुःखसंज्ञै-
र्गच्छन्त्यमूढाः पदमव्ययं तत्
verses.iast:
nirmānamohā jitasaṅgadoṣā
adhyātmanityā vinivṛttakāmāḥ |
dvandvairvimuktāḥ sukhaduḥkhasaṃjñai-
rgacchantyamūḍhāḥ padamavyayaṃ tat
verses.meaning: The proud-free, delusion-free, attachment-conquered. Constant in self-knowledge. Wanting nothing. Beyond pleasure and pain. They reach the imperishable home, undeluded.
verses.takeaway: The passenger list for no-return.

verses.devanagari:
न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः ।
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम
verses.iast:
na tadbhāsayate sūryo na śaśāṅko na pāvakaḥ |
yadgatvā na nivartante taddhāma paramaṃ mama
verses.meaning: Neither sun, nor moon, nor fire lights that highest home of Mine. Going there, none return.
verses.takeaway: Unlit by every known light.

verses.devanagari:
ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः ।
मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति
verses.iast:
mamaivāṃśo jīvaloke jīvabhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ |
manaḥṣaṣṭhānīndriyāṇi prakṛtisthāni karṣati
verses.meaning: A spark of Me becomes the living soul in this mortal world — drawing mind and five senses along.
verses.takeaway: You are a fragment of the infinite, gathering instruments.

verses.devanagari:
शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतीश्वरः ।
गृहीत्वैतानि संयाति वायुर्गन्धानिवाशयात्
verses.iast:
śarīraṃ yadavāpnoti yaccāpyutkrāmatīśvaraḥ |
gṛhītvaitāni saṃyāti vāyurgandhānivāśayāt
verses.meaning: Moving house between bodies, the soul carries its senses along — as wind carries scent from flowers.
verses.takeaway: The gentlest simile for transmigration.

verses.devanagari:
श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च ।
अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते
verses.iast:
śrotraṃ cakṣuḥ sparśanaṃ ca rasanaṃ ghrāṇameva ca |
adhiṣṭhāya manaścāyaṃ viṣayānupasevate
verses.meaning: Through ear, eye, touch, taste, smell, and mind, the soul enjoys the sense-world.
verses.takeaway: Six windows. One watcher.

verses.devanagari:
उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वापि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम् ।
विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः
verses.iast:
utkrāmantaṃ sthitaṃ vāpi bhuñjānaṃ vā guṇānvitam |
vimūḍhā nānupaśyanti paśyanti jñānacakṣuṣaḥ
verses.meaning: The deluded never notice the soul arriving, leaving, or enjoying. Those with wisdom's eyes see.
verses.takeaway: Eyesight, not absence, is the issue.

verses.devanagari:
यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम् ।
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः
verses.iast:
yatanto yoginaścainaṃ paśyantyātmanyavasthitam |
yatanto'pyakṛtātmāno nainaṃ paśyantyacetasaḥ
verses.meaning: Striving seers perceive the soul within. The unrefined and undiscerning never do — strive as they might.
verses.takeaway: Effort without refinement misses.

verses.devanagari:
यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम् ।
यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्
verses.iast:
yadādityagataṃ tejo jagadbhāsayate'khilam |
yaccandramasi yaccāgnau tattejo viddhi māmakam
verses.meaning: The light in sun, moon, and fire that fills the world — know that glory as Mine.
verses.takeaway: Every photon on loan.

verses.devanagari:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा ।
पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसात्मकः
verses.iast:
gāmāviśya ca bhūtāni dhārayāmyahamojasā |
puṣṇāmi cauṣadhīḥ sarvāḥ somo bhūtvā rasātmakaḥ
verses.meaning: I enter the earth and uphold all life. As the moon, I feed every plant.
verses.takeaway: Support from below, nourishment from above.

verses.devanagari:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः ।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्
verses.iast:
ahaṃ vaiśvānaro bhūtvā prāṇināṃ dehamāśritaḥ |
prāṇāpānasamāyuktaḥ pacāmyannaṃ caturvidham
verses.meaning: As digestive fire in every body. Joined with every breath. I cook all four kinds of food.
verses.takeaway: The eater behind every eating.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि संनिविष्टो
मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च ।
वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो
वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्
verses.iast:
sarvasya cāhaṃ hṛdi saṃniviṣṭo
mattaḥ smṛtirjñānamapohanaṃ ca |
vedaiśca sarvairahameva vedyo
vedāntakṛdvedavideva cāham
verses.meaning: I sit in every heart — source of memory, wisdom, and forgetting. I am the meaning of all scriptures, their author, their knower.
verses.takeaway: Memory, meaning, and their erasure — one resident.

verses.devanagari:
द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च ।
क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते
verses.iast:
dvāvimau puruṣau loke kṣaraścākṣara eva ca |
kṣaraḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni kūṭastho'kṣara ucyate
verses.meaning: Two persons walk this world: the perishable many and the imperishable one.
verses.takeaway: The census has two entries.

verses.devanagari:
उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्यः परमात्मेत्युदाहृतः ।
यो लोकत्रयमाविश्य बिभर्त्यव्यय ईश्वरः
verses.iast:
uttamaḥ puruṣastvanyaḥ paramātmetyudāhṛtaḥ |
yo lokatrayamāviśya bibhartyavyaya īśvaraḥ
verses.meaning: Beyond both stands the highest Self — the undying Lord filling three worlds, upholding all.
verses.takeaway: The third who transcends the pair.

verses.devanagari:
यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि चोत्तमः ।
अतोऽस्मि लोके वेदे च प्रथितः पुरुषोत्तमः
verses.iast:
yasmātkṣaramatīto'hamakṣarādapi cottamaḥ |
ato'smi loke vede ca prathitaḥ puruṣottamaḥ
verses.meaning: Transcending the perishable. Surpassing even the imperishable. I am famed as the highest Person. In scripture and world.
verses.takeaway: The name above both names.

verses.devanagari:
यो मामेवमसंमूढो जानाति पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
स सर्वविद्भजति मां सर्वभावेन भारत
verses.iast:
yo māmevamasaṃmūḍho jānāti puruṣottamam |
sa sarvavidbhajati māṃ sarvabhāvena bhārata
verses.meaning: Whoever knows Me thus, undeluded — highest Person — worships Me wholly, knowing all.
verses.takeaway: One recognition. Total worship. Full knowledge.

verses.devanagari:
इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ ।
एतद्‌बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत
verses.iast:
iti guhyatamaṃ śāstramidamuktaṃ mayānagha |
etad‌buddhvā buddhimānsyātkṛtakṛtyaśca bhārata
verses.meaning: Thus I have taught the most hidden teaching. Grasp it and all is done; wisdom is won.
verses.takeaway: The diploma verse. Course complete — for this chapter.

verses.devanagari: दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्
verses.iast: dānaṃ damaśca yajñaśca svādhyāyastapa ārjavam
verses.meaning: Krishna said: fearlessness, pure heart. Steady wisdom-seeking. Generosity, restraint, sacrifice. Study, discipline, honesty.
verses.takeaway: The divine inventory opens.

verses.devanagari:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम् ।
दया भूतेष्वलोलुप्त्वं मार्दवं ह्रीरचापलम्
verses.iast:
ahiṃsā satyamakrodhastyāgaḥ śāntirapaiśunam |
dayā bhūteṣvaloluptvaṃ mārdavaṃ hrīracāpalam
verses.meaning: Harmlessness, truth, calm anger. Charity, peace, no backbiting. Pity for all beings.
verses.takeaway: Virtues two through eleven.

verses.devanagari:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिः शौचमद्रोहो नातिमानिता ।
भवन्ति संपदं दैवीमभिजातस्य भारत
verses.iast:
tejaḥ kṣamā dhṛtiḥ śaucamadroho nātimānitā |
bhavanti saṃpadaṃ daivīmabhijātasya bhārata
verses.meaning: No greed, gentleness, modesty, no idleness. Nobility, forgiveness, courage, purity. No cruelty, no conceit. These mark the heaven-born.
verses.takeaway: The list closes. The birthmark named.

verses.devanagari:
दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च ।
अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ संपदमासुरीम्
verses.iast:
dambho darpo'bhimānaśca krodhaḥ pāruṣyameva ca |
ajñānaṃ cābhijātasya pārtha saṃpadamāsurīm
verses.meaning: Show, pride, conceit, anger. Harshness and ignorance. These mark the demon-born.
verses.takeaway: Six stains. Short verse, long shadow.

verses.devanagari:
दैवी संपद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता ।
मा शुचः संपदं दैवीमभिजातोऽसि पाण्डव
verses.iast:
daivī saṃpadvimokṣāya nibandhāyāsurī matā |
mā śucaḥ saṃpadaṃ daivīmabhijāto'si pāṇḍava
verses.meaning: The divine leads outward to freedom. The demonic inward to chains. Do not grieve — you are heaven-born.
verses.takeaway: Two doors. Your birth chose correctly.

verses.devanagari:
द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च ।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु
verses.iast:
dvau bhūtasargau loke'smindaiva āsura eva ca |
daivo vistaraśaḥ prokta āsuraṃ pārtha me śṛṇu
verses.meaning: Two races walk this world: the divine and the demonic. The divine you know. Now hear the demonic.
verses.takeaway: The chapter's subject turns.

verses.devanagari:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः ।
न शौचं नापि चाचारो न सत्यं तेषु विद्यते
verses.iast:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca janā na vidurāsurāḥ |
na śaucaṃ nāpi cācāro na satyaṃ teṣu vidyate
verses.meaning: They know neither right action nor restraint. Neither purity, nor honor, nor truth lives in them.
verses.takeaway: Four absences define the type.

verses.devanagari:
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम् ।
अपरस्परसंभूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्
verses.iast:
asatyamapratiṣṭhaṃ te jagadāhuranīśvaram |
aparasparasaṃbhūtaṃ kimanyatkāmahaitukam
verses.meaning: The universe, they say, is lawless, lordless, truthless. Lust-begotten and nothing more.
verses.takeaway: The philosophy of appetite.

verses.devanagari:
एतां दृष्टिमवष्टभ्य नष्टात्मानोऽल्पबुद्धयः ।
प्रभवन्त्युग्रकर्माणः क्षयाय जगतोऽहिताः
verses.iast:
etāṃ dṛṣṭimavaṣṭabhya naṣṭātmāno'lpabuddhayaḥ |
prabhavantyugrakarmāṇaḥ kṣayāya jagato'hitāḥ
verses.meaning: Wrecked selves, small minds, cruel deeds. Holding this view, they are born to ruin the world.
verses.takeaway: Ideas have casualties.

verses.devanagari:
काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः ।
मोहाद्‌गृहीत्वासद्ग्राहान्प्रवर्तन्तेऽशुचिव्रताः
verses.iast:
kāmamāśritya duṣpūraṃ dambhamānamadānvitāḥ |
mohād‌gṛhītvāsadgrāhānpravartante'śucivratāḥ
verses.meaning: Insatiable craving, drunk on ego and display. Clutching falsehoods, they pledge themselves to filthy rites.
verses.takeaway: Hunger that calls itself worship.

verses.devanagari:
चिन्तामपरिमेयां च प्रलयान्तामुपाश्रिताः ।
कामोपभोगपरमा एतावदिति निश्चिताः
verses.iast:
cintāmaparimeyāṃ ca pralayāntāmupāśritāḥ |
kāmopabhogaparamā etāvaditi niścitāḥ
verses.meaning: Endless anxieties ending only at death. Pleasure as the highest good. 'This much is everything' — so they decide.
verses.takeaway: The creed of the closed horizon.

verses.devanagari:
आशापाशशतैर्बद्धाः कामक्रोधपरायणाः ।
ईहन्ते कामभोगार्थमन्यायेनार्थसञ्चयान्
verses.iast:
āśāpāśaśatairbaddhāḥ kāmakrodhaparāyaṇāḥ |
īhante kāmabhogārthamanyāyenārthasañcayān
verses.meaning: Netted in a hundred hopes, enslaved to lust and rage, they hoard wealth unjustly to feed desire.
verses.takeaway: Hope as a hunting net.

verses.devanagari:
इदमद्य मया लब्धमिमं प्राप्स्ये मनोरथम् ।
इदमस्तीदमपि मे भविष्यति पुनर्धनम्
verses.iast:
idamadya mayā labdhamimaṃ prāpsye manoratham |
idamastīdamapi me bhaviṣyati punardhanam
verses.meaning: 'I won this today. That wish comes next. This wealth is mine — and that will be too.'
verses.takeaway: The autobiography of greed, first person.

verses.devanagari:
असौ मया हतः शत्रुर्हनिष्ये चापरानपि ।
ईश्वरोऽहमहं भोगी सिद्धोऽहं बलवान्सुखी
verses.iast:
asau mayā hataḥ śatrurhaniṣye cāparānapi |
īśvaro'hamahaṃ bhogī siddho'haṃ balavānsukhī
verses.meaning: 'I killed this foe. I will kill the rest. I am lord, enjoyer, perfect, strong, happy. Highborn. Who compares? I will sacrifice, give, and feast.'
verses.takeaway: Ego reciting its own liturgy.

verses.devanagari:
आढ्योऽभिजनवानस्मि कोऽन्योऽस्ति सदृशो मया ।
यक्ष्ये दास्यामि मोदिष्य इत्यज्ञानविमोहिताः
verses.iast:
āḍhyo'bhijanavānasmi ko'nyo'sti sadṛśo mayā |
yakṣye dāsyāmi modiṣya ityajñānavimohitāḥ
verses.meaning: Deluded, storm-tossed by schemes, meshed in confusion. Wedded to pleasure. Down they slide into foul hell.
verses.takeaway: The descent, stage by stage.

verses.devanagari:
अनेकचित्तविभ्रान्ता मोहजालसमावृताः ।
प्रसक्ताः कामभोगेषु पतन्ति नरकेऽशुचौ
verses.iast:
anekacittavibhrāntā mohajālasamāvṛtāḥ |
prasaktāḥ kāmabhogeṣu patanti narake'śucau
verses.meaning: Self-worshipping, stubborn, drunk on wealth and pride. Their rites are theater, against every rule.
verses.takeaway: Piety as costume.

verses.devanagari:
आत्मसंभाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः ।
यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्
verses.iast:
ātmasaṃbhāvitāḥ stabdhā dhanamānamadānvitāḥ |
yajante nāmayajñaiste dambhenāvidhipūrvakam
verses.meaning: Clutching ego, force, arrogance, lust, and rage — they hate Me in their own flesh and in others'.
verses.takeaway: Hatred of God begins as hatred of neighbor.

verses.devanagari:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः ।
मामात्मपरदेहेषु प्रद्विषन्तोऽभ्यसूयकाः
verses.iast:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ ca saṃśritāḥ |
māmātmaparadeheṣu pradviṣanto'bhyasūyakāḥ
verses.meaning: These cruel, vile, lowest enemies I hurl. Again and again into demonic wombs.
verses.takeaway: The sentence, pronounced plainly.

verses.devanagari:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रुरान्संसारेषु नराधमान् ।
क्षिपाम्यजस्रमशुभानासुरीष्वेव योनिषु
verses.iast:
tānahaṃ dviṣataḥ krurānsaṃsāreṣu narādhamān |
kṣipāmyajasramaśubhānāsurīṣveva yoniṣu
verses.meaning: Lost in womb after womb, they sink to the vilest state — never reaching Me.
verses.takeaway: The long road away.

verses.devanagari:
आसुरीं योनिमापन्ना मूढा जन्मनि जन्मनि ।
मामप्राप्यैव कौन्तेय ततो यान्त्यधमां गतिम्
verses.iast:
āsurīṃ yonimāpannā mūḍhā janmani janmani |
māmaprāpyaiva kaunteya tato yāntyadhamāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: Three gates open into this hell, ruinous to the self —
verses.takeaway: The diagnosis narrows to three.

verses.devanagari:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः ।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्
verses.iast:
trividhaṃ narakasyedaṃ dvāraṃ nāśanamātmanaḥ |
kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobhastasmādetattrayaṃ tyajet
verses.meaning: lust, anger, and greed. Abandon this triple gate.
verses.takeaway: Name them. Shun them.

verses.devanagari:
एतैर्विमुक्तः कौन्तेय तमोद्वारैस्त्रिभिर्नरः ।
आचरत्यात्मनः श्रेयस्ततो याति परां गतिम्
verses.iast:
etairvimuktaḥ kaunteya tamodvāraistribhirnaraḥ |
ācaratyātmanaḥ śreyastato yāti parāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: Freed from these three doors of darkness, one works out one's own rescue — and climbs to the highest goal.
verses.takeaway: The exit posted clearly.

verses.devanagari:
यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः ।
न स सिद्धिमवाप्नोति न सुखं न परां गतिम्
verses.iast:
yaḥ śāstravidhimutsṛjya vartate kāmakārataḥ |
na sa siddhimavāpnoti na sukhaṃ na parāṃ gatim
verses.meaning: Who discards scripture and follows craving reaches nothing. Neither perfection, nor joy, nor the goal.
verses.takeaway: Unguided appetite arrives nowhere.

verses.devanagari:
तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ ।
ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि
verses.iast:
tasmācchāstraṃ pramāṇaṃ te kāryākāryavyavasthitau |
jñātvā śāstravidhānoktaṃ karma kartumihārhasi
verses.meaning: So let scripture judge what to do and what to shun. Know its rule — then act in this world.
verses.takeaway: The closing gavel: the rulebook stands.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः ।
तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः
verses.iast:
ye śāstravidhimutsṛjya yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ |
teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvamāho rajastamaḥ
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: some worship with faith. But ditch scripture's rules. Clarity, passion, or inertia?
verses.takeaway: Faith without a rulebook. What governs it?

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा ।
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
trividhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāvajā |
sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu
verses.meaning: Krishna said: faith runs threefold, born of one's nature — clear, passionate, or dark. Hear how.
verses.takeaway: Nature writes the faith. Listen for yours.

verses.devanagari:
सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत ।
श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः
verses.iast:
sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata |
śraddhāmayo'yaṃ puruṣo yo yacchraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ
verses.meaning: Each person's faith mirrors their being. As the faith, so the faithful.
verses.takeaway: You are what you trust.

verses.devanagari:
यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः ।
प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः
verses.iast:
yajante sāttvikā devānyakṣarakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ |
pretānbhūtagaṇāṃścānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ
verses.meaning: The clear worship gods. The passionate worship spirits of power. The dark worship ghosts and ghouls.
verses.takeaway: Worship reveals the worshipper.

verses.devanagari:
अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः ।
दम्भाहंकारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः
verses.iast:
aśāstravihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ |
dambhāhaṃkārasaṃyuktāḥ kāmarāgabalānvitāḥ
verses.meaning: Fierce self-torture outside scripture. Stuffed with ego, craving, clinging, stubbornness. Know it as demonic resolve.
verses.takeaway: Pain is not piety by itself.

verses.devanagari:
कर्षयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः ।
मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान्
verses.iast:
karṣayantaḥ śarīrasthaṃ bhūtagrāmamacetasaḥ |
māṃ caivāntaḥśarīrasthaṃ tānviddhyāsuraniścayān
verses.meaning: Fools rack the body's frame. And Me within it. Pain mistaken for piety.
verses.takeaway: God lives in the tortured body too.

verses.devanagari:
आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः ।
यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु
verses.iast:
āhārastvapi sarvasya trividho bhavati priyaḥ |
yajñastapastathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedamimaṃ śṛṇu
verses.meaning: Food, ritual, discipline, and gifts — each runs threefold too. Hear the divisions.
verses.takeaway: The threefold lens turns to daily life.

verses.devanagari:
आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः ।
रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहाराः सात्त्विकप्रियाः
verses.iast:
āyuḥsattvabalārogyasukhaprītivivardhanāḥ |
rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārāḥ sāttvikapriyāḥ
verses.meaning: Fresh, nourishing, hearty, sweet. Strengthening, delightful. Food loved by the clear.
verses.takeaway: Eat like the person you want to be.

verses.devanagari:
कट्‌वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः ।
आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः
verses.iast:
kaṭ‌vamlalavaṇātyuṣṇatīkṣṇarūkṣavidāhinaḥ |
āhārā rājasasyeṣṭā duḥkhaśokāmayapradāḥ
verses.meaning: Bitter, sour, salty, scorching. Pungent, harsh, burning. Food craved by the passionate. Breeding pain and disease.
verses.takeaway: Fire on the plate, fire in the mind.

verses.devanagari:
यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत् ।
उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्
verses.iast:
yātayāmaṃ gatarasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat |
ucchiṣṭamapi cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasapriyam
verses.meaning: Cold, stale, tasteless, rotten. Impure, leftover. Food loved by the dark.
verses.takeaway: Dead food for a dimmed mind.

verses.devanagari:
अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते ।
यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः
verses.iast:
aphalākāṅkṣibhiryajño vidhidṛṣṭo ya ijyate |
yaṣṭavyameveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ
verses.meaning: Rite done as duty, by rule, without hunger for results — that ritual is clear.
verses.takeaway: Duty, not desire, lights the altar.

verses.devanagari:
अभिसंधाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत् ।
इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम्
verses.iast:
abhisaṃdhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārthamapi caiva yat |
ijyate bharataśreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam
verses.meaning: Rite done for rewards and reputation. Know that ritual as passionate.
verses.takeaway: Spectacle spoils sacrifice.

verses.devanagari:
विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम् ।
श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते
verses.iast:
vidhihīnamasṛṣṭānnaṃ mantrahīnamadakṣiṇam |
śraddhāvirahitaṃ yajñaṃ tāmasaṃ paricakṣate
verses.meaning: Rite against rule, without food-gifts, hymns, fees, or faith — that ritual is dark.
verses.takeaway: Empty ritual, voided warranty.

verses.devanagari:
देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम् ।
ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते
verses.iast:
devadvijaguruprājñapūjanaṃ śaucamārjavam |
brahmacaryamahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate
verses.meaning: Honoring gods, priests, teachers, sages. Cleanliness, honesty, continence, non-harm — this is bodily discipline.
verses.takeaway: The body trained in reverence.

verses.devanagari:
अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् ।
स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते
verses.iast:
anudvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priyahitaṃ ca yat |
svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ caiva vāṅmayaṃ tapa ucyate
verses.meaning: Speech that harms none — true, kind, useful — plus study of scripture: this is vocal discipline.
verses.takeaway: Four filters for every sentence.

verses.devanagari:
मनः प्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः ।
भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते
verses.iast:
manaḥ prasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunamātmavinigrahaḥ |
bhāvasaṃśuddhirityetattapo mānasamucyate
verses.meaning: Calm mind, gentle heart, silence, self-rule, pure intent: this is mental discipline.
verses.takeaway: The quietest austerity of all.

verses.devanagari:
श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्त्रिविधं नरैः ।
अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते
verses.iast:
śraddhayā parayā taptaṃ tapastattrividhaṃ naraiḥ |
aphalākāṅkṣibhiryuktaiḥ sāttvikaṃ paricakṣate
verses.meaning: This threefold discipline, done with full faith. Wanting nothing, devoted. Is called clear.
verses.takeaway: Three disciplines, one seal: selflessness.

verses.devanagari:
सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत् ।
क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम्
verses.iast:
satkāramānapūjārthaṃ tapo dambhena caiva yat |
kriyate tadiha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calamadhruvam
verses.meaning: Discipline done for respect and applause, unstable and fleeting — is called passionate.
verses.takeaway: An audience corrupts the austerity.

verses.devanagari:
मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः ।
परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.iast:
mūḍhagrāheṇātmano yatpīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ |
parasyotsādanārthaṃ vā tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.meaning: Discipline from delusion, self-torture, or meant to destroy another — is called dark.
verses.takeaway: Austerity weaponized is darkness.

verses.devanagari:
दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे ।
देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम्
verses.iast:
dātavyamiti yaddānaṃ dīyate'nupakāriṇe |
deśe kāle ca pātre ca taddānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam
verses.meaning: A gift given as duty, to one who cannot repay, at fit place and time, to a fit receiver — is clear.
verses.takeaway: The anatomy of a pure gift.

verses.devanagari:
यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः ।
दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम्
verses.iast:
yattu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalamuddiśya vā punaḥ |
dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ taddānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
verses.meaning: A gift given grudgingly. Expecting returns or rewards. Is passionate.
