verses.takeaway: Strings attached, merit detached.

verses.devanagari:
अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते ।
असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.iast:
adeśakāle yaddānamapātrebhyaśca dīyate |
asatkṛtamavajñātaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.meaning: A gift flung at the unworthy, wrong place, wrong time, with contempt — is dark.
verses.takeaway: Contempt cancels charity.

verses.devanagari:
ॐतत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः ।
ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा
verses.iast:
oṃtatsaditi nirdeśo brahmaṇastrividhaḥ smṛtaḥ |
brāhmaṇāstena vedāśca yajñāśca vihitāḥ purā
verses.meaning: Om, Tat, Sat — the triple name of the ultimate. From it, priests, scriptures, and rites were made of old.
verses.takeaway: Three syllables older than ritual itself.

verses.devanagari:
तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः ।
प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम्
verses.iast:
tasmādomityudāhṛtya yajñadānatapaḥkriyāḥ |
pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahmavādinām
verses.meaning: So all sacred acts begin with Om — rites, gifts, disciplines, by the book.
verses.takeaway: Open with Om. Always.

verses.devanagari:
तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः ।
दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः
verses.iast:
tadityanabhisandhāya phalaṃ yajñatapaḥkriyāḥ |
dānakriyāśca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣakāṅkṣibhiḥ
verses.meaning: Seekers of freedom act without wanting results, closing with Tat — 'that'.
verses.takeaway: Sign the act over to That.

verses.devanagari:
सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते ।
प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते
verses.iast:
sadbhāve sādhubhāve ca sadityetatprayujyate |
praśaste karmaṇi tathā sacchabdaḥ pārtha yujyate
verses.meaning: Sat means what is real and good. Every worthy act is Sat. Steadfastness in rite, discipline, and giving is Sat.
verses.takeaway: Goodness has a name. Use it.

verses.devanagari:
यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते ।
कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते
verses.iast:
yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ saditi cocyate |
karma caiva tadarthīyaṃ sadityevābhidhīyate
verses.meaning: And every act rooted in That — rite, gift, discipline — is also Sat.
verses.takeaway: Rooted in That, all acts are real.

verses.devanagari:
अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् ।
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह
verses.iast:
aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat |
asadityucyate pārtha na ca tatpretya no iha
verses.meaning: But whatever is offered, given, or suffered without faith is Asat. Unreal, worthless, here and hereafter.
verses.takeaway: Faithlessness voids every offering.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् ।
त्यागस्य च हृषीकेश पृथक्केशिनिषूदन
verses.iast:
saṃnyāsasya mahābāho tattvamicchāmi veditum |
tyāgasya ca hṛṣīkeśa pṛthakkeśiniṣūdana
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: mighty-armed one, I want the truth about giving up acts and giving up their fruits — distinctly.
verses.takeaway: The final chapter opens with the final question.

verses.devanagari:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः ।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः
verses.iast:
śrībhagavānuvāca
kāmyānāṃ karmaṇāṃ nyāsaṃ saṃnyāsaṃ kavayo viduḥ |
sarvakarmaphalatyāgaṃ prāhustyāgaṃ vicakṣaṇāḥ
verses.meaning: Krishna said: dropping desire-driven acts, the poets call renunciation. Dropping every fruit, the wise call surrender.
verses.takeaway: Two givings-up, distinguished at last.

verses.devanagari:
त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः ।
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे
verses.iast:
tyājyaṃ doṣavadityeke karma prāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ |
yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyamiti cāpare
verses.meaning: Some sages say all action is tainted — abandon it. Others say ritual, charity, and discipline must stay.
verses.takeaway: The debate, fairly stated both ways.

verses.devanagari:
निश्चयं शृणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम ।
त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः संप्रकीर्तितः
verses.iast:
niścayaṃ śṛṇu me tatra tyāge bharatasattama |
tyāgo hi puruṣavyāghra trividhaḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ
verses.meaning: Hear My verdict on surrender. It runs threefold, best of Bharatas.
verses.takeaway: The judge speaks. Three kinds coming.

verses.devanagari:
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत् ।
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्
verses.iast:
yajñadānatapaḥkarma na tyājyaṃ kāryameva tat |
yajño dānaṃ tapaścaiva pāvanāni manīṣiṇām
verses.meaning: Ritual, charity, discipline — never abandon these. They must be done. They purify even the wise.
verses.takeaway: Three keepers. Non-negotiable.

verses.devanagari:
एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च ।
कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
etānyapi tu karmāṇi saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalāni ca |
kartavyānīti me pārtha niścitaṃ matamuttamam
verses.meaning: Yet do even these without clinging or hunger for results. That is My settled, final word.
verses.takeaway: Signed and sealed opinion.

verses.devanagari:
नियतस्य तु संन्यासः कर्मणो नोपपद्यते ।
मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः
verses.iast:
niyatasya tu saṃnyāsaḥ karmaṇo nopapadyate |
mohāttasya parityāgastāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.meaning: Refusing required duty is wrong. Quitting it from confusion is dark surrender.
verses.takeaway: Duty dodged is not duty transcended.

verses.devanagari:
दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म कायक्लेशभयात्त्यजेत् ।
स कृत्वा राजसं त्यागं नैव त्यागफलं लभेत्
verses.iast:
duḥkhamityeva yatkarma kāyakleśabhayāttyajet |
sa kṛtvā rājasaṃ tyāgaṃ naiva tyāgaphalaṃ labhet
verses.meaning: Quitting hard duty from fear of hardship earns nothing. That is passionate surrender.
verses.takeaway: Comfort is a poor guru.

verses.devanagari:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं क्रियतेऽर्जुन ।
सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलं चैव स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः
verses.iast:
kāryamityeva yatkarma niyataṃ kriyate'rjuna |
saṅgaṃ tyaktvā phalaṃ caiva sa tyāgaḥ sāttviko mataḥ
verses.meaning: Doing required duty detached and fruit-free. Simply because it must be done. That is clear surrender.
verses.takeaway: The gold standard, stated simply.

verses.devanagari:
न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म कुशले नानुषज्जते ।
त्यागी सत्त्वसमाविष्टो मेधावी छिन्नसंशयः
verses.iast:
na dveṣṭyakuśalaṃ karma kuśale nānuṣajjate |
tyāgī sattvasamāviṣṭo medhāvī chinnasaṃśayaḥ
verses.meaning: The clear surrenderer neither hates hard tasks nor clings to easy ones. Doubts gone, wisdom full.
verses.takeaway: Equanimity toward the task list.

verses.devanagari:
न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः ।
यस्तु कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते
verses.iast:
na hi dehabhṛtā śakyaṃ tyaktuṃ karmāṇyaśeṣataḥ |
yastu karmaphalatyāgī sa tyāgītyabhidhīyate
verses.meaning: No embodied being can quit acting entirely. Who quits the fruits is the true surrenderer.
verses.takeaway: Hands will act. Let motives rest.

verses.devanagari:
अनिष्टमिष्टं मिश्रं च त्रिविधं कर्मणः फलम् ।
भवत्यत्यागिनां प्रेत्य न तु संन्यासिनां क्वचित्
verses.iast:
aniṣṭamiṣṭaṃ miśraṃ ca trividhaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam |
bhavatyatyāgināṃ pretya na tu saṃnyāsināṃ kvacit
verses.meaning: Pleasant, painful, mixed. Triple harvest for the un-surrendered hereafter. Never for the surrendered.
verses.takeaway: Three fruits for the clinging. None for the free.

verses.devanagari:
पञ्चैतानि महाबाहो कारणानि निबोध मे ।
सांख्ये कृतान्ते प्रोक्तानि सिद्धये सर्वकर्मणाम्
verses.iast:
pañcaitāni mahābāho kāraṇāni nibodha me |
sāṃkhye kṛtānte proktāni siddhaye sarvakarmaṇām
verses.meaning: Learn the five makers of every act, taught in Sankhya wisdom.
verses.takeaway: Action has five parents. Meet them.

verses.devanagari:
अधिष्ठानं तथा कर्ता करणं च पृथग्विधम् ।
विविधाश्च पृथक्चेष्टा दैवं चैवात्र पञ्चमम्
verses.iast:
adhiṣṭhānaṃ tathā kartā karaṇaṃ ca pṛthagvidham |
vividhāśca pṛthakceṣṭā daivaṃ caivātra pañcamam
verses.meaning: The body, the doer, the instruments, the efforts, and fate as fifth.
verses.takeaway: The full committee behind every deed.

verses.devanagari:
शरीरवाङ्‌मनोभिर्यत्कर्म प्रारभते नरः ।
न्याय्यं वा विपरीतं वा पञ्चैते तस्य हेतवः
verses.iast:
śarīravāṅ‌manobhiryatkarma prārabhate naraḥ |
nyāyyaṃ vā viparītaṃ vā pañcaite tasya hetavaḥ
verses.meaning: Whatever one does — body, speech, or mind, right or wrong — these five cause it.
verses.takeaway: No act has a single author.

verses.devanagari:
तत्रैवं सति कर्तारमात्मानं केवलं तु यः ।
पश्यत्यकृतबुद्धित्वान्न स पश्यति दुर्मतिः
verses.iast:
tatraivaṃ sati kartāramātmānaṃ kevalaṃ tu yaḥ |
paśyatyakṛtabuddhitvānna sa paśyati durmatiḥ
verses.meaning: Who sees the spotless Self as the lone doer, dim of mind, sees nothing rightly.
verses.takeaway: Blaming the soul for the committee's work.

verses.devanagari:
यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते ।
हत्वापि स इमाँल्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते
verses.iast:
yasya nāhaṃkṛto bhāvo buddhiryasya na lipyate |
hatvāpi sa imām̐llokānna hanti na nibadhyate
verses.meaning: Ego gone, heart unstained — even slaying these armies, one slays not, nor is bound.
verses.takeaway: The verse Arjuna needed on page one.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं परिज्ञाता त्रिविधा कर्मचोदना ।
करणं कर्म कर्तेति त्रिविधः कर्मसंग्रहः
verses.iast:
jñānaṃ jñeyaṃ parijñātā trividhā karmacodanā |
karaṇaṃ karma karteti trividhaḥ karmasaṃgrahaḥ
verses.meaning: Knowing, known, knower — three spurs to action. Tool, deed, doer — action's triple shape.
verses.takeaway: The anatomy of every act.

verses.devanagari:
ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः ।
प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि
verses.iast:
jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ |
procyate guṇasaṃkhyāne yathāvacchṛṇu tānyapi
verses.meaning: Wisdom, work, and worker each run threefold by nature's moods. Hear them truly told.
verses.takeaway: Three times three. Listen well.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम्
verses.iast:
sarvabhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvamavyayamīkṣate |
avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam
verses.meaning: Seeing one imperishable being in all separate beings. Undivided in the divided. That is clear wisdom.
verses.takeaway: One sight, everywhere. Again.

verses.devanagari:
पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् ।
वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम्
verses.iast:
pṛthaktvena tu yajjñānaṃ nānābhāvānpṛthagvidhān |
vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam
verses.meaning: Seeing only scattered manyness in every being. Separate and apart. That is passionate wisdom.
verses.takeaway: Division as doctrine.

verses.devanagari:
यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् ।
अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.iast:
yattu kṛtsnavadekasminkārye saktamahaitukam |
atattvārthavadalpaṃ ca tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.meaning: Clinging to one fragment as the whole, reasonless, petty, narrow — that is dark wisdom.
verses.takeaway: The part mistaken for the all.

verses.devanagari:
नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते
verses.iast:
niyataṃ saṅgarahitamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam |
aphalaprepsunā karma yattatsāttvikamucyate
verses.meaning: Duty done detached, without likes or dislikes. Wanting no fruit. That is clear action.
verses.takeaway: The cleanest definition of right action.

verses.devanagari:
यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम्
verses.iast:
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṃkāreṇa vā punaḥ |
kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam
verses.meaning: Action straining with craving and ego. Heavy with effort. That is passionate action.
verses.takeaway: Sweat with self in it.

verses.devanagari:
अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनवेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते
verses.iast:
anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsāmanavekṣya ca pauruṣam |
mohādārabhyate karma yattattāmasamucyate
verses.meaning: Action begun in delusion. Blind to cost, harm, injury, or capacity. That is dark action.
verses.takeaway: Blind doing, double damage.

verses.devanagari:
मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते
verses.iast:
muktasaṅgo'nahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ |
siddhyasiddhyornirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate
verses.meaning: Free of clinging and self-talk, brave, energetic, steady in win or loss — that is the clear doer.
verses.takeaway: The portrait of the steady worker.

verses.devanagari:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः ।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः
verses.iast:
rāgī karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hiṃsātmako'śuciḥ |
harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ
verses.meaning: Greedy for results, grasping, cruel, impure, tossed by joys and sorrows — that is the passionate doer.
verses.takeaway: The portrait of the hungry worker.

verses.devanagari:
अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः ।
विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते
verses.iast:
ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko'lasaḥ |
viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate
verses.meaning: Slack, vulgar, stubborn, cheating. Spiteful, lazy, gloomy, stalling. That is the dark doer.
verses.takeaway: Eight stains, one worker.

verses.devanagari:
बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु ।
प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनंजय
verses.iast:
buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śṛṇu |
procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanaṃjaya
verses.meaning: Now hear wisdom and willpower. Each threefold by nature. Told fully and distinctly.
verses.takeaway: Two faculties. Three shades each.

verses.devanagari:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
verses.iast:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye |
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.meaning: Knowing duty from non-duty, courage from fear, bondage from freedom — that is clear wisdom.
verses.takeaway: Discrimination as a superpower.

verses.devanagari:
यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी
verses.iast:
yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca |
ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.meaning: Seeing right and wrong, fit and unfit, only crookedly — that is passionate wisdom.
verses.takeaway: Half-light, half-blind.

verses.devanagari:
अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता ।
सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी
verses.iast:
adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā |
sarvārthānviparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.meaning: Calling wrong right, seeing everything backwards under darkness — that is dark wisdom.
verses.takeaway: Inversion as worldview.

verses.devanagari:
धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः ।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी
verses.iast:
dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ |
yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī
verses.meaning: The will that holds mind, breath, and senses steady in unbroken focus — that is clear resolve.
verses.takeaway: Steadiness as strength.

verses.devanagari:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन ।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी
verses.iast:
yayā tu dharmakāmārthāndhṛtyā dhārayate'rjuna |
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī
verses.meaning: The will that clutches duty, pleasure, and wealth for their fruits — that is passionate resolve.
verses.takeaway: Grip mistaken for strength.

verses.devanagari:
यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी
verses.iast:
yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca |
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī
verses.meaning: The will that will not drop sleep, fear, grief, gloom, or folly — that is dark resolve.
verses.takeaway: Stubbornness in the wrong things.

verses.devanagari:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति
verses.iast:
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha |
abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati
verses.meaning: Now hear the three joys. Where practice turns to delight and pain comes to its end —
verses.takeaway: Joy also runs threefold.

verses.devanagari:
यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम्
verses.iast:
yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme'mṛtopamam |
tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam
verses.meaning: Poison at first, nectar at last, born of self-knowledge — that joy is clear.
verses.takeaway: The slow joy that lasts.

verses.devanagari:
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम् ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम्
verses.iast:
viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre'mṛtopamam |
pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam
verses.meaning: Nectar at first from sense-contact, poison at last — that joy is passionate.
verses.takeaway: The fast joy that fades.

verses.devanagari:
यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्
verses.iast:
yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ |
nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam
verses.meaning: Befogging at first and last, born of sleep, sloth, and error — that joy is dark.
verses.takeaway: The joy that never was joy.

verses.devanagari:
न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः
verses.iast:
na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ |
sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāttribhirguṇaiḥ
verses.meaning: Nothing on earth or in heaven stands free of nature's three moods.
verses.takeaway: No exemptions. None.

verses.devanagari:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप ।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः
verses.iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa |
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ
verses.meaning: Priests, warriors, merchants, laborers. Each has work assigned by inborn nature.
verses.takeaway: Four natures. Four works.

verses.devanagari:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम्
verses.iast:
śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca |
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam
verses.meaning: Calm, restraint, discipline, purity. Patience, honesty, wisdom, experience, faith. The priest's work.
verses.takeaway: Nine notes of the priestly chord.

verses.devanagari:
शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम्
verses.iast:
śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam |
dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam
verses.meaning: Valor, fire, resolve, skill. Never fleeing battle. Giving. Commanding. The warrior's work.
verses.takeaway: Seven notes of the warrior chord.

verses.devanagari:
कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम्
verses.iast:
kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam |
paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam
verses.meaning: Plowing, herding, trading — the merchant's work by nature. Serving — the laborer's work.
verses.takeaway: Work sorted by nature, not contempt.

verses.devanagari:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः ।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु
verses.iast:
sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ |
svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu
verses.meaning: Loving one's own work, one reaches perfection. Hear how duty-done becomes perfection-won.
verses.takeaway: Excellence in place beats imitation elsewhere.

verses.devanagari:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः
verses.iast:
yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam |
svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ
verses.meaning: Worshipping through duty the source of all, the all-pervader — one reaches perfection.
verses.takeaway: Work as worship. Duty as liturgy.

verses.devanagari:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम्
verses.iast:
śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt |
svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam
verses.meaning: Your own flawed duty beats another's perfect one. Doing nature's task incurs no sin.
verses.takeaway: Flawed and yours beats polished and borrowed.

verses.devanagari:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः
verses.iast:
sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet |
sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ
verses.meaning: Never drop inborn work, flaws and all. Every enterprise carries flaws, as fire carries smoke.
verses.takeaway: Smoke proves fire. Flaws prove work.

verses.devanagari:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति
verses.iast:
asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ |
naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati
verses.meaning: Self-ruled, detached everywhere, want-free. Through surrender one wins. Freedom from action itself.
verses.takeaway: The summit past the summit.

verses.devanagari:
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा
verses.iast:
siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me |
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā
verses.meaning: Hear briefly how the perfected one reaches the ultimate. Wisdom's highest crown.
verses.takeaway: Perfection has a further shore.

verses.devanagari:
बुद्ध्या विशुद्ध्या युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च
verses.iast:
buddhyā viśuddhyā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca |
śabdādīnviṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca
verses.meaning: Pure intellect, self mastered by resolve. Senses set aside. Likes and dislikes dropped.
verses.takeaway: The equipment list for the final climb.

verses.devanagari:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः ।
ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः
verses.iast:
viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ |
dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ
verses.meaning: Lonely haunts, little food. Speech, body, mind restrained. Ever meditating. Desire renounced.
verses.takeaway: The regime of the God-bound.

verses.devanagari:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते
verses.iast:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham |
vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate
verses.meaning: Ego, force, arrogance, craving, anger, possessions — shed. Mine-less, tranquil — fit for oneness.
verses.takeaway: Six weights dropped. One fitness earned.

verses.devanagari:
ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम्
verses.iast:
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati |
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām
verses.meaning: One with the ultimate, serene — no grief, no craving. Same to all beings. Highest love for Me.
verses.takeaway: Equality ripens into devotion.

verses.devanagari:
भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम्
verses.iast:
bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ |
tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram
verses.meaning: Through love one knows Me truly — how great I am. Knowing truly, one enters Me.
verses.takeaway: Love knows. Knowledge enters.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः ।
मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम्
verses.iast:
sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ |
matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam
verses.meaning: Doing all acts sheltered in Me, by My grace one wins the eternal, imperishable home.
verses.takeaway: Shelter first. Home after.

verses.devanagari:
चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव
verses.iast:
cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ |
buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava
verses.meaning: Offer every act to Me in thought. Hold Me highest. Mind on Me always through steady focus.
verses.takeaway: The standing instruction.

verses.devanagari:
मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि ।
अथ चेत्त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि
verses.iast:
maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi |
atha cettvamahaṃkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi
verses.meaning: Mind on Me — cross every danger by My grace. Refuse through ego — and perish.
verses.takeaway: Two futures. Your call.

verses.devanagari:
यदहंकारमाश्रित्य न योत्स्य इति मन्यसे ।
मिथ्यैष व्यवसायस्ते प्रकृतिस्त्वां नियोक्ष्यति
verses.iast:
yadahaṃkāramāśritya na yotsya iti manyase |
mithyaiṣa vyavasāyaste prakṛtistvāṃ niyokṣyati
verses.meaning: 'I will not fight' — vain resolve. Your own nature will drag you to war.
verses.takeaway: Nature outvotes resolutions.

verses.devanagari:
स्वभावजेन कौन्तेय निबद्धः स्वेन कर्मणा ।
कर्तुं नेच्छसि यन्मोहात्करिष्यस्यवशोऽपि तत्
verses.iast:
svabhāvajena kaunteya nibaddhaḥ svena karmaṇā |
kartuṃ necchasi yanmohātkariṣyasyavaśo'pi tat
verses.meaning: Bound by your own duty-born nature, helpless, you will do what delusion refuses.
verses.takeaway: The question answers itself.

verses.devanagari:
ईश्वरः सर्वभूतानां हृद्देशेऽर्जुन तिष्ठति ।
भ्रामयन्सर्वभूतानि यन्त्रारूढानि मायया
verses.iast:
īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hṛddeśe'rjuna tiṣṭhati |
bhrāmayansarvabhūtāni yantrārūḍhāni māyayā
verses.meaning: The Lord sits in every heart, spinning all beings round as on a machine by His power.
verses.takeaway: The puppeteer with love in His hands.

verses.devanagari:
तमेव शरणं गच्छ सर्वभावेन भारत ।
तत्प्रसादात्परां शान्तिं स्थानं प्राप्स्यसि शाश्वतम्
verses.iast:
tameva śaraṇaṃ gaccha sarvabhāvena bhārata |
tatprasādātparāṃ śāntiṃ sthānaṃ prāpsyasi śāśvatam
verses.meaning: Surrender to Him wholly. By His grace find supreme peace and the eternal home.
verses.takeaway: Total surrender. Total peace.

verses.devanagari:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्‌गुह्यतरं मया ।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु
verses.iast:
iti te jñānamākhyātaṃ guhyād‌guhyataraṃ mayā |
vimṛśyaitadaśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru
verses.meaning: Thus I have told the most hidden wisdom. Think it through fully — then act as you will.
verses.takeaway: Freedom, after full disclosure.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वगुह्यतमं भूयः शृणु मे परमं वचः ।
इष्टोऽसि मे दृढमिति ततो वक्ष्यामि ते हितम्
verses.iast:
sarvaguhyatamaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ |
iṣṭo'si me dṛḍhamiti tato vakṣyāmi te hitam
verses.meaning: Hear once more My highest word. You are dearly loved — so I speak your good.
verses.takeaway: Love is the reason for the encore.

verses.devanagari:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु ।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे
verses.iast:
manmanā bhava madbhakto madyājī māṃ namaskuru |
māmevaiṣyasi satyaṃ te pratijāne priyo'si me
verses.meaning: Mind on Me. Love Me. Serve Me. Bow to Me. You shall reach Me — truly promised, for you are dear.
verses.takeaway: Four imperatives and a vow.

verses.devanagari:
सर्वधर्मान्परित्यज्य मामेकं शरणं व्रज ।
अहं त्वां सर्वपापेभ्यो मोक्षयिष्यामि मा शुचः
verses.iast:
sarvadharmānparityajya māmekaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraja |
ahaṃ tvāṃ sarvapāpebhyo mokṣayiṣyāmi mā śucaḥ
verses.meaning: Drop every duty-code. Take Me alone as refuge. I will free you from all wrongs. Do not grieve.
verses.takeaway: The most quoted verse. Earned its fame.

verses.devanagari:
इदं ते नातपस्काय नाभक्ताय कदाचन ।
न चाशुश्रूषवे वाच्यं न च मां योऽभ्यसूयति
verses.iast:
idaṃ te nātapaskāya nābhaktāya kadācana |
na cāśuśrūṣave vācyaṃ na ca māṃ yo'bhyasūyati
verses.meaning: Never tell this to the harsh, the faithless, the closed, or the scoffer.
verses.takeaway: The teaching has a lock. Respect it.

verses.devanagari:
य इमं परमं गुह्यं मद्भक्तेष्वभिधास्यति ।
भक्तिं मयि परां कृत्वा मामेवैष्यत्यसंशयः
verses.iast:
ya imaṃ paramaṃ guhyaṃ madbhakteṣvabhidhāsyati |
bhaktiṃ mayi parāṃ kṛtvā māmevaiṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ
verses.meaning: Who shares this supreme secret with My lovers, loving Me deeply — reaches Me, doubt-free.
verses.takeaway: Transmission is itself devotion.

verses.devanagari:
न च तस्मान्मनुष्येषु कश्चिन्मे प्रियकृत्तमः ।
भविता न च मे तस्मादन्यः प्रियतरो भुवि
verses.iast:
na ca tasmānmanuṣyeṣu kaścinme priyakṛttamaḥ |
bhavitā na ca me tasmādanyaḥ priyataro bhuvi
verses.meaning: None serves Me more dearly among humans. None ever will.
verses.takeaway: The highest service, ranked first.

verses.devanagari:
अध्येष्यते च य इमं धर्म्यं संवादमावयोः ।
ज्ञानयज्ञेन तेनाहमिष्टः स्यामिति मे मतिः
verses.iast:
adhyeṣyate ca ya imaṃ dharmyaṃ saṃvādamāvayoḥ |
jñānayajñena tenāhamiṣṭaḥ syāmiti me matiḥ
verses.meaning: Who studies this holy dialogue offers Me wisdom's own sacrifice. So I hold.
verses.takeaway: Study as offering. Reading as rite.

verses.devanagari:
श्रद्धावाननसूयश्च शृणुयादपि यो नरः ।
सोऽपि मुक्तः शुभाँल्लोकान्प्राप्नुयात्पुण्यकर्मणाम्
verses.iast:
śraddhāvānanasūyaśca śṛṇuyādapi yo naraḥ |
so'pi muktaḥ śubhām̐llokānprāpnuyātpuṇyakarmaṇām
verses.meaning: Who listens faithfully, without scoffing, is freed — rising to the worlds of the good.
verses.takeaway: Listening counts. Faithfully.

verses.devanagari:
कच्चिदेतच्छ्रुतं पार्थ त्वयैकाग्रेण चेतसा ।
कच्चिदज्ञानसंमोहः प्रनष्टस्ते धनंजय
verses.iast:
kaccidetacchrutaṃ pārtha tvayaikāgreṇa cetasā |
kaccidajñānasaṃmohaḥ pranaṣṭaste dhanaṃjaya
verses.meaning: Did you hear with focused mind? Is ignorance-born delusion gone, Arjuna?
verses.takeaway: The teacher's final question.

verses.speaker: अर्जुन
verses.devanagari:
नष्टो मोहः स्मृतिर्लब्धा त्वत्प्रसादान्मयाच्युत ।
स्थितोऽस्मि गतसन्देहः करिष्ये वचनं तव
verses.iast:
naṣṭo mohaḥ smṛtirlabdhā tvatprasādānmayācyuta |
sthito'smi gatasandehaḥ kariṣye vacanaṃ tava
verses.meaning: Arjuna said: delusion gone. Memory regained by Your grace. Doubts fled. I stand ready. I will do Your word.
verses.takeaway: The student's final answer. War can begin.

verses.speaker: सञ्जय
verses.devanagari:
इत्यहं वासुदेवस्य पार्थस्य च महात्मनः ।
संवादमिममश्रौषमद्भुतं रोमहर्षणम्
verses.iast:
ityahaṃ vāsudevasya pārthasya ca mahātmanaḥ |
saṃvādamimamaśrauṣamadbhutaṃ romaharṣaṇam
verses.meaning: Sanjaya said: thus I heard this wondrous, hair-raising dialogue of Krishna and the great-souled prince.
verses.takeaway: The narrator signs his report.

verses.devanagari:
व्यासप्रसादाच्छ्रुतवानेतद्गुह्यमहं परम् ।
योगं योगेश्वरात्कृष्णात्साक्षात्कथयतः स्वयम्
verses.iast:
vyāsaprasādācchrutavānetadguhyamahaṃ param |
yogaṃ yogeśvarātkṛṣṇātsākṣātkathayataḥ svayam
verses.meaning: By Vyasa's grace I heard this supreme mystery of devotion. From Krishna Himself. Lord of discipline. Speaking in person.
verses.takeaway: Lineage stated. Source named.

verses.devanagari:
राजन्संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य संवादमिममद्भुतम् ।
केशवार्जुनयोः पुण्यं हृष्यामि च मुहुर्मुहुः
verses.iast:
rājansaṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya saṃvādamimamadbhutam |
keśavārjunayoḥ puṇyaṃ hṛṣyāmi ca muhurmuhuḥ
verses.meaning: Remembering this holy dialogue again and again, O king, I rejoice endlessly.
verses.takeaway: Joy on repeat.

verses.devanagari:
तच्च संस्मृत्य संस्मृत्य रूपमत्यद्भुतं हरेः ।
विस्मयो मे महान् राजन्हृष्यामि च पुनः पुनः
verses.iast:
tacca saṃsmṛtya saṃsmṛtya rūpamatyadbhutaṃ hareḥ |
vismayo me mahān rājanhṛṣyāmi ca punaḥ punaḥ
verses.meaning: Remembering Hari's awesome form again and again — great is my wonder, and my joy.
verses.takeaway: Wonder on repeat.

verses.devanagari:
यत्र योगेश्वरः कृष्णो यत्र पार्थो धनुर्धरः ।
तत्र श्रीर्विजयो भूतिर्ध्रुवा नीतिर्मतिर्मम
verses.iast:
yatra yogeśvaraḥ kṛṣṇo yatra pārtho dhanurdharaḥ |
tatra śrīrvijayo bhūtirdhruvā nītirmatirmama
verses.meaning: Where Krishna leads and Arjuna strives. There stand fortune, victory, prosperity, and justice.
verses.takeaway: The last word: the winning side.

feelings.line: For when the mind will not sit still.
feelings.name: Restless

feelings.line: For when you have fallen short.
feelings.name: Failing

feelings.line: For when you ask what it is all for.
feelings.name: Seeking Purpose
